name: 5TH EVRYTANIA TRAIL RACES
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, Μαραθώνιος, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 12 km, 5 km
description: The organizers of the 5th Evrytania Trail Races invite you to run on the pine-covered trails of the mountainous Evrytania, in one of Europe's cleanest ecosystems. The races offer a unique opportunity to experience the magic of nature, cool off in the crystal-clear waters of the Krikellopotamos River, and enjoy the hospitality of traditional villages that serve as refreshment stations. The event includes races of different distances suitable for beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful and challenging routes combining trails, dirt roads, and roads.
course_highlights: Pine-covered trails with 60% trail on all routes
Refueling stations in traditional villages along the route
Elevation differences from 350m to 1000m depending on the distance
additional: The races include 6K, 12K, and 20K routes with different cutoff times (2 hours for 6K, 3 hours for 12K, 5 hours for 20K). The start for 6K and 12K is on Saturday, May 30th at 17:00 from the central square of Krikello, while the 20K starts on Sunday, May 31st at 10:00 from the forest of Prophet Elias in Domnista. No mandatory equipment is required, but minimal survival gear and water are recommended. There is a generous time limit for walking or completing the route. The event is open to participants aged 16 and over (6K, 12K) and 18 and over (20K). The races include both trail running and cultural activities, emphasizing nature and local tradition. Participants should be prepared for difficult mountain routes and be autonomous with their equipment.

name: 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος Χαλκιόπουλοι Βάλτου
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας – Πειραιά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The 2nd Mountain Trail Running Race in the paths of the Valtians Fighters - Chalkiopoulo Trail Run 2026 will take place on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Neo Chalkiopoulo, Valto, Aetolia-Acarnania, starting at 9:00 AM. The event is organized by the Association of Chalkiopouloi of Athens - Piraeus "Saint Andrew the Hermit", the Cultural and Educational Association of Chalkiopouloi, the local Community of Chalkiopouloi, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races include two distances, 27 and 10 kilometers, crossing the beautiful mountainous landscapes of Chalkiopouloi and Valto, offering a unique mountain running experience.
course_highlights: Routes of 27 and 10 kilometers on the trails of the Valtians Fighters
Passages through local villages and natural landscapes such as Velora, Paliagrapidia, Prophet Elias, Saint Nicholas
Start and finish in Neo Chalkiopoulo, with varied terrain and mountain character
additional: The races are organized by the Association of Chalkiopouloi of Athens - Piraeus "Saint Andrew the Hermit", the Cultural and Educational Association of Chalkiopouloi, the local Community of Chalkiopouloi, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The start is at 9:00 AM from Neo Chalkiopoulo. The 27 km route passes through many local points of interest and villages, providing a comprehensive mountain running experience. Routes on mountain trails, camping area, meal for finishers, limited rooms in the village, and a need for quick reservation.

name: 5η Γιορτή Αθλητισμού Δήμου Γαύδου
description: The 5th Sports Festival of the Municipality of Gavdos is an open mass sports celebration held on the island of Gavdos, as part of the Holy Spirit three-day festival. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and noble competition, providing residents and visitors the opportunity to participate actively. The running races include routes that highlight the natural beauty and trails of the island, offering a unique experience at the southernmost tip of Europe. The organization has established itself as a tradition with high participation and impeccable organization.
course_highlights: Routes through the natural beauty trails of Gavdos
Running races of 21 km, 11 km, and 6 km
The southernmost tip of Europe as the race setting
additional: The event includes races for adults and children, with timing for adults and no timing for children. Participation exceeds 130-150 people, with great success and institutional character. The event takes place during the Holy Spirit three-day festival and promotes noble competition and a healthy lifestyle. Off-road running races, participation for those over 15 years old with parental responsibility, and registration for races of 10 km, 6 km, and 1 km under personal responsibility and acceptance of participation terms.

name: 5ο Posidonia Running Event
description: The 5th Posidonia Running Event will take place on May 31, 2026, in Piraeus, offering a 5-kilometer route through the city streets. The event is open to runners from around the world and combines sports with support for charitable causes, as the proceeds will be allocated to the Municipality of Piraeus and partnering charitable organizations. The start and finish will be at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, with a start time at 09:00 a.m. The event is part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition and promises a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route through the streets of Piraeus
Start and finish at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus
Organized within the framework of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition
additional: Registrations for the race have already closed. The organization supports charitable causes with the proceeds allocated to the Municipality of Piraeus and partner organizations. The race is open to individuals over 14 years old with medical clearance, with a limited number of participants and online registration. The proceeds are directed to charitable causes, and the event is an important meeting point for the maritime community.

name: 5ο Rock Solid Kastellorizo
description: The 5th Rock Solid Kastellorizo is a small trail-running weekend held in Kastellorizo at the end of May. It includes routes of 22 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1.3 km, all starting from the same point. The main 22 km route is mountainous with significant elevation gain and requires serious preparation, while the shorter routes offer a more friendly and social atmosphere. The race is organized under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Mountain Sports and offers medals, plaques, and awards to the winners and the top local finishers.
course_highlights: Mountainous route of 22 km with 1,006 meters of positive elevation
Mix of natural trails and asphalt with views of the islet Ro
Limited participation in the shorter routes for a more personal atmosphere
additional: The 10 km race has a participation limit of 50 runners and a cut-off time of 2 hours 30 minutes. The 5 km race has a limit of 80 participants, and the children's 1.3 km race has a limit of 50 participants. Medals, age category plaques, and awards for the top three men and women overall are provided, as well as a separate plaque for the first local finisher. There are feeding stations, medical support, and course signage. The weather in May is warm with an average temperature of 28°C and a 30mm chance of rain. The event includes medals, awards, and souvenirs, emphasizing enjoyment of nature and the sporting experience.

name: 6ο Karya Olympus Trail
description: Karya Olympus Trail is a mountain running race held in Karya, offering a unique experience for runners who love nature and mountain challenges. The race highlights the beauty of Olympus and the surrounding area, combining demanding trails with stunning views. It is an event that attracts runners of all levels, aiming to promote sports and local tradition. The organization is welcoming and supports participants every step of the way.
course_highlights: Mountain route in Olympus
Trails with natural beauty and views
Challenging terrain for runners of all levels
additional: The event includes different routes, with the longest race being 25 km, and takes place on the slopes of Olympus, with participants from all levels. Participation and experience combine nature, endurance, and authentic mountain atmosphere.

name: 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου
description: The 42nd Distomo Memorial Run is a commemorative running race held on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Distomo, honoring the memory of the 1944 massacre. The 11.2 km route starts from the historic site of Karakolithos and ends at the National Resistance Square. The race offers free participation and includes a children's race of 1.1 km starting at the same time. The organization arranges transportation for runners, timing, medical coverage, and refreshments along the route and at the finish line.
course_highlights: 11.2 km route with slight elevation changes
Start from the historic site of Karakolithos
Finish at the National Resistance Square of Distomo
additional: Number pickup is on race day from 08:30 to 09:30 at the start area. Organized bus transportation for runners from the National Resistance Square to the start is available between 07:30-08:30. There are water stations with refreshments at the 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th kilometers. At the finish line, water, juices, and bananas are offered. Full medical coverage is provided with a doctor and ambulance. The top three men and women are awarded, and all finishers receive commemorative medals and participation diplomas. The race is held in memory of the victims of the 1944 Distomo massacre, with memorial and commemorative events, as well as various activities in the area.

name: Mystras Trail
organizer: Δήμος Σπάρτης και ο Σύλλογος Σπαρτιάτες Δρομείς
description: The Mystras Trail 2026 race is organized by the Municipality of Sparta and the Spartiatates Runners Club, with the support of the Mountaineering Club of Sparta, as part of the festive events of Palaiologeia. It is a demanding mountain race that includes three circular routes of different distances, starting between 09:00 and 10:00 in the morning of May 31, 2026. The routes cross technical trails with loose ground and rocks, offering a challenge for experienced runners. The organization provides electronic timing, feeding stations, and a race shirt to all participants.
course_highlights: Three circular routes of different distances: 26 km, 12 km, and 6 km
Technical trails with loose ground and rocks, demanding terrain
Positive elevation gain up to 1680 meters on the longest route
additional: Number pickup takes place on race day at the start area, at least one hour before the start. Timing is done with a chip that runners must wear throughout the race and return after finishing. Along the routes, there are feeding stations with water, isotonic drinks, and snacks. Cups are awarded to the top three men and women in each route, with exceptions in age categories. The route is technical and demanding, with loose ground and rocks. It includes electronic timing, a chip, and medals for all finishers. There are three routes and participation in various categories and ages.

name: Sifnathlon
organizer: Δήμος Σίφνου και Ένωση Συμμετασχόντων σε Ολυμπιακούς Αγώνες
description: The SiFNaThLoN 2026 in Sifnos invites runners and swimmers to experience a unique athletic event on one of the most charming islands of the Cyclades. The competitions take place over two days, with open water swimming on May 30 and running races on May 31, in the enchanting landscapes of Sifnos, such as the beaches of Platys Gialos and the Kamara area. The running routes combine asphalt and dirt paths, offering a variety of terrains for participants. This event combines sport and the beauty of the Aegean, making it ideal for athletes of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Open water swimming at Platys Gialos beach
Running routes with mixed terrain of asphalt and dirt paths
Races in the stunning landscapes of Kamara and Platys Gialos
additional: The races are held over two days: on Saturday, May 30, 2026, there is an open water swimming event with distances of 3 km, 1.5 km for adults, and 300 meters for children. On Sunday, May 31, 2026, running races of 10 km and 4 km for adults are held, along with children's running races for elementary and middle school students. The children's races take place at the 5x5 stadium in Kamara. The running route is mixed with asphalt and dirt paths. The event includes 4 km and 10 km running races, as well as swimming competitions for children, in a beautiful location with beaches and trails that encourage enjoyment and athletic activity.

name: Karya Olympus Trail
description: The Karya Olympus Trail 2026 race offers a unique mountain running experience in the idyllic valley of Karya, under the protection of Mount Olympus. The routes follow marked trails with different distances and positive elevation gain, suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes races of 25, 13, and 5 kilometers, as well as children's races, with amenities such as electronic timing, commemorative medals, and technical t-shirts. The start is early in the morning, and the awards are given at the start-finish area. The region offers natural beauty and historical interest, making the race a comprehensive athletic and cultural experience.
course_highlights: Routes on marked trails with positive elevation gain from +285 m to +1500 m
Natural beauty of the Ziliána valley and views of Mount Olympus
Variety of distances from 0.6 Km to 25 Km, suitable for all ages and levels
additional: Services: participant number, commemorative medal, electronic timing chip, technical t-shirt for 25Km & 13Km, buff for 5Km, water and snacks at stations and finish line, escort (sweep) after the last runner. Awards at 13:00 at the start-finish area. Includes routes of 25 km, 13 km, and 5 km, with organized amenities and souvenirs. Registration is open until May 10, 2026.

name: Titnata Trail
description: The Titnata Trail 13km is a short mountain running race held in Karya, Greece. The 13-kilometer route includes +760 meters of ascent, offering a challenging uphill challenge on a marked trail. The race starts at 08:50 and has a participation limit of 200 runners. Participants who finish receive a commemorative technical T-shirt.
course_highlights: 13 km marked mountain trail
+760 meters total ascent
Uphill and demanding route
additional: Participation limit of 200 runners. Trail map provided for preparation before the race. Trail race, registration fee 15 euros, technical T-shirt for finishers, trail map available

name: Αγώνας δρόμου ιστορικής μνήμης «Βασιλί – Δασόλοφος»
organizer: Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Βασιλί και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δασολόφου
description: The historical memory running race "Vasilí - Dasolófos" is organized by the Cultural Association of Vasilí and the Beautification Cultural Association of Dasolófos in memory of the 40 Greeks who were executed in 1944. The race starts from the square of Vasilí and crosses historic and scenic points of the area, honoring the memory of the heroes and promoting unity and historical awareness. After the finish, a memorial service will be held at the fallen soldiers' monument. The event combines sports with culture and history, inviting participants to send a message of remembrance and respect.
course_highlights: Start at the square of Vasilí
Route through the Folklore Museum, Enipeas Bridge, Vamvakou Square, Revmatiá and Sitóhoro villages
Finish at the square of Dasolófos
additional: After the race, a memorial service will be held at the fallen soldiers' monument in Kato Dasolófos by the Municipality of Farsala. Interested participants can contact the Presidents of the Associations to register. A running race with a historical and cultural character, route through villages, memorial ceremony, and memorial service.

name: Karya Mini Trail
description: The Karya Mini Trail race is part of the Karya Olympus Trail held in Karya, an idyllic valley in Olympus. The 5-kilometer route follows a marked trail with a positive elevation of 285 meters, offering a beautiful mountain running experience. The event also includes longer routes and children's races, with amenities such as electronic timing, souvenirs, and refreshments. Karya, with its rich history and natural beauty, provides a unique environment for runners and visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km route on a marked trail
Positive elevation +285 meters
Natural scenery in the Ziliána valley near Karya
additional: Services: participant number, commemorative buff for the 5 km race, electronic timing chip, water and snacks at stations and finish line, escort (sweep) after the last runner. Awards at 13:00 at the start-finish area. Mountain terrain, includes medal, t-shirt, water stations, online registration via bank transfer.

name: Tihiorace Ultra Edition
description: The Tihiorace Ultra Edition is a demanding mountain running race held in the enchanting landscape of Tihio Doryda in Greece. It includes three major ultra-distance routes with steep positive elevation gains, offering unique trails through nature. The race is aimed at runners seeking challenge and connection with the natural environment, with courses ranging from 75 to 250 kilometers. The organization is welcoming and supports participants with useful information and infrastructure.
course_highlights: Unique trails through enchanting natural scenery
Significant positive elevation gains (up to 14,000m)
Ultra-distance routes of 75km, 170km, and 250km
additional: The race includes three routes: UltraSummits TihioRace 250Km, X-Ultra TihioRace 170Km, and 75-Ultra Tihiorace 75km with positive elevation gains of 14,000m, 9,100m, and 3,500m respectively. The organization also provides information on accommodation, access, restaurants, and attractions in the Tihio Doryda area. Support is available for athletes with disabilities in other events of the organization. The race features rugged mountain terrain, multiple ultra routes, and is open for entries until 17/05/2026. There are options for various ultra distances, with significant elevation differences and beautiful scenery.

name: Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης
organizer: δήμος Νέας Σμύρνης και Περιφέρεια Αττικής
description: The Night Race of Nea Smyrni 2026 is a 5-kilometer running race organized by the Municipality of Nea Smyrni in collaboration with the Attica Region and the Nea Smyrni Commercial Association, in the context of World Environment Day. The race has an athletic, ecological, and entertainment character, aiming to promote environmental protection and sustainable development. The route takes place along Eleftheriou Venizelou Street, starting and finishing at Omirou 54. After the race, there is a concert and party, while local shops participate with special offers and discounts.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route along Eleftheriou Venizelou Street
Night race with music at points along the route
Start and finish at Omirou 54
additional: Registrations open on 13/05 at 12:00 with an extension until 19/05 at 12:00 for a limited number of spots, with professional timing and Bib Number. At the finish line, athletes receive medals, bananas, and water. All participants have free access to full photographic material and participation certificates via email. After the race, there is a concert and party, while the shops of Nea Smyrni remain open with special offers until 22:30. 5 km route, public roads, events, concert, happenings, participation via online registration, activities, and updates in the coming days.

name: Δρόμος της Ελιάς
description: The Olive Tree Race is a traditional running event organized in Gargalianoi, Messinia. The route starts and finishes at the central square of Gargalianoi, offering a beautiful running experience in a picturesque area. The race is participatory and open to runners of all levels, promoting athletic activity and health. The organization is carried out in collaboration with the SEGAS Central and Southern Peloponnese Regional Association and the Municipality of Trifylia.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the central square of Gargalianoi
12-kilometer route through a scenic environment
Co-organized by the Municipality of Trifylia and SEGAS Central and Southern Peloponnese Regional Association
additional: The event is part of the area's cultural and athletic activities, promoting health and local culture.

name: Global Day Run
description: The Global Day Run Patras 2026 is a friendly road race organized in Agia of Patras, aiming to promote running as a means of improving physical and mental health. The event includes races of 8 km, 4 km, and a children's race of 1 km, mainly targeting beginners and casual athletes who want to exercise in nature with their friends. The race is part of the global running celebration, encouraging participation of families and friends without competition. The start takes place in the afternoon of Saturday, June 6, 2026, at the Agia beach.
course_highlights: 8 km and 4 km routes along Agia beach with start and finish at the benches in the park opposite the kiosk
Children's race of 1 km with a dirt track and minimal elevation changes within the park
Friendly route for beginners and casual athletes in a natural environment
additional: The children's race starts 300 meters before the finish line and features a dirt track with minimal slopes. The race is part of the global events of World Running Day and mainly targets beginners and casual athletes who want to exercise in nature with friends. Organized in collaboration with the Municipality of Patras, it includes 8 km, 4 km, and a children's race of 1 km, dirt paths, and medal and trophy awards.

name: 1ο Vlasti Wind Trail
description: The Vlasti Wind Trail race is a distinctive mountain running event held in the natural environment of Vlasti Kozani. It combines athletic experience with the promotion of harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, emphasizing Renewable Energy Sources and sustainable development. The event is a celebration of sustainability and local collaboration, supporting the local community and highlighting the value of clean energy. The routes offer a unique experience in a beautiful natural landscape, with respect for the environment and local tradition.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with positive elevation gain +500 m (21 km) and +250 m (9 km)
Natural environment of the wider Vlasti Kozani area
Emphasis on harmonious coexistence with nature and Renewable Energy Sources
additional: Registration desk operation 08:30 - 09:30. Mandatory passage through all control stations. Provision of commemorative medal, refreshments at aid stations, dinner the night before and after the race. Medical coverage and photography coverage throughout. Littering outside designated points and damaging flora or disturbing fauna are prohibited. There is an organized camping area near the start with respect for nature. The race includes routes in mountainous terrain, with safety provisions and rules, and is a celebration of sustainability and local collaboration.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας
description: The 2nd Kourouta Running Race 2026 invites runners to run on a route where the road meets the wave, offering a unique view of the Aegean. The race includes distances of 10 km, 4.3 km, and a children's race of 1,000 meters, with electronic timing and a collectible medal for all finishers. The organization provides medical coverage by the Red Cross and traffic safety by the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. The start and award ceremonies take place at the Central Square of Kourouta, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km route with a view of the Aegean
Children's race of 1,000 meters for elementary and middle school students
Electronic timing (chip) and collectible finish medal
additional: Awards are approximately at 11:00 at the Central Square of Kourouta. Medical support by the Red Cross. Traffic coverage by the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. Participation of children with a parent/guardian responsible statement. Participation packs can be picked up on Saturday in Amaliada and Sunday in Kourouta from early morning. Three different events: 10 km, 4.3 km, and children's 1 km. Awards will be given after the race, with cups for the top three men and women in the 10 km. The route is paved, with a small dirt section, and the start and finish are located at the central square of Kourouta.

name: 2o Sykourio Trail
organizer: Δήμος Τεμπών και ο Σύλλογος Εμποροβιοτεχνών Συκουρίου
description: The 2nd Sykourio Trail race is a mountain running event organized in the Sykourio area of the Municipality of Tempi, Kissavos, on June 7, 2026. It includes three routes of varying difficulty and length, crossing trails, dirt roads, and asphalt, offering a comprehensive mountain running experience. The race is open to runners of all ages, with a special route for children within the settlement. The organization ensures electronic timing, feeding stations, and hydration during the race and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Trails on paths, dirt roads, and asphalt
Positive elevation gain of 1200m for the main 21 km route
Children's race 1 km within Sykourio settlement
additional: Registration opens on March 28, 2026, and closes on June 1, 2026. Participation includes a BIB or electronic timing chip number, feeding stations, and hydration during the race and at the finish. Participation is only individual, and payment is made exclusively by credit or debit card online. Public online registration from March 28 to June 1, 2026, includes bib/chip number, feeding stations, and technical briefing. The routes have different difficulty levels and require preparation according to the distance.

name: 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος
description: The 4th Sykaireios Road Race is a running event held in Kryoneri, Attica on Sunday, June 7, 2026. It offers two distances, 15 km and 5.5 km, with start and finish at the Gate of the Municipal Unit of Kryoneri. The race is open to runners of various ages and provides commemorative medals to all finishers, as well as awards to the top men and women. The organization emphasizes safety and support for runners with refreshment stations along the route.
course_highlights: 15 km route with a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes
5.5 km route with a time limit of 1 hour and 15 minutes
Refreshment stations with water and isotonic drinks approximately every 3 km on the longer route
additional: Packet pickup is on race day from 07:00 at the start-finish area. The race has a participation limit of 250 for the 15 km and 200 for the 5.5 km. Prizes are awarded to the top three men and women overall in each distance. The race takes place in the morning, starting at 07:20, and includes scenic routes through beautiful areas of the region.

name: 4ο Argithea Mountain Race
description: The 4th Argithea Mountain Race is a demanding mountain race held in the Petritou area, Karditsa, on June 7, 2026. It includes various routes such as the Argithea Skyrace 30 km with 2000 meters of elevation gain, the Vlachogiannis race 15 km with 700 meters ascent, as well as a family race 5 km and a children's race 1 km. There is also the Lakos Vertical route 3.6 km with 700 meters of ascent offering a unique experience on trails within a fir forest with views of the peaks of the Agrams. The race attracts runners who love the mountain and challenge, while also offering activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Argithea Skyrace 30 km with 2000 meters of elevation gain
Vlachogiannis Race 15 km with 700 meters ascent
Lakos Vertical 3.6 km with 700 meters continuous ascent within a fir forest
additional: The Lakos Vertical route starts from the settlement of Vasilades and continues uphill through old cobblestone paths and trails with drinking water. The finish line is located at Tsoutes at an altitude of 1750 meters with views of the Aforismeni, Karagounis, and Delidim peaks. There are also races for families and children, as well as hiking and mountain biking activities. It includes mountain running races, vertical race, family and children's routes, and activities on natural trails and landscapes of the Thessalian Agrams.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare
description: The 5th Aqua Mare Running Race is organized in Megara, starting and finishing at Vareas Beach, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar. Participants can choose between two routes, 10 km and 5.3 km, running alongside the sea on a beautiful seaside course. The event offers a pleasant athletic experience with free transportation and a collectible t-shirt for runners. The start is early in the morning, creating a day full of adrenaline and relaxation.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and 5.3 km along the sea
Start and finish at Vareas Beach Megara in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar
Seaside scenery with views of the waves
additional: Free bus transportation for athletes from Aigaleo to Megara and back. Departure at 07:15 a.m. from Davaki Square (Aigaleo) and return at 2:00 p.m. from Megara. Additional option to purchase a collectible t-shirt for 8 euros. Registration until June 2, 2026. Free bus transfer from Aigaleo. Participation is only for adults with a medical certificate. Includes timing chip, medal, water, and optional t-shirt.

name: 6ο Raches Run
description: The 6th Raches Run - Agroinvest is a sporting event organized by the Interactive Association of Raches ALOPI on the Raches Beach in Fthiotida. It includes races of 10,000 meters, 5,000 meters, and 1,000 meters for children, promoting sports and social solidarity. The race highlights the beauty and history of the area while strengthening participants' connection to the village and the local community.
course_highlights: Races of 10,000m, 5,000m, and 1,000m for children
Held at Raches Beach in Fthiotida
Promotion of cultural heritage and local development
additional: The routes are safe, marked with signage and ribbons, and the event takes place in warm summer weather. There is no specific information about participation fees.

name: 6ο Vamvakou Mountain Run
description: The 6th Vamvakou Mountain Run, which will take place on June 7, 2026, is a mountain running race offering a unique experience through the authentic trails of the Lakonic Parnonas. With three routes of 29, 19, and 7 kilometers, the race combines physical challenge, changing landscapes, and the warm hospitality of the revived village of Vamvakou. Organized under the supervision of runner and coach Ioannis Dimopoulos, it is part of the Vamvakou Revival initiative and supported by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation. The race is open to runners of all levels and offers electronic timing, medals, awards, and prize draws.
course_highlights: Three routes of 29 km (Elevation +1353m), 19 km (Elevation +800m), and 7 km (Elevation +385m)
Trails through firs, pines, gorges, and open horizons
Start and finish at the Vamvakou square, at an altitude of 950 meters
additional: Limited number of participants (200). All participants receive a race number, timing chip, commemorative T-shirt, medal, and a light meal at the finish line. Electronic timing is available on all routes. Awards for the top 3 men and women in each route and age categories. Prize draws for one lucky participant per route. Transportation from Athens and Kalamata is available. A pasta party and activities for children are organized. Trail running, mountain terrain, multiple race distances, organized by non-profit, support from SNF, registration open until 31/05/2026.

name: Artemida Sunset Run
location: Δημοτικό Γήπεδο Αρτέμιδος, Σπάτα, East Attica, Greece
description: The Artemida Sunset Run is the first running race organized in Artemida, offering 5 and 10 kilometer routes at sunset. The routes are predefined and marked on public roads, with start and finish at the Artemida Municipal Stadium. The event includes electronic timing, participation medals, a race shirt, and awards in each age category. The race is open to runners aged 15 and above, with a total participation limit of 300 runners for both distances.
course_highlights: Route along the coastal front with turnaround point at the chapel at the junction with Andros
Designated route on public roads with two laps for the 10,000 meters
Water supply stations and electronic timing at two points
additional: Pick up timing chip and race shirt from the Spata Municipal Stadium before race day. Participation limit of 300 runners for the 5,000 and 10,000 meter distances. Completion time limit of 40 minutes for 5,000 meters and 70 minutes for 10,000 meters. There is a personal item storage area and an ambulance with medical coverage throughout the race. The race includes events and participation distribution from the Municipal Stadium, with entries since 2009 and older. Participation is limited, with starts at 19:00 and 19:05, and includes a medal, shirt, and refreshment stations.

name: Kilkis Trail
description: The Kilkis Trail race is organized by the Kilkis Health Runners Club and offers a variety of routes, including the main 20-kilometer trail, a 4.8 km health walk, a 4x4 relay race, and a 1 km children's race. The Kilkis Trail course runs on trails and dirt roads around the city of Kilkis, with gentle slopes and technical sections, covering an elevation gain of approximately 850 meters. The start and finish are at the Kilkis Summer Cinema, providing a beautiful and challenging experience for runners. The race takes place on Sunday, June 7, 2026, and is open to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 20 km route on trails and dirt roads with 850 meters of elevation gain
Technical trails requiring attention and experience
Start and finish at the Kilkis Summer Cinema
additional: The Kilkis Trail route is marked with signs, ribbons, and indicators. The completion time for Kilkis Trail is set at 13:00, 3.5 hours after the start. Bib pickup is on Saturday, 17/6 at the Town Hall square and on Sunday, 18/6 at the starting point from 7:30 a.m. until 15 minutes before the race. There are coffee and food shops near the start/finish area. Registration includes detailed information about the routes and schedule, emphasizing community and health.

name: 5ο CHOLOMON TRAIL
description: The 5th Cholomon Trail mountain race is organized by the Halkidiki Runners and Walkers Club "Ypsizon" and offers three routes of 10, 21, and 50 kilometers through the dense forest of Mount Cholomon. The routes cross trails with majestic trees and natural landscapes of unparalleled beauty, providing a unique mountain running experience. There is also the possibility of free participation for those who donate blood to the club's blood bank. The race is supported by the Regional Unit of Halkidiki, the Municipality of Polygyros, and the Polygyros Forest Service.
course_highlights: 50 km with over 2,800 meters of elevation, 1 km asphalt, 10 km dirt road, 39 km trail
Time limit of 12 hours with a cutoff at 6 hours at the 30.5 km station
Water, isotonic drinks, and snacks available during the race
additional: Free participation for those who donate blood to the club's blood bank (valid for 10 and 21 km). Group registrations of 10 people with a 5 euro discount for 50 and 21 km and 2 euros for 10 km. All runners of the 50 km receive a mountain backpack, technical t-shirt, and commemorative medal. Payment must be made within 3 days of registration, no later than 28/05/2026. Three different route lengths, mountain running races, start and finish in Polygyros, Halkidiki, with a 12-hour time limit for completion.

name: Vamvakou Mountain Run
description: The 6th Vamvakou Mountain Run, which will take place on June 7, 2026, invites runners of all levels to discover the rhythm of the mountain through three routes of 29, 19, and 7 kilometers. The course starts from the square of Vamvakou and ascends to an altitude of up to 1900 meters, offering a unique experience in one of the most authentic mountain landscapes of the Peloponnese. The race combines athletic competition with an escape from urban pace, while the organization includes electronic timing, medals, prizes, and raffles. The event is part of the Vamvakou Revival initiative and is supported by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation.
course_highlights: Routes of 29, 19, and 7 kilometers with elevation differences of +1353m, +800m, and +385m respectively
Running on trails through forests of firs and pines, alongside gorges and open horizons
Start and finish at the square of Vamvakou at an altitude of 950 meters
additional: All participants receive a participation number, timing chip, personal item bag, commemorative T-shirt, and medal, as well as a light meal at the finish line. The organization includes electronic timing on all routes, awards for the top overall and age category positions, and raffles with prizes for lucky participants. The start times for the 29 km and 19 km routes are at 09:30, while the 7 km route starts at 10:00. The race has a participation limit of 200 people per route and requires online registration and payment. Three routes (7 km, 19 km, 29 km), participation via online registration, free transportation from Athens and Kalamata, activities for companions and children, registration deadline is 31/05/2026.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Βουφράδος
description: The 5th Boufrados Race, organized by the Cultural Association of Hatzí 'Anagennisi' in collaboration with the Municipality of Messini and the Messini Sports Club, includes running and power walking races of 20 and 5 kilometers as well as a 1500-meter race. The routes are semi-mountainous and pass around the area of the village of Hatzí in Messinia, highlighting natural beauty and forgotten settlements. The purpose of the event is to promote physical activity and improve quality of life through physical and mental health. The start and finish are at the central square of Hatzí, creating a friendly and warm environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Semi-mountainous routes around the village of Hatzí in Messinia
Passing through natural routes and forgotten settlements
Start and finish at the central square of Hatzí
additional: Event schedule: 15:00 opening of the registration desk for race material delivery at the central square of Hatzí. 17:30 start of the 20 km race, 17:45 start of the 5 km race, 17:50 start of the 1.5 km race. 20:30 end of finishes, 20:40 awards to the winners at the central square of Hatzí. 21:00 energy recovery with traditional products at the central square. Organized in collaboration with the Municipality of Messini and local associations, aiming to promote sports and social cohesion.

name: 5ο Livadia Night Run
description: The 5th Livadia Night Run is a night running event held in Livadeia, near the Erkinas springs in the Krya area. The race includes three distances: 10 km main race, 5 km, and 1 km for students, covering all ages and levels of runners. The start is at 20:00 and timing is done with an electronic chip by CHRONOLOG. The race is organized by the Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia in collaboration with the Municipality of Livadeia, offering a local athletic experience in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: Night race with start at 20:00
Routes of 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km near the Erkinas springs
Electronic timing with chip from CHRONOLOG
additional: Race packs are collected from the Tholoto hall next to the start. For the 10 km, registered athletes from SEGAS clubs and independent runners aged 17 and above can participate. The weather in June is warm with an average temperature of 32°C and humidity, making the nighttime start ideal. The organization attracts runners from the entire region and offers a unique running experience in a nighttime environment, with participation from both registered athletes and amateurs.

name: 5ο Olympic Day Run
description: The 5th Olympic Day Run in Ancient Olympia is a unique and official Olympic running event that honors Greece as the birthplace of the Olympic Games. The race brings together Olympians, Paralympians, and distinguished athletes, creating a large Olympic running team. The event includes races of 8,000 meters, 4,000 meters, and 1,500 meters, with routes passing through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia, offering a unique athletic and cultural experience. The event is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Olympic Committee and other important organizations, aiming to highlight the Olympic heritage.
course_highlights: Routes within the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia
Start and finish at the Municipality of Ancient Olympia
Course along the Alfios River and the provincial road
additional: The races include distances of 8,000m, 4,000m, and 1,500m. The event combines athletic, educational, and cultural activities with high aesthetic and safety standards. The organization is carried out by the Hellenic Olympic Committee, the International Olympic Academy, the Thessaloniki Olympic Museum, and the Municipality of Ancient Olympia. It includes information about routes, registrations, sponsors, and volunteers. The event promotes sports and culture in Greece, specifically in Ancient Olympia.

name: 16ος Ανδάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 16th Andaneios Race of 17,000 meters will take place on Saturday, June 13, 2026, starting from the Arcadian Gate of Ancient Messene and finishing in Diavolitsi. Simultaneously, there will be 5,000-meter races and a children's race of 1,000 meters. The event is part of a two-day program that includes activities related to Ancient Andania, hiking routes, and tours in the wider area, offering a comprehensive experience to participants. The Messinia Health Runners Club welcomes all runners to live this unique athletic and cultural experience.
course_highlights: 17,000 m route from the Arcadian Gate of Ancient Messene to Diavolitsi
Parallel races of 5,000 m and a children's race of 1,000 m
Hiking routes and cultural events in the wider area
additional: The races are held within a two-day event (June 13 & 14) with parallel cultural and hiking activities. Contact phone: 6942553154 (Thymios Alexopoulos). The event includes routes of 17,000 m, 5,000 m, and 1,000 m for children, a cycling route, cultural activities, and outdoor events, with free participation.

name: Ιεράπετρα City Run in Stadium Vol 6
location: Vouzounerekeio Δημοτικό Στάδιο, Ιεράπετρα, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
description: The Ierapetra City Run in Stadium Vol 6 is an evening road race held inside the Vouzounerekeio Municipal Stadium in Ierapetra, Crete. The race is organized by the Ierapetra Health Runners Club in collaboration with the Region of Crete and offers officially timed races with a lively stadium atmosphere, music, lights, and refreshments. The program includes a 400-meter children's race, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a mixed relay 4 x 800 meters. Participants enjoy a unique experience inside the stadium with support and awards for the best runners.
course_highlights: Evening race inside Vouzounerekeio Municipal Stadium
Officially timed races with chip timing
Music, lights, water, refreshments, and souvlaki for participants
additional: Includes a 400 m children's race, a 5 km race in two heats, a 10 km race for ages 18+, and a mixed relay 4 x 800 m with two men and two women per team. All races except the children's race have chip timing. The weather in June is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 32°C and a low of 20°C, and an average rainfall of 25mm. The event features a children's race, medals, T-shirts, snacks, music, and food. The event takes place indoors, with expected warm and humid weather.

name: 8ο Γράμμος Mountain Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή για τον αγώνα 21km είναι 25€

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή για τον αγώνα 10km είναι 15€

description: The 8th Grammos Mountain Run is a demanding mountain running race held in the beautiful region of Mastorohoria, in the village of Plikati, Konitsa Municipality. It includes two routes, 21 km and 10 km, starting and finishing at the village square. The 21 km route runs along the ridge of the Grammos mountain range with a total elevation gain of over 1680 meters, offering a unique experience for runners in good physical condition and with mountain running experience. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. for the 21 km and at 10:30 a.m. for the 10 km, with full support and amenities for participants.
course_highlights: Circular route along the ridge of the Grammos mountain range
Elevation gain of over 1680 meters for the 21 km
Start and finish at the village square of Plikati
additional: The electronic timing is done with a chip. A commemorative medal, water, fruits, and snacks are provided at aid stations, along with medical services during and after the race. The maximum allowed time for the 21 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes. There is a 'sweep' following the last runner for support and safety. In case of adverse weather conditions, organizers reserve the right to modify or cancel parts of the route. The race takes place on mountain trails, with registrations via an external link, and includes a time limit of 5 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Ημιμαραθώνιος Δολιανών
description: The 10th Mountain Half Marathon of Doliana, which will take place on Sunday, June 14, 2026, in Ano Doliana, Arcadia, offers a challenging and beautiful mountain half marathon route of 21.076 meters with significant elevation changes. Runners will enjoy uphill and downhill sections with steep gradients, in a natural environment reaching altitudes of up to 1303 meters. The event emphasizes participant safety and provides support with a physiotherapist at the finish line, while a photographer will be present at various points along the route. Results will be announced on the official race website.
course_highlights: Mountain half marathon 21.076 km with approximately 808 m positive and negative elevation change
Maximum altitude 1303 m with uphill and downhill sections with steep gradients (+28.9% and -31.1%)
Route with 50% uphill and 47.8% downhill sections, in a natural mountain environment
additional: Physiotherapist at the finish line for recovery. Photographer at the start, finish, and at points along the route. Runner safety with volunteers-rescuers along the course. Bib number for judges' convenience. The route includes elevation differences and technical variations in water supply and infrastructure. There are hydration points, and the participation time limit is 4.5 hours. Entries open through the official website.

name: 13ος Δρόμος Σέιχ Σου
description: The 13th Seich Sou Road is a mountain running race organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners Club. The routes include 10 km, 16 km, and a popular 3 km road, within the Seich Sou suburban forest of Thessaloniki. The purpose of the race is to familiarize citizens with the natural environment and promote exercise and forest protection. The event is supported by O.M.A.K. Kalamarias and offers an opportunity for gentle mountain running in a natural and historic setting.
course_highlights: Area: Seich Sou suburban forest of Thessaloniki
Routes: 10 km, 16 km, and a popular 3 km road
Gentle mountain running in a natural environment
additional: The race is organized with the support of O.M.A.K. Kalamarias. The aim of the event is to familiarize participants with the suburban forest, to introduce them to the challenges of mountain running, and to promote the protection of the natural environment. The Thessaloniki Health Runners Club was founded in 1993 and promotes popular mass sports, exercise for health, and sports education. It is scheduled for Sunday, June 14, 2026, with participation in different routes and support from local authorities, aiming to foster connection with the forest and promote outdoor exercise.

name: 1ο Chios Night Run
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: The 1st Chios Night Run is a night running race held at the central port of Chios. The course offers a unique running experience with refreshment stations every 2.5 kilometers and an official technical race t-shirt. After the finish, participants enjoy a party with hot dogs and a music festival, creating a festive atmosphere for all runners and spectators. The race includes age categories and a special category for security forces and armed forces.
course_highlights: Location: Central Port of Chios
Refreshment stations every 2.5 kilometers
Official technical race t-shirt
additional: Party with hot dogs and a music festival after the race. Age categories: 15-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+ with awards for the top 1-2-3. Special category for security forces and armed forces. Participation includes chip timing, technical T-shirt, medal, water, and snacks. The route is urban and nocturnal, starting and finishing at the central port of Chios. Early start is recommended due to hot and humid weather.

name: 2ο Φεστιβάλ Αθλητισμού Δυτικής Μάνης
price_range: 10 ευρώ ανά αγώνα, δωρεάν για τους παιδικούς αγώνες
description: The 2nd Western Mani Sports Festival is a two-day athletic event held in Stoupa Messinia, by the sea. It includes open water swimming at distances of 0.5 km, 1 km, and 2 km, running, children's races, and aquathlon. The 500-meter route is triangular with electronic timing and awards, and all participants receive a medal, bib, swim cap, technical T-shirt, and local products. The event is organized by the Municipality of Western Mani and proceeds support the volunteer association West Mani GAIA.
course_highlights: Open water swimming in front of Stoupa beach
Triangular 500-meter route with one right turn
Different color swim cap for each distance
additional: Participants under 18 years old need written parental consent. There are free children's races and aquathlon with running and swimming. Each participant receives bib, swim cap, technical T-shirt, and local products. The start of the swimming distances is early in the afternoon. The weather in June is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 32°C and humidity, so a morning start is recommended. Races on sea and mountain/asphalt trails, participation of children and adults, awards and distinctions, environmentally friendly and cultural activities.

name: 9ο Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου»
description: The Koufalia Hill Run "Dimitra Jordanidou" is a distinctive event that combines the natural beauty of the Koufalia hill with athletic challenge. It includes 6 and 10 kilometer routes mainly on dirt trails within a pine forest, with ascents and descents offering unique views such as the monastery of Grigorios Palamas and the Gavana cave. The race has a family character, with parallel events for children and parents, and aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the local community. The event honors the memory of Dimitra Jordanidou, who inspired the race and established it as a tradition.
course_highlights: Dirt trails with paths within a pine forest
Passing by the monastery of Grigorios Palamas
Technically demanding points with ascents and descents, view of the Gavana cave
additional: The race includes parallel events for children and parents, as well as a parent-child race and a race for people with disabilities with a companion. The start and finish are at the tennis courts of the Koufalia Tennis Club. The 10km and 6km routes share common sections and feature steep ascents and descents, natural obstacles, and technical points. The event is supported by local authorities and volunteers. It takes place in the peri-urban forest of Koufalia, emphasizing community and the natural environment. There are options for different levels and ages, and the event promotes outdoor sports and family participation.

name: 10ο Πέρασμα Του Αποστόλου Παύλου
organizer: Δημο Πυδνας Κολινδρου και Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΥΓΕΣ»
description: The 10th Anniversary Running Race "The Passage of Apostle Paul" is organized by the Holy Metropolis of Kitrus, Katerini, and Platamonas, the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros, and the Athletic Cultural Club of N. Pieria "Zeus". The race covers a distance of 10,000 meters and takes place on a paved route passing through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos. The start is from the Holy Church of Apostle Paul in the central square of Methoni, and the finish is at Ancient Pydna. It is a beautiful route with small ascents and descents, marked along its entire length.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt
Passes through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos
Start from the Holy Church of Apostle Paul, finish at Ancient Pydna
additional: The race is under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Folk Mass Sports and Ultra-distance Races. Cultural clubs and local organizations participate. Runners of all distances and sports enthusiasts are invited to run or walk the route. It takes place on June 20, 2026, with start and finish at Ancient Pydna, and includes cultural and athletic activities.

name: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience
description: The Beyond Kerkini Running Experience is a unique running race held at Limanaki Lithotopou, next to Lake Kerkini. It offers routes that combine different landscapes and terrains, from flat asphalt paths to challenging mountain trails. Each route provides a distinctive visual experience of the area's natural beauty, with the opportunity to run among water bodies and landscapes that change from dawn to sunset. The event also includes free activities for families and children, making it a full-day sports experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Routes extending from the western side to the eastern embankment of Lake Kerkini
Combination of mountain, dirt, and asphalt on different routes
Running experience among majestic water bodies and the lake
additional: Free activities for children and families on Saturday. Free bus transportation. Technical T-shirts and a collectible finisher medal for each race. Chip timing and athlete BIB. Provision of Maurten energy gels and a light meal. Medical coverage and rescue team available. Changing rooms, showers, and storage area. Free photographic material. Hydration and feeding stations along the route. Includes free bus transfer, routes covering different difficulty levels, and a sports celebration in a magical natural environment.

description: The 3rd Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run invites you to discover the wild and unspoiled beauty of the Pindus Mountains through three impressive routes. The races offer a unique mountain running experience with fir-covered slopes, waterfalls, alpine peaks, and scenic trails. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers to the sport, featuring electronic timing, refreshment stations, and transportation to and from the city of Agrinio. Experience the mountain's magic and create unforgettable memories.
course_highlights: Routes with fir-covered slopes and alpine peaks
Passing through scenic trails and waterfalls
Elevation gain of 1030 meters in the 21 km race
additional: The timing is done electronically with a chip. There is free bus transportation to and from the cities of Agrinio and Antirrio (until capacity is reached). Participant numbers and athlete packages are handed over at the registration desk up to 30 minutes before the start. Runners of the 21 km and 8 km races receive a technical dry fit shirt, a commemorative medal, a surprise running accessory, and a bag with local products. The event takes place on June 21, 2026. Registrations open from March 2026. Transportation options from Agrinio and Antirrio are available. Official merchandise is also available.

price_range: 10€ για μη κατοίκους, δωρεάν για κατοίκους

description: The 3rd Galatsi Night Run is a nighttime running event held in Galatsi, Athens, with start and finish at the Galatsi Olympic Indoor Hall - PALI. The 5 km route runs along the main road of the city, Vekou Avenue, and there is also a 1 km children's race within the premises of the Galatsi Olympic Indoor Hall - PALI. The event promotes citizen participation in sports and physical activity, emphasizing safety and an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Night race of 5 km on the main road Vekou Avenue
Children's race of 1 km within the premises of the Galatsi Olympic Indoor Hall - PALI
Safe and circular route for children without vehicles
additional: Participants can collect their race packet on Saturday, June 20 (10:00 - 15:00) and Sunday, June 21 (10:00 - 13:00) at the PALI venue. Residents and citizens of Galatsi participate for free. The start for the children's race is at 20:40 and for the 5 km race at 20:55. There will be awards for the top three overall finishers and medals for all participants. The race includes online registration, participation packet, medical coverage, and a participation limit of 1500 adults and 200 children.

name: 5ο Orestis Run
description: The 5th Orestis Running Race in Orestiada is a sporting event that attracts runners and sports enthusiasts from the region. The race offers an opportunity to participate in an organized route within the city, promoting health and athletic activity. The organization is friendly and open to everyone, aiming to strengthen the local community and promote sports. The event has established itself as an important athletic moment for the Orestiada area.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and possibly other distances
Participants from Greece and Bulgaria
Organized in a scenic area of Orestiada
additional: The race is an important sporting event in the region, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community.

name: Go Florina – Run The City Experience
location: Φλώρινα, Δήμος Φλώρινας, Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Φλώρινας, Ελλάδα
description: The Municipality of Florina and GoEvents organize the two-day running races GO FLORINA - RUN THE CITY, a sports and cultural event that combines athletics with the beauty of the city of Florina. The races take place on June 20 & 21, starting and ending at Georgios Moudis Square. Runners of all ages and levels are invited to participate in routes within the city and along the Sakouleva River, enjoying the unique atmosphere of the area. The routes include 10 km, 5 km, a 3 km night race, and a 1 km participatory race for families and children.
course_highlights: Dynamic urban route of 10 kilometers within the city of Florina starting from the village of Simos Ioannidis
Beautiful 5-kilometer route along the Sakouleva River beside water and greenery
Night race of 3 kilometers in the city center with music and lighting in a festive atmosphere
additional: The races start and finish at Georgios Moudis Square. Participation is allowed from 18 years and above, while those under 18 require a parental or guardian responsible statement. Medals are awarded to all participants and prizes to the top three in each age and gender category. Organized with an emphasis on urban exploration and family participation, with multiple routes and events in a welcoming environment.

name: 25ο «Στα Χνάρια του Απόστολου Παύλου»
description: The 25th Running Race and Power Walking 'In the Footsteps of Apostle Paul' is organized by the Municipality of Corinth and symbolically revives the route followed by Apostle Paul in the area. The race takes place on Sunday, June 21, 2026, starting from the ancient port of Kechries and ending at the central square of Ancient Corinth. The route is 11.4 kilometers long and includes three support stations along the way. It is a historical and cultural route that combines sports and tradition.
course_highlights: 11.4 km route from the ancient port of Kechries to Ancient Corinth
Three support stations along the route
Symbolic reenactment of Apostle Paul's journey
additional: The route map is available through the event's online platform (Google My Maps). Organized with local festive events, traffic regulation by the police, and medical coverage from Corinth Hospital. All finishers receive a technical T-shirt and participate in the race.

name: SNF Nostos Run
description: The SNF Nostos Run 2026 is a beloved evening running event organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, returning on June 23 to celebrate the 30 years of its philanthropic activities. The race includes routes of 10 km, 6 km, and 1 km for Special Olympics athletes, starting from the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center. The organization emphasizes offering and solidarity, as SNF will donate three times the total amount raised from registrations to support non-profit organizations. During the course, participants will enjoy music from percussion bands and a DJ set at the finish line, while official timing is provided but the race is non-competitive.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and 6 km starting from the Panathenaic Stadium and ending at the SNFCC
1 km route for Special Olympics athletes
Music accompaniment from Batala and Quilombo percussion bands and a DJ set at the finish line
additional: The race is non-competitive but features official timing. The event is organized in collaboration with the NGO “Anagennisi & Proodos” under the scientific supervision of Sports Excellence - the Department of Athletic Excellence of the First Orthopedic Surgery Clinic of EKPA. SNF will donate three times the total registration amount to support non-profit organizations Lapsi and Pnoi Agapis. Technical routes in an urban environment, with a focus on charitable action and supporting organizations for children with cancer and cancer patients, including a special 1 km route for Special Olympics athletes.

name: 2ο Silk City Run
description: The 2nd Silk City Run in Soufli is a running race that invites amateur and experienced runners, families, and young people to enjoy a unique route within the city of silk. Running through the streets of Soufli is not just a race, but a journey towards a healthier, more balanced, and creative lifestyle. The Municipality of Soufli warmly welcomes all participants, offering an opportunity for renewal and energy.
course_highlights: Route within the city of Soufli, known as the city of silk
Friendly environment for amateurs and experienced runners
Opportunity for families and young people to participate in a sporting event
additional: Routes of 5 and 10 km, electronic timing, refreshment station, participation over 18 years old

name: 11ες Ορεινές Διαδρομές Βοριτσίου
description: The 11th Boritsio Mountain Runs is a mountain running race held in Boritsi, Heraklion, Crete on June 27, 2026. The event offers different routes with beautiful natural landscapes and a variety of terrains, ideal for runners who love adventure and mountain nature. The event is an opportunity for athletes and nature enthusiasts to enjoy the beauty of Crete through an organized and welcoming athletic experience.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with natural landscapes
Variety of terrains and trails
Routes suitable for different levels of runners
additional: Trail races include Tsikoudia trail, Lagoudera, Boritsani Relay. The route is likely mountainous and technical, with many options for participants and detailed instructions available.

name: 22ος Olympus Marathon
description: The Olympus Marathon is a unique 44-kilometer mountain running race with a positive elevation gain of +3350 meters, held on the mythical Mount Olympus. The route starts from the archaeological site of Dion and follows trails through forests, alpine meadows, and peaks, reaching Litochoro. The race honors the ancient tradition of pilgrims who ascended Olympus to honor Zeus, offering a unique experience for runners following the footsteps of history on the mountain of gods. It is a certified SKYRUNNING race and presents a challenge for experienced mountain runners.
course_highlights: 44 kilometers with +3350 meters positive elevation
Route from the archaeological site of Dion to Litochoro
Passing through alpine meadows, beech forests, and Olympus peaks
additional: The route includes three feeding and hydration stations, a runner's packet with a gift, pasta-party on the Friday before the race, a medal for finishers, and transportation from Litochoro. The race has a time limit of 12 hours and requires prior experience in mountain races. Technical support, first aid, and volunteers are available throughout the course. It includes parallel races such as Olympus Ultra 71 km, Olympus Vertical 4 km, Melindra Trail 5 km, and the Eagle's Peak 14 km. Registrations open in February 2026, with discounts for early registration. The event combines sport, nature, and tradition.

name: Porto Heli Night Run
location: Παραλία του Πόρτο Χέλι, Πόρτο Χέλι, Αργολίδας, Greece
description: The Municipality of Ermionida and the Municipal Community of Porto Cheli invite you to the grand sports celebration "Porto Heli Night Run" which will take place on Saturday, June 27, 2026. The race is dedicated to the memory of Minos Kyriakou and includes routes for everyone, from an 11 km trail run and 5 km night run, to children's races and an event for people with disabilities. Each participant will receive a commemorative t-shirt and medal, offering a unique athletic experience in the beautiful Porto Cheli.
course_highlights: 11 km Trail Run in natural environment
5 km Night Run with atmospheric lighting
Children's races 500m and 1,000m, as well as a 300m event for people with disabilities
additional: Commemorative t-shirt and medal for all participants. Multiple routes and categories, with registrations until 24/06/2026, medals and t-shirts for all participants.

name: 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Κακολύρι 1944
organizer: Δήμος Κύμης – Αλιβερίου και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ταξιαρχών
description: The 4th Thysia Race "Kakolyri 1944" is a running event that honors the memory of the victims of the Holocaust in the village of Taxiarches in 1944. It is organized by the Municipality of Kymi - Aliveri and the Cultural Association of Taxiarches, with support from local cultural groups and communities. It includes a half marathon of 21 km, a 5 km race, and a children's race of 1.2 km, with routes passing through historic villages and natural landscapes. The race offers electronic timing, commemorative medals and t-shirts, as well as full support with refreshment stations and medical coverage.
course_highlights: Half marathon 20.8 km circular route passing through the villages Pygros, Andronianoi, Taxiarches, Giannides, Agios Vlasis, and Konistres
Refreshment stations with water and electrolytes at multiple points along the route
Routes combining trails, dirt roads, and settlements of historical and natural interest
additional: Electronic timing by Fitrace. Commemorative medal and dry fit t-shirt for all athletes. 7 water stations in the half marathon and 2 stations in the 5 km race. Provision of water, fruits, soft drinks, and salty snacks at the finish line. Medical coverage with a doctor, EKAB ambulance, and volunteer rescuers. Support from volunteer groups and associations. The event includes technical descriptions, GPX route maps, historical information, participant details, and support from volunteers and organizations such as the Hellenic Red Cross and the Evia Runners Association.

name: Coast To Coast Run
description: The Coast to Coast Run in Ierapetra, Crete, is a half marathon race of 21.100 meters starting from Pachia Ammos beach and ending at Minos Square in Ierapetra, crossing the narrowest point of Crete with beautiful natural landscapes and the Gorge of Chara. Simultaneously, 5,000-meter races and a children's 1,000-meter race are organized in the city of Ierapetra. The race has a cultural and touristic character, offering a unique experience that connects the northern and southern coasts of Eastern Crete. The organization takes care of transportation for athletes and the safe conduct of the races.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.100 meters from Pachia Ammos beach in Ierapetra
Route crossing the narrowest point of Crete with views of the Gorge of Chara
Last 4 kilometers within the city of Ierapetra with views of the southern Cretan Sea
additional: Transportation for the half marathon athletes is provided by buses from Minos Square until 08:00 a.m. The 5,000-meter race and the Health & Power Walking 5,000-meter race start and finish at Minos Square. There is also a children's 1,000-meter race. The event includes various routes and activities, emphasizing the beauty of nature and social participation.

name: 8ο Skloupo Trail Run

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 8th Skloupo Trail Run is a trail race held in the picturesque Ampelohori (Skloupo) of the Municipality of Northern Tzoumerka. It includes three routes: 13.5 km, 5 km, and Kids Race 1 km, offering a unique experience through forests with firs and conifers, with steep ascents and descents. The course combines dirt trails and paved sections, with beautiful natural scenery and historic sites of the village. The race is open to runners of all ages, with special care for young participants.
course_highlights: 13.5 km route with 8.35 km of forest trail through fir and conifer forests
Significant positive elevation gain of 395 meters
Passage through historic sites and traditional paths of Ampelohori
additional: Participants receive a participation pack with a number and timing chip, safety pins, and a commemorative T-shirt. The maximum number of participants is 300 for the two main races and 50 for the Kids Race. There is a time limit of 2 hours for the 13.5 km and 1 hour for the 5 km. Throwing objects along the route is prohibited and strict regulations are enforced. Three routes, electronic timing, medical services, photographic coverage, commemorative T-shirt and medal, participation in the 1 km kids race.

name: 3ο Πολύλοφος Run
description: The 3rd Polylophos Run is organized by the Cultural Association of Polylophos Messinia in collaboration with the Municipality of Messini. It consists of running and power walking races on routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1000 meters around the community of Polylophos. The course is mixed, with asphalt and dirt, and the start and finish are at the central square of the local district. The purpose of the event is to encourage athletes and participants to engage in a natural activity that improves health and quality of life, highlighting the natural beauty of the area.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1000 m around the community of Polylophos
Mixed course with asphalt and dirt
Start and finish at the central square of Polylophos
additional: Event schedule: 17:30 opening of the registration desk for race packet pickup, 19:15 start of the 10 km race, 19:20 start of the 1000 m race, 19:30 start of the 5 km race, 20:45 end of finishers, 21:00 awards and refreshments with local products at the central square. Routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1000 m, races for all ages, running events, activities for students and adults, technical support, and prizes.

name: 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης
price_range: 12 € (5 χλμ, με μπλούζα), 15 € (10 χλμ, με μπλούζα), δωρεάν (παιδικός)
description: The 4th Night Race of Mytilene is a popular night running event held in the city of Mytilene. The 5 and 10 kilometer routes pass through the city's fabric, starting and finishing at Tsamakia, with a large part of the course passing through pedestrian streets to minimize traffic disturbance. The race is organized by the Lesvos Runners Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Mytilene and other local bodies, offering a unique running experience under the night sky. High participation and a warm atmosphere characterize the event, which has become a tradition for the island of Lesvos.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 kilometer route through the city of Mytilene
Start and finish at Tsamakia
Large part of the course on pedestrian streets for minimal traffic disturbance
additional: A children's 1 km race took place beforehand on the pedestrian street with children's participation. After the races, awards are given at the beach in Tsamakia. The event has technical support from Lesvos Ride and medical coverage from the Mytilene Hospital and other agencies. Collaboration with Traffic Police and Port Authority ensures traffic management. The race is under the auspices of the LESVOS SEGAS EAS. Participation includes online registration until July 9, 2026, and the event is part of the Lesvian Summer festivities. Participants can enjoy special offers on ferry tickets and run through the illuminated city streets.

name: 5ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Κουρκούλας
description: The 5th Night Race of Kourkoula is a special night running event of 5.5 and 11 kilometers held on Mount Kourkoula in Glykovrysi, Laconia. The race offers a unique experience where the light does not come from the sun but from the runners themselves, with a flashlight illuminating each step. The route combines sport with a sense of exploration and enjoyment of the moment, creating an almost mystical tranquility. It is a challenge for those who want to experience something different and enjoy the night with determination and energy.
course_highlights: Night route of 5.5 and 11 kilometers on Mount Kourkoula
Lighting only from runners' flashlights
Almost mystical tranquility and sense of exploration
additional: The race is organized by the Athletic Cultural Association Callisthenes and the Local Community of Glykovrysi, Municipality of Eurytus. The start is at 21:15 on the night of Saturday, July 11, 2026. The route requires the use of a flashlight for illumination. Routes of 5.5 and 11 kilometers, downhill race, 1-kilometer race for children, race on paved road, participation with cars in the organization, start from Old Kourkoula.

name: 15ος Faethon Skyrace
