description: The 15th Faethon Skyrace "Apostolos Tsoirekas" will take place on July 12, 2026, in Kokkino Pilo of Olympus. It is a demanding mountain running race offering two routes: the Faethon SkyRace 23 km with +1800m elevation gain in alpine terrain and the Faethon Trail 14 km with +400m, crossing historic paths and lush forests. The event also includes the children's race Faethonaki Run 1 km, giving children the opportunity to experience mountain running. The start is from the central square of the village Kokkino Pilo, and the organization embodies the vision and love for Olympus and mountain running.
course_highlights: Faethon SkyRace 23km with +1800m elevation gain in alpine terrain and peaks up to 2520m
Faethon Trail 14km with +400m, route through historic paths and green forests
Routes through high natural beauty trails in Olympus, with alpine passes and pristine forests
additional: The race has a finish time limit of 6 hours (until 14:00). There is an intermediate refreshment station at Diaselo Kardaara at 14 km and 2340m altitude with a crossing limit of 3.5 hours. Participation is allowed for individuals over 18 years old with mountain race experience of at least 15 km in the last 2 years. No medical certificate is required, but a responsible declaration must be signed. The event also includes the children's race Faethonaki Run 1 km, held on Saturday, July 11. Registrations open on April 15, 2026. The organization features mountain running, skyrunning, and routes with technical and natural terrain.

name: Faethon Skyrace
description: The Faethon Skyrace is a demanding mountain running race held on the mythical Olympus, in the Kokkino Pilos area. The 24-kilometer route with a +1800 meter elevation gain offers a unique experience through trails, alpine terrain, and peaks over 2000 meters. The race starts from the central square of the village and has a time limit of 6 hours, with intermediate refreshment stations. The event is aimed at experienced athletes with good physical condition and mountain race experience.
course_highlights: 24 km route with +1800m elevation gain
Trails and alpine terrain in western Olympus
Passage through the pristine forest of Kokkino Pilos and peaks over 2000m
additional: The race has a participation limit of 300 athletes. No medical certificate is required, but a responsible declaration must be signed. There is a 6-hour finish time limit with an intermediate station at Diaselo Kardaρα at 14 km (2340m altitude). Free shuttle bus service from Thessaloniki is provided for athletes. Organized with races of 23km, 14km, and 1km for children, with registrations via bank transfer and participation in a high-difficulty and naturally beautiful race. The start and finish are located in a historic area rich in natural and cultural heritage.

name: I Run Myrtos
description: The Cultural Association of Myrtos in collaboration with the Health Runners Association of Ierapetra organizes the running race I Run Myrtos, which includes routes of 12.2 kilometers, 5 kilometers, and a children's race of 750 meters. The race takes place at the square of Myrtos and offers electronic timing and feeding stations. The route is mainly asphalted and without significant elevation change, suitable for runners of all ages. The race has a friendly character with awards and commemorative medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the square of Myrtos
Routes of 12.2 km and 5 km without significant elevation change
Electronic timing and feeding stations on each route
additional: The children's race of 750 meters is free for children aged 6-12 with parental approval. The top three men and women overall and the first in each age category are awarded. There are separate age categories for men and women. The route includes feeding stations at specific kilometers. terrain: flat, registration: online until July 14, 2025, includes technical t-shirt, medals, water, medical support

name: Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR)
description: The Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR) race is the largest Greek mountain running event, offering a unique experience amidst the natural beauty and culture of the Zagori region. With routes crossing stone bridges, villages, and the impressive Vikos Gorge, runners have the opportunity to test their endurance on challenging trails with significant elevation changes. ZMR includes multiple routes, from 5 km for all to the two-day Challenge 93 km race, covering different levels of difficulty and experience. The organization is welcoming and professional, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: Routes with stone bridges and villages of Zagori
Impressive Vikos Gorge and Tymphis mountain range
Significant elevation changes and demanding trails
additional: The races start at different times depending on the route, with Challenge and TeRA starting at 05:00, Zagori Classic 33 km at 06:30, Half Marathon at 07:30, Forest 10 km at 08:45, Fun 5 km at 21:00, and ZAGORAKI Kids Race at 19:00. The Challenge race is two days (July 18-19, 2026) and includes a total of 93 km. There are special routes for children and runners of all levels. The organization provides support, supply stations, and strict regulations for participant safety. It includes races for children and adults, with registrations opening on March 27, 2026. Information on accommodation, regulations, and volunteering is available.

name: 15ο Zagori Mountain Running
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, 33 km, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Zagori Mountain Running race is the largest Greek mountain running event, offering a unique experience through the majestic landscapes of Zagori. The routes cross stone bridges, the Vikos Gorge, and the Tymphis mountain range, combining natural beauty with challenging terrain. With many route options, from 5 km to 93 km, the race caters to all preferences and runner levels. The organization is welcoming and well-organized, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: Stone arch bridges of Zagori
Impressive Vikos Gorge
Tymphis mountain range with significant elevation changes
additional: Multiple routes with different dates and start times: Challenge 93 km over 2 days (18-19/07/2026, 05:00 & 06:30), TeRA 60 km (18/07/2026, 05:00), Classic Race 33 km (19/07/2026, 06:30), Half Marathon 21 km (18/07/2026, 07:30), Forest 10 km (19/07/2026, 08:45), Fun 5 km (18/07/2026, 21:00), ZAGORAKI Kids Race (18/07/2026, 19:00). Registrations open on March 27, 2026, with entries also available for children's races and fun runs. The organization also includes information on accommodation and transportation in the area.

name: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού
description: Salt Road is a running race held in Messolonghi, offering routes of 10km, 5km, and 1000m. The organization emphasizes precise electronic timing and excellent organization, aiming to provide an unforgettable experience for runners from all over Greece. The race combines athletic spirit and local tradition, attracting participants of all ages and levels. The organization ensures immediate announcement of results and the provision of commemorative participation diplomas.
course_highlights: Routes of 10km, 5km, and 1000m
Accurate electronic timing with chip
Double start and finish gates 4 meters wide
additional: Registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the race start. Results are announced and posted immediately, 5-10 minutes after the race ends. Participants receive a commemorative electronic participation diploma with their individual results. The race announcer informs participants during the event. The race is a celebration of sports and the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the region's cultural heritage.

name: 10ο WAVE Running
description: The 10th WAVE Running returns dynamically on July 24-25, 2026, along the coast of Keramoti - Abdera, with the main base at Myrodato Beach in Xanthi. The anniversary event offers three routes of 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km within the unique natural environment of the Nestos Delta. Parallel activities highlight the character and philosophy of the event, such as beach cleaning, a local products exhibition, and musical events, creating a comprehensive celebration of sports, nature, and culture.
course_highlights: Three routes of 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km
Natural environment of the Nestos Delta
Main base at Myrodato Beach
additional: Parallel activities such as beach cleaning, a local products exhibition, and musical events that highlight the character and philosophy of the event. Routes of 5 km, 10 km, 28 km; natural environment, parallel activities, exhibitions, musical events

name: 2ο Oinousses Run
description: The 2nd Oinousses Run is a unique race that combines running and cycling on the enchanting island of Oinousses. The 13 km running route passes by the historic Evangelismos Monastery and offers spectacular views of Chios, while the 20 km cycling route makes a complete circuit of the island with gentle ascents and fast descents. Participants enjoy a beautiful experience amidst picturesque landscapes and seaside routes, with amenities such as electronic timing, a medal, commemorative T-shirt, and refreshment stations. The race is organized by the Chios Cyclists and the Municipality of Oinousses, providing a friendly and summery athletic event.
course_highlights: Seaside and traditional routes
Passing by the historic Evangelismos Monastery
Spectacular view of Chios
additional: The maximum number of participants is 150 athletes due to limited boat capacity. Race amenities include registration number, electronic timing, commemorative T-shirt, finisher's medal, refreshment stations (water, isotonic drinks, fruits), medical coverage, photographic coverage, and 50% boat transfer. The organization includes routes of 13 km and 20 km, with participation up to 150 athletes, and offers commemorative T-shirts, medals, refreshment stations, and medical coverage.

name: 10α Παραποτάμια
description: The Pindos Mountain Club organizes on August 2, 2026, the 10th consecutive year of the Riverside Races in Prodromos, Evrytania. These are mixed river crossing and trail races, with two routes of 8 and 14 kilometers starting from Dipotama Prousou and ending at the square of Prodromos. The route includes water crossings, trails with a 350-meter elevation gain, and two hydration points. The event is co-organized with the Regional Unit of Evrytania and the Municipality of Karpenisi and is under the auspices of EAS SEGAS Central Greece.
course_highlights: Two routes of 8 and 14 km with a common start and finish
Water crossings of Krikelopotamos and Prousitis rivers
Elevation gain of 350 meters and two hydration points
additional: Finish time is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Those who do not finish within this time sign a declaration and continue at their own risk. The start is given from the Bakoyanni bridge. The race includes mixed competitions and trails, emphasizing nature and the local community.

name: 13ος Αυξέντιος Δρόμος
description: The 13th Axentios Race is a 7.4-kilometer running event held in the Pirouniana area, Heraklion, Crete. The start and finish are located in the courtyard of the Holy Spirit Church. The route is circular and crosses rural dirt roads and accessible trails, passing through significant local attractions such as the Pirouniana settlement, the stone fountain, Saint George Chosto (11th century), the waterfall, and the forest. The race is open to men, women, teenagers, and young women and offers an opportunity for athletic activity in a natural and historical environment.
course_highlights: Circular route on rural dirt roads and accessible trails
Passing through the Pirouniana settlement and the stone fountain
Route with views of Saint George Chosto, the waterfall, and the forest
additional: Transportation to the start is available by bus or alternatively by private vehicles and farm vehicles. There are sports events for all ages. The race includes categories for men and women by age groups. The route has minimal asphalt and is nature-oriented. Distances of 7.4 km and 600 m, rural trail, three age categories, finish in the courtyard of the Holy Spirit Church, includes competitive categories and routes for students and young women.

name: Parapotamia -Krikelopotamos o bregmenos dromos
description: The Parapotamia - Krikelopotamos Race The Wet Road is organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club Always Rain in the region of Southern Evrytania. It is a mountain race crossing rivers and trails, offering a unique experience in a natural environment rich in history and beauty. The club, founded in 2015, has significant activity in the area and takes care of trail maintenance and promoting mountain sports. Participation in the race supports the continuation of the club's activities and the promotion of the area.
course_highlights: Routes crossing rivers and trails in Southern Evrytania
Natural mountain environment with rich history
Trail maintenance and promotion by the organizing club
additional: The Hellenic Mountaineering Club Always Rain was founded in 2015 and organizes the crossing race of river and trail Parapotamia - Krikelopotamos The Wet Road. The club takes care of opening and maintaining trails and awards individuals who have contributed to the area. There is an option to contact the club for registrations and information via phone and email. The event includes trails, river crossings, and local music, with online registration. The event takes place on August 2, 2026, in the Evrytania region.

name: 2ο Olympia Night Run «Run Under Zeus»
description: The 2nd Olympia Night Run "Run Under Zeus" is a night running event held in the heart of Ancient Olympia, honoring the tradition of the first Olympic Games. The race takes place under the full moon, reviving the myth of Hercules and Zeus, and offers a unique running experience in a historic and mythological environment. The event is supported by the Hellenic Tourism Organization and aims to combine sports with a message of life and culture.
course_highlights: Night race under the light of the full moon
Route in the heart of Ancient Olympia
Historic and mythological environment with a view of the Aegean
additional: The race honors the tradition of the first Olympic Games organized by the Curetes and held under the light of the full moon. It is supported by PharmaLead and the Hellenic Tourism Organization. Greek Olympians embrace the event, giving it an athletic and cultural character. Night race with cultural significance, possible participation through registration, the route passes through important archaeological sites of the area.

name: Voio Race Series
description: The VoioRace is a series of four road races held at different locations within the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, wellness, environmental and social responsibility, with the participation of volunteers and active involvement of the local community. Sports are presented as the most beautiful part of life, while participation is considered a victory and finishing a triumph. The organization welcomes everyone, encouraging young people and children to participate in creative and beautiful activities.
course_highlights: Four road races at different locations within the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain routes
Promotion of health, wellness, and social cohesion
additional: Participants must be over 15 years old. In case minors participate, parental consent is required. The organization is voluntary and supported by volunteers, promoting social responsibility and cohesion. Four road races at different locations within the Municipality of Voio, with participants over 15 years old, promote health and social cohesion. The Námati race on August 9, 2026, is the largest mountain race in Western Macedonia.

name: Βαλτινές Διαδρομές
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιποπουλιωτών Αθήνας – Πειραϊά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The 'Valtines Routes' road races are organized for the fourth consecutive year next to the Inachos River, in N. Chalkiopoulo Valtou, Aetolia-Acarnania. The Athens-Piraeus Association of Chalkiopoulites 'Saint Andrew the Hermit' invites you to participate in a celebration of culture and sports held as part of cultural events from August 10 to August 17. The races include three routes and timing is done electronically, with the support of volunteers and the local community.
course_highlights: Three routes alongside the Inachos River
Electronic timing
Organized by the Athens-Piraeus Association of Chalkiopoulites 'Saint Andrew the Hermit'
additional: The races take place on Sunday, August 11, 2024, starting at 18:30. The event is supported by volunteers and the local community of Chalkiopouloi. Timing is electronic. The event is part of cultural activities running from August 10 to August 17. Routes are 1,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m, with electronic timing, cultural events, volunteer assistance, and routes with turnaround points and finish at the Municipal School.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Χίου
description: The 14th Chios Half Marathon is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Club in collaboration with the Municipality and the Regional Unit of Chios. The race and the parallel athletic and cultural activities will take place in the traditional settlement of Kambos of Chios on August 23, 2026. Alongside the half marathon, races of 1.5 km (children's), 5 km, and 10.5 km will also be held, as well as races for people with disabilities. It is a celebration of sports and culture inviting runners of all ages and abilities to participate.
course_highlights: Routes in the traditional settlement of Kambos Chios
Parallel races for people with disabilities and a 1.5 km children's race
Cultural activities alongside the races
additional: The race includes parallel athletic and cultural activities. It is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Club in collaboration with the Municipality and the Regional Unit of Chios. There are races for people with disabilities, a children's race of 1.5 km, as well as 5 and 10.5 km races. Routes in natural landscapes, road and trail events, activities on the island of Chios.

name: Στη Σκιά του Κριάκουρα
description: The mountain running race "In the Shadow of Kriakoura" is organized for the 12th time in Theodoriana Arta, offering two challenging routes of 10 and 23 kilometers. The routes pass through fir forests, rivers, and trails with special natural beauty and difficulty, revealing the secrets of the Tzoumerka mountains. The race is dedicated to the inspirer of the first race in 2014 and serves as a criterion for participation in major mountain marathons. The start and finish are at the central square of Theodoriana, with a start time of 10:00 a.m. for all routes.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 and 23 km with special difficulty and natural beauty
Passages through fir forests, three rushing rivers, and trails
Significant natural diversity with wild boar mud pools and bear territory
additional: Participation includes a technical t-shirt, commemorative medal, electronic timing, individual feeding stations, and a meal with traditional products after the race. Race numbers are distributed at the secretariat on Saturday from 18:00 to 21:00 and on Sunday from 08:00 to 09:30. There are 12 feeding stations for the 23 km and 4 for the 10 km. The use of trekking poles and GPS devices is permitted. Camping and a wide range of accommodation options are available in the area. The race takes place on August 23, 2026, with both men and women participating. The organization promotes sports, contact with nature, and local tradition.

name: Black Yard Ultra
location: Black Yard Ultra, Βερδικούσια, Λάρισας, Greece
description: The BLACK YARD Ultra by Mamali Festival is a challenging ultra trail race that starts and finishes at Mamali Festival Base Camp, at an altitude of approximately 1454 meters. It includes a Last Runner Standing ultra race, a 12-kilometer race, and a 1-kilometer children's race. The 12-kilometer loop has 514 meters of elevation gain, mainly on trails and dirt roads, and the ultra requires experience as the rounds become increasingly demanding with reduced completion times. The Base Camp offers camping facilities, showers, food, and festival phases, creating a unique atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 12 km loop with 514 meters of elevation gain
10 km trail and 2 km dirt road
Race altitude approximately 1454 meters
additional: The Last Runner Standing race has a 2-hour time limit for the first round, decreasing by 3 minutes in each subsequent round. Mandatory equipment includes: headlamp, phone, water bottles, rain jacket, and emergency blanket. The Base Camp offers free camping, showers, toilets, food, electricity, and festival phases. Nutrition includes electrolytes, bananas, water, Coca-Cola, snacks, and after 4 hours, potatoes, pasta, and soup. Maximum number of participants: 100. A medical certificate is required. The weather in August is hot and humid with an average temperature of 35°C and 25mm of rainfall, making an early start necessary. Trail, ultra race, last runner standing format, camping available, registration requires medical certificate, mandatory gear includes headlamp, phone, water bottles, rain jacket, emergency blanket.

name: Voio Race Series
description: The VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations within the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, wellness, and social cohesion, with the participation of volunteers and active involvement of the local community. Sports are presented as a beautiful part of life, while participation is considered a victory and finishing a triumph. The event is open to individuals over 15 years old and encourages the participation of youth and children with parental consent.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations within the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain routes
Promotion of health, wellness, and social cohesion
additional: Participants must be over 15 years old. Minors require parental consent to participate. The organization is supported by volunteers and promotes environmental and social responsibility. Four different routes in mountainous areas, participation from age 15 and above, volunteer involvement, and the creation of environmental and social awareness.

name: MAMALI BLACKYARD ULTRA

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Οι εγγραφές θα διαρκέσουν από 01-05-2026 και θα κλείσουν 31-07-2026

description: The Mamali BlackYard Ultra 2026 is a endurance race of the Last Runner Standing type held in the mountainous environment of Mamali, at an altitude of 1454 meters, on August 29-30, 2026. Runners are required to complete continuous rounds of the same course, while a 12-kilometer trail race is also organized for those seeking a quick mountain experience. There is also a 1-kilometer children’s race without timing, ideal for families. The event offers a fully organized Base Camp with free camping, coffee, refreshments, and festival atmosphere throughout the race.
course_highlights: Endurance race of the Last Runner Standing type with continuous rounds
Mountain course at an altitude of 1454 meters
12-kilometer trail race with a fast pace
additional: The organization uses electronic timing with chip. Packet pickup occurs at least one hour before the race and the day before at a location to be announced. The start and finish area features a Base Camp with free camping in a fenced area, coffee, refreshments, rest areas, and festival atmosphere. The course may be modified or postponed in case of dangerous weather conditions. Trail and ultra race, festival atmosphere, camping facilities, a medical certificate is required, specific equipment (headlamp, batteries, clothes, food), limited entries (up to 100 participants).

name: Δρόμος Μάχης Μαραθώνα
location: Μαραθώνας, Δήμος Μαραθώνα, Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ανατολικής Αττικής, Ελλάδα
description: The Marathon of Marathon is a historic running race organized by the Marathon Runners Club of Marathon Telmissos. The race honors the memory of the Battle of Marathon and offers a unique running experience on a route with historical and natural beauty. Telmissos actively supports the race and invites runners of all levels to participate and run together in Marathon. The event includes parallel races and group registrations, enhancing the spirit of community and athletic tradition.
course_highlights: Historical route in Marathon
Natural scenery with views of Lake Marathon
Parallel races of 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Telmissos offers group registrations for the Athens Marathon and supports parallel races and ultramarathons. There is also the possibility to participate in group training sessions and volunteering. The club's apparel is available for participants. Routes include 5km, 10km, half marathon, marathon, and ultra distances, emphasizing the history and cultural heritage of the area.

name: Ορειβατικός Μαραθώνιος Ολύμπου
description: The Olympus Mountain Running Marathon is a historic race organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Thessaloniki. It is a demanding route that crosses Mount Olympus, offering unique natural beauty and challenges to participants. The race includes routes of 5, 15, and 42 kilometers, covering different levels of difficulty and experience. The organization emphasizes safety and athlete support with refreshment points along the course.
course_highlights: Routes of 5, 15, and 42 kilometers on Mount Olympus
Unique natural scenery and mountain environment
Refreshment points along the course
additional: Athletes who placed first in their category in the previous marathon are entitled to free participation, with an application required. Easy fulfillment of financial obligations is supported through bank accounts of EOS Thessaloniki. There are instructions for necessary equipment and suggestions for equipment rental through the club. Races of 5, 15, and 42 kilometers, registrations via application, date 2026-09-06, in Litochoro, Pieria.

name: 20ό Hercules Series
description: The 20th Hercules Series is a mountain race series held in Ypati Fthiotida, offering routes of various distances that cross the most iconic trails of Mount Oiti. The races include challenging courses with natural beauty, historical sites, and picturesque villages, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and contact with nature. The event is open to runners of all levels and provides a unique mountain running experience in a enchanting environment.
course_highlights: Routes through wild trails and fir forests of Oiti
Passing through picturesque villages and alpine meadows
Historical sites and natural beauty of the area
additional: The event includes multiple distances (1.2K, 7K, 16.7K, 42.6K) and combines natural beauty with historic trails. Support is provided by volunteer groups and group registration options are available. The start and route details are available on the official event pages. The event features races of different distances and offers an opportunity to participate in a local sporting event with a friendly and family atmosphere.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail (OUT 100K) is a demanding ultra-distance race of 101.7 kilometers in the Oiti mountain, with a positive elevation of 5,265 meters. The route combines natural and historical trails, passing through mountain villages, dense forests, and the highest peak of Oiti, offering a unique experience that tests the limits of body and mind. The race connects sport with nature and history, presenting a challenge for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Route of 101.7 kilometers with 5,265 meters of positive elevation
Passing through mountain villages and dense forests
Ascend to the highest peak of Oiti
additional: The race is categorized as UTMB 100K with 4 ITRA points. There is an option for voluntary participation at aid stations and registration/start area. Recommended equipment with a capacity of at least 8 liters. The race combines hiking and mountain running, with registrations through a club. The route passes through natural trails and mountain villages, offering an authentic mountain running experience.

name: 8ο Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail
organizer: Α.Σ. Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail και Δήμος Νάουσας
description: The Naousa Vermio Trail race offers a unique mountain running experience on Mount Vermio and the town of Naousa. It includes routes of different distances, such as the challenging 6 Korfes 44 km race with a positive elevation of 3000 meters, the Amazon 24.4 km, the Ververa 10 km, and the fun Alcove Fun & Run 6 km. The routes pass through beautiful natural landscapes, peaks, and trails, providing a challenge for runners of all levels. The event is welcoming and supports participants with supplies and signage.
course_highlights: 6 Korfes 44 km route with 3000 meters elevation gain
Variety of distances from 6 to 44 km for different runner levels
Passing through Mount Vermio and scenic trails with beautiful landscapes
additional: Available routes: 6 Korfes 44km, Amazon 24.4km, Ververa 10km, Alcove Fun & Run 6km. There is signage and supplies on the routes. Contact phones: 697 696 1886, 697 394 5967. Includes information on routes, maps, results, supplies, and time limits.

name: 8ο Acheloos Run
description: The 8th Acheloos Run is organized by the Oiniades Running Team in Neochori Mesolongiou and includes road races on public roads for all ages. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas beside the Acheloos River, with flat terrain and historic sites, offering a unique running experience. The finish line is near the sea, where runners enjoy local products and music at a beach party. The event is supported by volunteers and security agencies for participant safety.
course_highlights: Route along the calm waters of the Acheloos River
Passing through environmentally sensitive areas and historic villages
Finish near the sea with beach party and local products
additional: Packet pickup takes place at the Heroes Square in Neochori on Friday, September 11 and Saturday, September 12, 2026. Participants must be at the start area 45 minutes before the race begins. Hydration points are available at specific kilometers. The route is supported by volunteers, police, EMS, and other agencies. Training instructions are available on the official website. The races include 1000m, 5km, 10km, and half marathon 21.1km. The start is scheduled for 8:00 a.m. on Sunday, September 13, 2026. The event is held in a beautiful area close to nature and water, aiming to promote sports and social cohesion.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: Oiti Ultra Trail is a demanding ultra-distance race of 101.7 kilometers held in the Oiti mountain, combining natural beauty, history, and endurance. The route includes trails through dense forests, mountain settlements, and the highest peak of Oiti, offering a unique experience to runners. The race is part of the events organized by the Fthiotida Runners Club TRACHINA and is categorized as UTMB 100K with 4 ITRA points. The organization connects sports with nature and the history of the area.
course_highlights: Route of 101.7 kilometers with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain
Passing through historic and natural trails of Oiti
Passing through mountain settlements and the highest peak of Oiti
additional: The race is categorized as UTMB 100K with 4 ITRA points. There is an option for voluntary participation at supply stations and the registration/start area. The event is supported by local sponsors and co-organizers. Participants receive an OUT medal. Trail running, mountain terrain, high elevation gain, well-marked course, organized aid stations, emphasis on safety and environmental responsibility.

name: Serifos Sunset Race
description: The Serifos Sunset Race 2026 is a unique athletic event combining running and swimming races on the enchanting island of Serifos, taking place on the weekend of September 12-13, 2026. The routes include 5 and 10 kilometer road races starting and ending at Vagia beach, as well as swimming competitions of 750m, 1,500m, and 3,000m in the Livadi Bay. The event offers a one-of-a-kind sunset running experience, ideal for runners and swimmers of all levels. Additionally, participants have the opportunity to visit the beautiful Serifos and enjoy local activities and hospitality.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 kilometer road races starting and ending at Vagia beach
Swimming competitions of 750m, 1,500m, and 3,000m in Livadi Bay
Unique sunset running experience on Serifos
additional: The 5 km race starts at 17:50 from Vagia. There is lifeguard and rescue coverage. Car and motorcycle rentals are available on the island. Serifos is connected by ferry to Piraeus, Lavrio, and other Cyclades islands. Volunteer opportunities are available for the organization. The event includes running and swimming races, with detailed information on routes, safety, awards, and registration. The events take place at Vagia and Livadi beaches.

description: The Syros Trail Challenge 2026 is a running race organized in Ermoupoli, Syros, with routes of 3 and 10 kilometers. The routes cross paved alleys, stairs, trails, and cobblestones, offering a unique experience in an urban and natural environment. The race is open to men and women over 18 years old, with age categories for the 10 km, and includes a commemorative T-shirt and medal for all participants. The start and finish are at Miaouli Square in Ermoupoli, with a maximum duration of 2 hours and 30 minutes to complete the race.
course_highlights: 10 km with 550m elevation gain, 90% paved alleys, trails, and stairs, 10% asphalt
3 km with 90m elevation gain, 95% paved alleys and stairs, 5% asphalt
Start and finish at Miaouli Square in Ermoupoli
additional: Registrations open on May 1, 2026, and close on September 6, 2026, or when 170 paid entries are reached. There is an option for individual registrations on race day. Each athlete can participate in only one event. Age categories are available for the 10 km. A commemorative T-shirt and medal are provided to all finishers. Registrations open in May 2026, with a limit of 170 participants. The event includes medals and T-shirts, and the route highlights the landscape and architecture of Syros.

name: Patmos ChoRun
description: The Patmos ChoRun 2026 is a running race held on Patmos on Sunday, September 13, 2026. It includes routes of 21 kilometers (half marathon), 5 kilometers, as well as a children's race of 1,000 meters and a power walk. The starts are from central points of Chora, offering a beautiful running experience on the island's public roads. The event is organized by the Patmos Athletic Club "Stadion" in collaboration with the Municipality of Patmos and the South Aegean Region under the auspices of the SEGAS Dodecanese.
course_highlights: Half marathon 21 km starting from Panagia Geránou
Routes of 5,000 m and 1,000 m children's race starting and ending at the Town Hall Square of Chora
Running on public roads of Patmos with beautiful island scenery
additional: The races take place on public roads under the auspices of SEGAS Dodecanese. The start and finish for the shorter distances are at the Town Hall Square of Chora, while for the half marathon at Panagia Geránou and the Town Hall Square of Chora. The race includes various routes and is organized with the support of local authorities and agencies, promoting sports and culture on the island.

name: Hercules Series
description: The Hercules Series is a mountain running race series held in Ypati and Oiti on September 12 and 13, 2026. It includes four unique routes of different distances and difficulties, as well as a children's race in Loutra Ypatis. The routes offer intense ascents and natural beauty, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and contact with the mountain. The event is open to everyone and organized by the Fthiotida Runners Club TRACHINA.
course_highlights: Hercules Marathon: 42.6 km with 2727+ meters of positive elevation
Helleborus: 16.7 km with 1225+ meters of positive elevation
Farmakides Trail: 7 km with 428+ meters of positive elevation
additional: Children's race Lagopodaros 500m and 1km without registration in Loutra Ypatis on September 12, 2026. The races take place in the Oiti mountain range with significant positive elevation. There is an option for volunteer participation and sponsor support. The event includes races in natural scenery, with registrations through the website, and offers activities for the whole family.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Ημιμαραθώνιος «Νικηταράς»
description: The 1st International Nikitaras Half Marathon 2026 is an off-stadium road race organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli, as part of a three-day event in honor of Giannis Kourou. The race starts from Ano Doliána and finishes in Tripoli, offering a unique experience for runners wishing to participate in an international half marathon. The event emphasizes safety and route quality, with a limited number of participants for better organization and runner health.
course_highlights: Start from Ano Doliána and finish in Tripoli
Off-stadium route with varied terrain
Organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli
additional: The race is invitational with a limited number of participants for safety and organizational reasons. The route is mainly hilly with old paved roads, but also includes dirt roads and trails where runners are encouraged to bring flashlights for possible night crossings. Includes a three-day event program, volunteer opportunities, and a route from Ano Doliána to Tripoli.

description: The Ioannina Lake Run is a flat, asphalt race of 30 kilometers that crosses the area around Lake Pamvotida, offering a unique experience within a landscape of natural beauty. It is aimed at both runners trying this distance for the first time and those seeking strong performances. The start and finish are at MaVili Square in Ioannina, with the start given in stages from 8:15 a.m. The event has a long tradition and attracts thousands of runners each year, creating a three-day running festival with races for all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalt 30 km route around Lake Pamvotida
Start and finish at MaVili Square, Ioannina
Scenic landscape with views of the lake and the city
additional: Chip, bib, and souvenir pickup takes place at MaVili Square on Friday 18/09 (17:00-20:00) and Saturday 19/09 (10:00-21:00). There is also an option to collect materials on Sunday before the race starting at 7:00 a.m. The start is staged in groups. The maximum participation is 3,000 runners. Participants must be over 18 years old. Medical and cardiological checks are recommended before participation. Organizers do not require medical certificates, and participation is at the runners' own responsibility. The route includes 11 feeding stations, electronic timing, a collectible medal, and a finisher diploma. There are parallel routes and races for all ages and levels, with start and finish in the heart of the city.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Διπλός Μαραθώνιος Δρόμος “Γιάννης Κούρος 2026”
organizer: Γιάννης Κούρος – Πέρα από τα όρια
description: The 1st International Double Marathon Race "Yannis Kouros 2026" is a demanding ultra-marathon approximately 455 kilometers long, starting and ending in Tripoli. The race takes place on various terrains, mainly on old paved roads with hills, but also on dirt roads and trails, where runners are encouraged to bring flashlights for the nighttime segment. The completion time for the race is 84 hours, and participation is by invitation with strict performance criteria. The race is part of a three-day festive program in honor of Yannis Kouros and is under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli.
course_highlights: Approximately 455 kilometers on diverse terrains
Mainly hilly old paved roads with dirt roads and trails
Nighttime segment requiring a flashlight
additional: The race is invitation-only with a limited number of participants and strict performance criteria (e.g., required kilometers in previous 24-hour, 48-hour, or 6-day races). The completion time is 84 hours. Runners are encouraged to bring flashlights for the trails they may cross at night. Participation includes a double marathon, half marathon, and parallel events. Registrations open until July 2026. The organization aims to establish a tradition and attract runners from around the world.

name: 3ο Dadia Trail Run
location: Δάσος της Δαδιάς, Σουφλί, Έβρος, Greece
description: The 3rd Dadia Trail Run is a mountain race held in the Dadia Forest, Soufli Evros, every September starting from 2024. The race is organized with the aim of revitalizing the natural environment and promoting mass sports, inspired by the message that hope can be reborn from ashes. The event is supported by the Running Team - Marathon Runners of the Authentic Athens Marathon "ORAMA" and the honorary Commander of the Hellenic Army General Staff, retired General Charalambos Lalousis, who has a special connection to the area. The race invites everyone to actively participate in the effort to regenerate the forest and life.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dadia Forest
Natural environment with significant ecological importance
Mountain race with a strong theme of regeneration and environmental awareness
additional: The race promotes environmental awareness and the local community, with participation from runners of all levels. The organization includes different routes and highlights the natural beauty of the area.

name: 9ο Lesvos Trail
description: The 9th Lesvos Trail is a mountain running race held in Lepetymnos, Lesvos, offering routes of 15 km, 6 km, and 1 km. The courses cross the Lepetymnos mountain range and pass through rural and livestock areas, combining natural beauty and local character. The event is supported by the Molyvos Tourism Board and has been moved to an autumn date due to regional restrictions. The race is ideal for runners seeking a mountain running experience in a warm but beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Routes of 15 km, 6 km, and 1 km in mountain terrain
Passing through rural and livestock areas
Course layout integrated with the landscape and local restrictions
additional: The event was moved from the original spring date to September due to foot-and-mouth disease measures. The weather in September is warm with an average temperature of 31°C and a low of 18°C, with an average rainfall of 30mm. The event was relocated from spring due to restrictions related to foot-and-mouth disease, emphasizing the local nature and authentic experience of the island.

name: 10ο Lailias Mountain Running
description: The 10th Lailias Mountain Running race is scheduled for September 20, 2026, at the Ski Center of Lailias near Serres. It is a mountain running race with two routes, 6 km and 21 km, offering runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural pine forest and the unexplored trails of Lailias. The race is suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners, with positive elevation gains of 200m and 1350m respectively, providing a unique mountain running experience in a magical environment.
course_highlights: 6 km route with a positive elevation of 200m, suitable for beginners
21 km route with a positive elevation of 1350m on unexplored trails
Natural pine forest and enchanting landscape in the Lailias mountain range
additional: Registrations open from June 1, 2026. There is a volunteer registration form. The 6 km route is aimed at novice mountain runners. There are refreshment stations with water and isotonic drinks along the 6 km route. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, and closes on September 13, 2026. The event also includes other categories, such as races for children and different difficulty levels.

description: The Run Greece Trikala 2026 is a running event offering routes of 10km, 5km, and a power walking category, as well as races for children and families. The organization emphasizes safety and support for runners with support stations and medical coverage. Participation is open to everyone, with special prices for students and university students in group registrations. Runners who complete the 10km race receive a medal and a participation certificate. The event provides an opportunity for sports activity and social participation in the city of Trikala.
course_highlights: Routes of 10km and 5km with power walking
Running races for children and families (Family Run)
Support stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing
additional: Participation in the 10km race includes a bib number with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher's medal, a participation certificate with times, a race T-shirt, support services, and medical coverage. Registrations must be completed no later than 3 days before the race or earlier if participation limits are reached. Payment of the fee is only accepted by card. Cancellations or refunds are not accepted. The children's races include routes of approximately 600 meters, without timing, and are intended for students of grades D, E, and F (born 2015-2017). Participation is free and includes registration and material pickup.

name: Thessaloniki Stage Run
location: Seich Sou Forest, Thessaloniki, Central Macedonia, Greece
description: The Thessaloniki Stage Run is a multi-level race in the peri-urban Seich Sou forest in Thessaloniki, designed for runners of all levels. It consists of three race levels: a night race of 15 km, a challenging 40 km race, and a fast 25 km race, offering a comprehensive trail running experience. The event encourages participants to run all three levels to fully enjoy the forest journey. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and atmosphere against the backdrop of city lights.
course_highlights: Night race 15 km with 500m positive elevation
40 km race with 1500m positive elevation, demanding and technical
Fast 25 km race with 1200m positive elevation on forest trails
additional: Participants can cancel their registration until August 20th with a 50% refund of the registration fee. After this date, no refunds are available. Snacks are provided after finishing, along with feed stations, a commemorative gift, and a medal. It is recommended to carry a small backpack with solid food and a suitable container for liquids. The cutoff times are the same for all races, and late finishers are recorded as DNF (Did Not Finish). The event includes multiple routes, with registration information available on the website.

name: 2ο Folegandros Challenge Run
description: The Folegandros Challenge Run is a race held on the island of Folegandros, offering distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. The main race is the half marathon, with a route from Livadi to Chryssopigi and Pounta, including approximately 660 meters of positive elevation gain and characteristic island ascents. The 10 km race starts from Pounta Square and features a circular route with gentle inclines and beautiful views of the island. The event is organized by the Municipality of Folegandros in collaboration with the local running community, and the first edition received positive feedback for the quality of the course.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 660 meters of positive elevation gain
Route from Livadi to Chryssopigi and Pounta with characteristic ascents
Circular 10 km route with gentle inclines and open views of the island
additional: The 10 km race has no aid stations and a time limit of 90 minutes. The weather in September is hot with an average temperature of 31°C and a low of 18°C, with an average rainfall of 30mm. It is recommended to confirm details with the organizer before registration. The routes include elevation differences of about 660 meters, participation includes refreshments, souvenirs, and medals. The event takes place on the last weekend of September, with good weather and beautiful local scenery.

name: 44ο Σπάρταθλον
description: The Spartathlon is a historic and extremely demanding ultramarathon race held from Athens to Sparta, retracing the steps of the ancient runner Pheidippides. The route covers approximately 246 kilometers with varied terrain, from flat sections to steep ascents and descents, with an elevation difference of up to 1,200 meters. The race starts at 07:00 in the morning on September 26, 2026, and lasts up to 36 hours, with strict time limits at checkpoints. It is aimed at experienced and well-prepared runners who meet specific performance criteria in previous ultramarathon races.
course_highlights: Route of 246 km from Athens to Sparta with ascent up to 1,200 meters
Crosses provincial roads, trails, vineyards, and olive groves
Aid stations every 3-5 km with food, water, and medical support
additional: The race is conducted under strict medical and police supervision with doctors, physiotherapists, and ambulances available throughout. There are time limits for passing each checkpoint, with disqualification for runners who do not comply. Participation requires official approval from the International Spartathlon Association and full acceptance of the terms of participation. Prior experience in ultramarathon races is required, with registrations open from January 25 to February 25, 2026. The race will take place on September 26, 2026.

name: Γύρος Λιμνοθάλασσας Αιτωλικού
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Αιτωλικού, Αιτωλικό, Μεσολόγγι, Ελλάδα
organizer: Αθλητικός και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Αιτωλικού
description: The Aitolikos Lagoon Run is a well-established race held annually in September by the Athletic and Cultural Club of Aitolikos. The race takes place in the beautiful town of Aitolikos, known as the small Venice of Greece, with a route surrounding the lagoon offering unique natural beauty and athletic experience. Approximately 500 athletes and high-level runners from all over Greece participate in the sporting events, along with many children in shorter routes. The organization combines sports and culture, hosting events at the Eastern Beach of Aitolikos, providing a celebration for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Route around the Aitolikos lagoon with natural environment and beautiful scenery
Passages through two stone arched bridges approximately 300 meters long each
Town of Aitolikos, known as the small Venice of Greece, with waters and an island in the center of the lagoon
additional: Approximately 500 athletes and high-level runners from all over Greece participate in the sporting events, along with a large number of children on a 1000-meter route. The events are held at the Eastern Beach of Aitolikos, combining sports and culture with a non-profit character. Routes include lake and beach areas, registration through the official website, high-level events with medical coverage, participation of about 500 athletes, and an awards ceremony.

name: Ainos Mountain Marathon
description: Ainos Mountain Marathon is a challenging mountain marathon held on Mount Ainos in Kefalonia. The 40.5 km course crosses mountainous terrain with technical trails and a total positive elevation gain of 2,500 meters, offering panoramic views of the surrounding islands and the mountains of central Greece and the Peloponnese. There are also races of a half marathon 23.5 km and an 11.1 km trail race, starting from the village Pygri. The event offers bus transportation for athletes, free food after the race, and special offers on ferry tickets and accommodation.
course_highlights: 40.5 km course with 2,500 m positive elevation gain
Passing the Megas Soro peak (1,628 m) with panoramic sea views for 8.5 km
Technical trails and demanding mountain terrain
additional: Athletes are transported by bus from Poros and Pygri to the start. After the race, free food is offered with a special card. The next day, free transportation and guided tours are available to the Melissani and Drogarati caves. A pasta party is organized the night before the race. There are special offers on ferry tickets and free accommodation for the first 50 athletes. The race includes technical trails, demanding terrain, and offers participation packages with discounts and amenities, as well as events before and after the race, such as pasta parties and area tours.

Participation is open to everyone, with special prices for students and university students in group registrations. Children's races and Family Run for family participation
Medical coverage and volunteer support throughout the course
additional: Registrations close 5 days before the race or upon reaching participation limits. Participants receive a confirmation email and instructions for bib pickup three days prior to the race. Full medical coverage and volunteer support are provided during the event. Cancellations are not accepted and refunds are not issued. The race is part of a series of regional races in Greece and promotes the local community and the region's athletic culture.

name: 2ο Makrakomi Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Makrakomi Backyard Ultra race is a unique ultra-distance race of the Backyard Ultra type held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, Phthiotis. Participants are called to run on a circular route of 6,706 meters, starting every hour for those who continue, until only one winner remains. The race promotes sportsmanship, noble competition, and environmental protection, offering an experience that combines natural beauty and endurance. The start and finish are located at the central square of Makrakomi, with a start time of 09:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Circular route of 6,706 meters with mixed terrain (asphalt, cobblestone, dirt road, trails)
Elevation difference of approximately 90 meters with uphill and downhill sections
Passage through the newly built Church of Saint Paisios and a 3-kilometer forest road
additional: The race takes place in a sensitive environment with strict adherence to nature protection rules. Athletes run on a circular route with a start every hour for those remaining. There is an option to download the route in GPX format for use on GPS watches. The race includes rules, information about the course, and results, with participants from various runners and detailed data on the official website.

name: 27ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Νεάπολης Αγρινίου
description: The 27th Neapoli Agrinio Popular Road Race is a traditional running event held in the beautiful area of Neapoli Aetolia-Acarnania. The race covers a distance of approximately 10 kilometers and offers an enjoyable route for runners of all levels. The organization is welcoming and aims to promote sports and the local community. Participants enjoy a well-organized event with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: Route approximately 9.7 kilometers in the Neapoli Agrinio area
Pleasant urban and semi-urban environment
Suitable for runners of all levels
additional: The race is organized on October 3, 2026, with participation in a 9.7-kilometer race, and is one of the most important local sporting events in the area.

name: MakrakomiBackyardUltra
description: The Makrakomi Backyard Ultra race is a demanding ultra-distance race of the Backyard Ultra type held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, Western Fthiotida. Participants are required to run a circular route of 6,706 meters every hour, with a new start for remaining athletes, until only one winner remains. The race promotes sportsmanship, culture, and environmental protection, offering a unique experience in a natural and sensitive environment. The start and finish are located at the central square of Makrakomi, with a start time at 09:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Circular route of 6,706 meters with mixed terrain (asphalt, cobblestone, dirt road, trails)
Elevation difference of approximately 90 meters in uphill and downhill sections
Route with views of the newly built Saint Paisios church and a natural environment sensitive to human intervention
additional: The race takes place in a sensitive environment with strict adherence to nature protection rules. Athletes run at hours with a new start every hour. The route is available in GPX format for use on GPS watches. The start and finish are located at the central square of Makrakomi. Registration is open online from July 1 to September 30, 2025. The race includes 6,706-meter routes, emphasizing environmental awareness and runner endurance.

description: The Salamina Half Marathon "Ahepa Run" is a new series of road races that combines Greece's history, culture, and sports. The routes pass through ancient paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience that honors the rich cultural heritage. The race is open to runners of all levels and promotes health, wellness, and social connection. Alongside the half marathon, 5 km races, 1 km for children, and races for people with disabilities (AΜΕΑ) are organized.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participation benefits include: participant number, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher medal, electronic participation certificate, nutrition at the course and finish line, medical support, personal item storage, and changing areas. There is transportation for athletes from the organizers for those who wish. Participation in the 1,000m race for students from municipalities, middle schools, and high schools is free with group registration through a school unit and contact with the organizer. The event includes various routes and cultural elements, with the date and details to be officially announced. It is expected to attract runners from all over Greece and abroad.

name: 4ο Γόμφοι Trail
description: The 4th semi-mountainous Gómfoi Trail Race "On the trails of our ancestors" will take place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in the Gómfoi area of Trikala. It is a unique event that includes two semi-mountainous routes starting and ending at the central square of Gómfoi, crossing trails, forest, and rural roads at the foothills of Mount Itamos and in the Thessalian plain. The aim of the race is to highlight the natural beauty and historical heritage of the area, as well as to promote sports tourism and fair play.
course_highlights: Routes at the foothills of Mount Itamos and in the Pindus mountain range
Trails, forest, and rural roads
Water and supply stations along the routes
additional: Runners must be at the central square of Gómfoi by 08:00 a.m. The longer route has a time limit of 3 hours and the shorter 1.5 hours. There are 4 supply-hydration stations on the longer route and 1 on the shorter. Participants receive a timing chip, number, and souvenirs on Saturday before the race or on the race day up to one hour before the start. Routes on trails, forest, and rural roads, with races for all ages and voluntary participation.

name: 5ο Armeno Gate Trail Race
description: The 5th Armeno Gate Trail Race is a mountain race held in the area of Karystos, Evia. It is a local event supported by the Armeno Gate Trail Organizing Committee, co-organized by Ultra Effort Coaching and Chalkida Sports Academy. The race offers an authentic mountain running experience, ideal for runners seeking routes in natural environments. The event is supported by the Municipality of Karystos and the Regional Unit of Evia. The weather in October is usually cool and favorable for races.
course_highlights: Mountain race in the area of Karystos
Natural environment with local character
Routes of 5 km, 12.5 km, and 20 km
additional: The weather in October is usually cool with temperatures ranging from 13°C to 25°C and an average rainfall of 35mm, ideal for mountain running events. The event is supported by the Municipality of Karystos and the Regional Unit of Evia, emphasizing the local community and mountain nature. There are no specific details about participation costs.

name: Ημιμαραθώνιος Κρήτης
description: The Crete Half Marathon, organized by the Athletic Club of Health of Arkalohori (ATHL.Σ.Υ.), is an important sporting event in the Arkalohori area of Heraklion. The race offers a unique opportunity for runners to enjoy a route that combines natural beauty and athletic spirit, while also supporting the local community and youth through scholarship programs. The event aims to promote health and sports in Crete, emphasizing endurance and participants' effort.
course_highlights: Includes half marathon, 5 km, 10 km, and a 1000 m race for people with disabilities
Location in the beautiful area of Arkalohori, Heraklion
Organized by ATHL.Σ.Υ., promoting sports and social participation
additional: The Athletic Club of Health of Arkalohori and the Organizing Committee of the Crete Half Marathon have established a program of monetary awards (scholarships) for students of Arkalohori with high performance in national exams, linking the ideals of sports with education. The event includes races for all ages and levels, with an emphasis on participation and entertainment. In 2026, the race will take place on October 4th.

name: Spetses Mini Marathon
description: The Spetses Mini Marathon is Greece's largest multi-sport event held on the beautiful island of Spetses. It includes running and swimming races for all ages and levels, with participation medals for everyone and awards in each age category. The routes offer unique experiences with refreshment stations and scenic landscapes, while the organization ensures the comfort and safety of athletes. The event attracts runners and swimmers from around the world, offering a celebration of sports and culture.
course_highlights: Running routes of 5K, 10K, and 25K with refreshment stations at various points
Swimming races of 1.5K and 3K with refreshment stations
Children's races with separate awards and participation medals
additional: All participants receive a participation medal and there are age group awards. Participation is allowed from 12 years and older for the shorter races and from 18 years and older for the longer ones. Refreshment stations are located at specific kilometers along each route. The registration office operates from October 1 to October 5 at designated hours. Participants receive a 30% discount on ferry tickets. The island has a Mediterranean climate with ideal weather conditions in October. Private cars are not allowed on the island, but parking is available in Kosta with ferry and water taxi services for transportation. From October 2 to 4, 2026, the event includes running and swimming races, as well as family and visitor activities.

name: Run Greece Piraeus
description: The Run Greece Piraeus 2026 race offers a unique road running experience in the heart of Piraeus, with routes suitable for runners of all levels. It includes 10km, 5km, and brisk walking races, as well as a children's race and a Family Run. The event is friendly to everyone, promoting sports and social participation in a beautiful urban environment. Participants enjoy a well-organized event with electronic timing and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: Urban route in Piraeus
Routes of 10km, 5km, children's race, and Family Run
Electronic timing for all races
additional: Registrations close at the latest 3 days before the race. There is electronic timing and a process for collecting race numbers. Medical support and information on data protection are provided. The participation fee for the 5 km race is 15 euros and includes a bib number, results, services, and a certificate. Participation is open to individuals over 12 years old, with discounts for specific groups and ages.

name: IRAKLEIOS ATHLOS
description: HERAKLION ATHLOS is a mountain running race held on Mount Erymanthos, in the Mixa-Tsapournia area of the Municipality of Erymanthos, Achaea. It includes three routes: 21 km, 9 km, and a children's race of 2 km, with varied terrain including fir forest, alpine zone, and forest dirt roads. The race combines athletic challenge with contact with nature and environmental awareness, promoting the protection of the Erymanthos ecosystem. The event offers electronic timing, medical coverage, refreshments, medals, and technical T-shirts for participants in the longer routes.
course_highlights: 21 km route with 1800m positive elevation, 42% fir forest, 55% alpine zone
9 km route with 700m positive elevation, 70% fir forest
Children's 2 km route in a safe fir forest for ages 5-17
additional: The organization provides electronic timing, refreshments, medical coverage, and rescue teams, post-race meal, prize draw, commemorative medal, and technical T-shirt for the 9 km and 21 km participants. There is age and gender categorization with trophy awards. Participants run at their own risk and must provide medical certification or a guardian’s responsible declaration for children. Routes include 21 km and 9 km, children's races of 2 km, with up to 1800m elevation difference, routes through fir forest and alpine zone, requiring registration or medical certification, with awards for the top men and women.

name: Xeskouriazo Trail
description: The Xeskouriazo mountain running race has been organized since 2013 by the Women's Association of Megali Panagia on Mount Kakavos in Chalkidiki. Dedicated to environmental protection and opposition to gold-copper mining, the race promotes trail running and highlights the natural beauty of the area. The routes start and finish at the Square of Chorostasi in Megali Panagia and offer a unique experience in mountainous terrain with significant elevation gain. The race welcomes athletes from all over Greece and aims to keep the mountains alive and protected.
course_highlights: 25 km route with a positive elevation of 1200m on Mount Kakavos
15 km route with a positive elevation of 625m
Start and finish at the Square of Chorostasi in Megali Panagia
additional: There are aid stations with electrolytes, water, dried fruits, and snacks at various kilometers. It is recommended to use your own cup or bottle to avoid plastic. A participation packet and race number are provided. Camping facilities are available for athletes and visitors. Registration can also be done on the race day until 9:00 a.m., subject to availability. The event includes different difficulty levels, awareness activities, and supports the local community and environment.

name: B2Run Aθens

description: The B2Run Athens 2026 is a corporate 5-kilometer running event held at the iconic Olympic Stadium of OAKA. More than 2,000 runners from various sectors participate wearing their corporate colors, fostering team spirit and collaboration among colleagues. After the race, a lively after-run party with live music, a DJ, food, and an awards ceremony follows, making B2Run a unique experience of sport and entertainment for the corporate world.
course_highlights: 5 kilometers inside the Olympic Stadium of OAKA
Start and finish within the iconic stadium
Dynamic after-run party with live music and Street Food Festival
additional: Participants receive a race number with electronic timing chip, finisher medal, and a backpack with gifts. Support stations and medical services are available during the race. After the race, a party with live music, DJ set, Street Food Festival, and awards ceremony is organized. Parking space for private vehicles and buses is available. Arrival begins at 16:00 and the start is at 18:00. Teams have a Team Captain who coordinates and motivates members. Includes a 5K race, food festival after the race, group activities, and options for tent spaces.

name: 1ο Famagusta Run
description: The 1st Famagusta Run is an international running event organized in the Protaras area, Cyprus, aiming to unite athletes, families, and communities from Cyprus and abroad. The routes start and end at Fig Tree Bay beach, offering a unique view of the Mediterranean Sea and the beauty of the region. The race promotes hope, peace, and sportsmanship, marking a new chapter in Cyprus's sporting history. The event is friendly to all participants, with categories for all ages and running levels.
course_highlights: Five unique routes that start and end at Fig Tree Bay beach
Natural beauty and Mediterranean sea breeze
Warm hospitality of the Famagusta district
additional: The race includes categories for ages 4 to 12 years (children's race 1 km), 5 km, 10 km, and 30 km with age participation limits. Children under 6 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. The organization reserves the right to change the schedule and participation terms without notice. It includes registrations for individual, team, and corporate participants, emphasizing the natural beauty and cultural identity of the area.

name: Run The City – Latsia / Geri
description: The Latsia-Geri Municipality Running Race, Run The City, is a major celebration of sports and solidarity taking place in the neighborhoods of the new Latsia-Geri Municipality. The event is open to all ages and running levels, offering routes for children and experienced runners. With every step, support is given to the Cyprus Cancer Association, while activities, music, and surprises are available for both young and old. The organization is hosted at the Latsia-Geri Town Hall and provides an opportunity for social contribution and athletic participation.
course_highlights: Routes through the neighborhoods of the Latsia-Geri Municipality
Routes for all ages and levels
Support for the Cyprus Cancer Association
additional: The event includes music, treats, and many surprises for children and adults. The organization is under the auspices of the Latsia-Geri Municipality and participation supports a charitable cause. Participants can choose between different routes and levels, while the event features music, volunteer activities, and support for the Cyprus Cancer Association.
