description: The 14th Thessaloniki International Night Half Marathon is a unique sporting event that combines athletics with the city's night party. Participants enjoy a half marathon route, as well as 10,000m, 5,000m, and 1-mile races, with full support and amenities. The event offers commemorative t-shirts, medals, electronic timing, and energy support, creating a welcoming and lively atmosphere for all runners. The event also promotes social responsibility and culture, strengthening the Thessaloniki community.
course_highlights: Nighttime route through the city of Thessaloniki
Half marathon, 10,000m, 5,000m, and 1-mile routes
Full support with water, isotonic drinks, energy beverages, and medical coverage
additional: Participation benefits include a commemorative technical t-shirt, race number, electronic timing, a commemorative medal, provision of water, isotonic drink, juice, energy drink, non-alcoholic beer, salty snack, cereal bar, banana, medical services, and a participation certificate via the official website. Group registrations are available with a discount of 5 euros per person for groups of 10 or more. The group leader is responsible for collecting equipment and representing the team. The event features parallel routes and activities, with registration available online and at offices, and has age restrictions for certain races.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αρτας
organizer: Δήμος Αρταίων, ΕΑΣ ΣΕΓΑΣ Ηπείρου, Σύλλογος Δρομέων Άρτας
price_range: 21,1 χλμ.: 13 ευρώ, 10 χλμ.: 8 ευρώ, 5 χλμ.: 6 ευρώ, παιδικοί αγώνες δωρεάν, μπλουζάκι 7 ευρώ
description: The 10th Artas Half Marathon "The Bridge Run" is a running race held in the city of Artas, known for its rich history and significant historical monuments. The half marathon route passes through the most emblematic points of the city, including the famous Bridge of Artas, offering a unique experience to runners. The race is certified by the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) and includes city races and children's races. The start and finish are located in central points of the city, enhancing the local color and festival atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route certified by IAAF
Passing through the historic Bridge of Artas
Route through important historical sites of the city
additional: The races on Sunday 18/10 start from the Medieval Castle Gate of Artas. The walking and children's races take place on Saturday 17/10, starting from Ethnikis Antistaseos Square. All finishes are at Ethnikis Antistaseos Square. There are races for all ages, from children's to half marathon and city streets. Routes certified by the International Association of Athletics Federations, with a time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes. Includes full medical coverage and electronic timing.

name: 12οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Καβουσίου
description: The 12th Kavousi Mountain Race, which will take place on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in Kavousi, Ierapetra, Crete, is an important mountain running event. The race offers a unique opportunity for runners to enjoy the natural beauty and distinctive landscape of the area, combining the challenge of mountain trail running with the tradition and hospitality of Crete. The organization is known for its excellent organization and friendly environment for participants. It is an event that attracts runners of all levels who love mountain running and outdoor adventure.
course_highlights: Mountain trail in Kavousi, Ierapetra with natural beauty
Challenging terrain with trails and natural scenery
Traditional Cretan environment and hospitality
additional: The race includes routes of 22.3 km and 8.7 km, starting at 9:00 a.m., with technical support throughout the course.

name: Sfakia Sky Marathon
description: The Sfakia Sky Marathon is a unique mountain running race of marathon distance 44.1 kilometers with a positive elevation gain of approximately 3050 meters, held in the southern part of the White Mountains in Crete. The route starts from the seaside village of Loutro and ends in Anopoli, offering a challenging and impressive experience with passages through seaside trails, mountain deserts, and the highest peak of the White Mountains, Pachnes. The race has a time limit of 10 hours and 30 minutes and includes cutoff points for athlete safety. The event is aimed at experienced mountain runners who have completed at least two mountain half marathons in the last three years.
course_highlights: 44.1 kilometers with +3050 meters positive elevation
Route from seaside Loutro to the Pachnes peak at 2454 meters
Passages through mountain desert and trails with loose rocks
additional: The race has a time limit of 10 hours and 30 minutes with three cutoff points. The start is from Loutro after athletes disembark from a boat. A mandatory participation criterion is finishing two mountain half marathons in the last 3 years. It is recommended to use a windbreaker due to strong winds in the mountain desert. There are refueling stations at specific points along the route. It includes multiple routes, detailed information about registration and the schedule, as well as cultural events surrounding the race.

name: Imittos Epic
description: The Imittos Epic race is a demanding mountain race aimed at experienced mountain runners, featuring technical and rocky terrain. The route starts from the area of Agios Georgios Koutalas and includes uphill and downhill trails, passages through historic sites such as the Monastery of Kaisariani, and two strict time limits at control points. The race requires good management and support, as the mountain is busy and the course has exposed sections. The organization offers chip timing and commemorative medals for all finishers.
course_highlights: Technical and rocky terrain with exposed sections without fall margins
Passages through Kaisariani Monastery and trails with significant elevation gain (1,220m)
Two strict time limits at control points CP4 (13.5km) and CP6 (17.5km)
additional: Number and chip pickup is from October 21 to 24 and on the race morning. There is an option to order a commemorative t-shirt until September 30. The race has time limits at two control points (CP4 and CP6). Awards are given immediately after the winners finish. Registration is canceled if the fee is not paid within 5 working days. Refunds are made with deductions depending on the cancellation date. The race includes challenging technical routes, GPS and Garmin track files, and approaches the environment with respect and sustainability.

name: South Olympus Forest Trail
description: The South Olympus Forest Trail 54 km race starts from the square of the village Palios Panteleimonas Pierias and crosses trails with gentle slopes and impressive views. The route includes uphill and downhill sections, with a total ascent of about 2000 meters, passing through natural landscapes such as Lake Kati and the village of Palioi Poroi. There are many feeding stations and strict equipment criteria due to the season. The race offers a demanding but enchanting experience on forest trails and mountain landscapes of Olympus.
course_highlights: Ascent of 930m in the first 8.5km with a view of Lake Kati
Route with a total elevation gain of approximately +2000m
Views of the Thessalian plain, Olympus peaks, and the Aegean Sea
additional: Mandatory equipment due to season. Feeding stations at kilometers 9, 17, 28, 36, 46. Cut-off gates at 17km (3:30 hours) and 36km (8:30 hours). The event also includes 10-kilometer routes, and the date of the event is in October 2026. There are detailed information about registration and the required equipment.

name: 11ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Παναγία Μερέντα
location: Μαρκόπουλο Αττικής, Δήμος Μαρκοπούλου Μεσογαίας, Αττική, Ελλάδα
organizer: Ενορία του Ιερού Μητροπολιτικού Ναού Αγ. Ιωάννου Μαρκοπούλου
description: The 11th Popular Run of Panagia Merenda is organized by the Parish of the Holy Metropolitan Church of St. John in Markopoulo and is an annual sporting event that attracts runners from the Attica region. The race takes place on a beautiful route in Markopoulo, Attica, offering an enjoyable running experience for all participants. The event has a long-standing tradition and aims to promote sports and social participation in the local community.
course_highlights: Route in Markopoulo, Attica
Organized start and finish at the central square
Friendly environment for runners of all levels
additional: The event includes a running race and activities for children and teenagers, aiming to promote sports and social cohesion in the area.

name: Τρέχω για τον Κορινό
price_range: δωρεάν για μαθητές, 10€ για 10 χλμ., 5€ για 5 χλμ.
description: The Running for Korino race is a well-established athletic event organized in the Korino area, Katerini. It is an event that promotes positive energy and smiles, inviting runners of all ages to participate in a celebration of sports and community. The race offers an opportunity for athletic activity in a beautiful natural environment, strengthening the local community and sports. The organization ensures accessibility and comfort for all participants.
course_highlights: Route in Korino, Katerini
Natural environment with beautiful landscapes
Established local race with a positive atmosphere
additional: Participation registrations are made electronically or via email, and bib numbers are collected one hour before the race. The event is supported by the Central Macedonia SEGAS Regional Committee.

name: 43ος Αυθεντικός Μαραθώνιος
organizer: ΣΕΓΑΣ (Σύνδεσμος Γραμμάτων και Τεχνών) και Μαραθώνιος Αθήνας
description: The 43rd Authentic Athens Marathon, scheduled for November 8, 2026, is a historic and iconic road event honoring the classic route from Marathon to Athens. The race includes the Marathon, as well as parallel events of 10 km, 5 km, a night race of 5 km for students, and a children's race of 1,200 meters. The organization offers a unique experience for runners of all levels, with a rich program of events and support. The town of Marathon, with its natural beauty, is an important part of the route and the race's history.
course_highlights: Historical route from Marathon to Athens
Parallel races of 10 km, 5 km, a night race of 5 km, and a children's race of 1,200 meters
Natural and historical landscape of Marathon town
additional: The Marathon includes parallel events such as Authentic Talks and the Allwyn Marathon Expo. There is a volunteer program and a runner support center at the Olympic Complex of Faliro. Number and material pickup takes place at the Faliro Indoor Gymnasium (Tae Kwon Do). Races start with the children's race at 16:00, the 5 km race at 17:00, the night 5 km race for students at 20:00, and the Marathon at 08:30 on November 8, 2026. It features races of 42.195 km, 10 km, 5 km, a children's 1,200 meters, events, volunteer opportunities, and online registration. There is also a parallel night 5 km race for students.

name: 4o Γίδι των Μεθάνων
description: The 4th Gidi of Methana is a mountain race organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Troizinia - Methana with the participation of the Hellenic Rescue Team of Argolis. It is a demanding route that offers unique mountain running experiences in a volcanic landscape with rich natural beauty. The race is a celebration for mountain and adventure enthusiasts, attracting runners seeking challenge and contact with nature. The organization emphasizes safety and support for participants throughout the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic landscape of Methana
Routes with intense ascent and natural beauty
Rich views of the sea and the mountain
additional: The race includes routes of 28km and 12km, with elevation gains of up to +1720m and +680m respectively, and offers cultural and entertainment events. The area is known for its thermal baths and its unique natural landscape.

description: The Nafpaktos Half Marathon "Ahepa Run" is a new running event that combines sports with Greece's cultural heritage. The race routes pass through historic paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience for all runners. The event includes parallel races of 1 km for children and 5 km for amateurs and people with disabilities (ΑΜΕΑ), promoting social connection and sustainable tourism. Participants enjoy full support, electronic timing, and souvenir gifts.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participation benefits: participant number, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher medal, electronic certificate, medical support, storage and dressing areas, athlete transportation, 5 hydration stations, electronic timing, feeding stations along the route and at the finish line. The event includes a half marathon, 5 km race, and a 1 km children's race, with impressive routes within natural and historic settings. Participation promotes health and the cultural identity of the area.

name: Gidi of Methana
description: The Goat of Methana is an annual mountain running race held in the fall on the volcanic peninsula of Methana. It offers routes of 28km with 1720m positive elevation, 12km with 680m, and 5km with 120m, attracting athletes seeking a challenge in intense volcanic terrain. The race is distinguished by continuous landscape changes, contact with the sea from high points, and warm hospitality. The region's thermal baths offer relaxation before or after the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic terrain with steep ascents
Continuous contact with the sea from high vantage points
Beautiful landscapes with natural environment variations
additional: Routes of 28km (+1720m), 12km (+680m), and 5km (+120m). There is an option to relax in the region's thermal baths before or after the race. Trail race through volcanic landscapes in Methana, Greece; registrations via official website; scheduled for November 22-23, 2025.

description: The Olympia International Marathon is a historic running event held in Ancient Olympia, the birthplace of Olympism. Runners have the opportunity to run along the historic "Sacred Way," crossing a route filled with cultural memory and athletic ideals. The event includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km, Family Run, and children's race, offering a unique athletic experience for all. The start and finish are at the Town Hall Square of Ancient Olympia, with full support and amenities for participants.
course_highlights: Route along the historic "Sacred Way" of Ancient Olympia
8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy gels, and medical assistance
Kilometer markers every 5 km and electronic timing
additional: Participants receive an electronic chip timing number, a commemorative medal and T-shirt, water, isotonic drink, energy beverage, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish line. There are 8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels. A medical check is mandatory for participation. Doping control is conducted by the Hellenic Anti-Doping Organization. There are changing rooms and toilets at the Town Hall of Ancient Olympia, as well as chemical toilets along the route. Runners must run on the right side of the road. The event is organized with participants from around the world, including activities and awards, emphasizing cultural heritage and the spirit of the Olympic Games.

name: Πεντελικόν Μάραθων
description: The Pentelic Marathon is a 12-kilometer mountain race organized for the fourth consecutive year by the Marathon Runners Club Telmissos of Nea Makri in collaboration with the Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association of Marathon. The route is forested and trail-based, starting in Agia Marina Nea Makri. The race aims to financially support the Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association of Marathon for forest protection and volunteer service to the community. Mount Pentelicus, despite recent fire damage, retains its incredible beauty and historical significance, and the race contributes to the effort of revitalizing the mountains.
course_highlights: Mountain route 12 km on forest trail
Start from Agia Marina Nea Makri
Area of great historical significance and natural beauty
additional: The race is organized with the support of the Municipality of Marathon and under the auspices of EOSLMA-Y. The start is at 10:00 AM. The event aims to financially support the Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association of Marathon for forest protection and volunteer service. The route passes through the S.E.D.M. (Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association of Marathon) and is a trail within a forest that was affected by fire in August 2024. The race includes competitive and volunteer participation, emphasizing enjoyment of nature and promoting mountain running.

name: 6ο Κέρη Cross Country Race
description: The Keri Cross Country Race offers two routes in the forest of Keri in Heraklion, Crete, one of 10.2 kilometers and one of 5 kilometers. The 10.2 km route is fast in the first half but challenging with uphill elevation in the second half, ideal for experienced runners. The 5 km route is shorter and faster, suitable for beginners or those who prefer an easier mountain trail. The race is held every December and provides a beautiful challenge for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Keri Forest with natural beauty
Fast and challenging 10.2 km route with uphill elevation
Easy and quick 5 km route suitable for beginners
additional: There is a team award for the fastest team based on the average time of the 6 fastest athletes (3 men and 3 women) separately for the 5 km and 10.2 km routes. The race includes 5 km and 10.2 km routes, with participation across various age categories and genders. The event also provides information on rules and registration, and the location is known for its natural environment and scenic beauty.

name: SNF Run: First Run
location: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center, Kallithea, Athens, Greece
description: The SNF FIRST RUN is an annual charity race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation every New Year's Day at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center in Kallithea, Athens. The race offers a unique experience of giving and sportsmanship, supporting social causes. Each year, the route is different, providing a distinctive course for participants. The start takes place in the early minutes of the new year, creating a dynamic and festive atmosphere for runners.
course_highlights: Route at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center
Start in the early minutes of New Year's Day
Charity race with a social purpose
additional: The race is held every year on January 1st with a start at 00:04. It is a nighttime running event with a charitable purpose. No information was found regarding prices or registrations, as spots have been filled and registration is closed. The race is accompanied by events such as a party with live music and fireworks, and it is part of the festive celebrations of the area.

name: 27ος Αγώνας Αλσους Δαφνίου
description: The 27th Dafni Forest Race is a traditional 10-kilometer running event held in Dafni Forest. The route starts from Athinon Avenue and passes near historic sites such as the ancient sanctuary of Dafni Apollo and Afea Aphrodite, offering a course away from the city's noise with beautiful views of the Thriasio Gulf. The race is dedicated to the memory of Babis Georgatsonas and is characterized by traditional hospitality and the liveliness of participants. There is electronic timing and a storage area for athletes' belongings. Participants are advised to arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their numbers.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer route with historic sites near the ancient sanctuary of Dafni Apollo and Afea Aphrodite
Area away from city noise with a view of the Thriasio Gulf
Electronic timing and traditional hospitality
additional: Participants must arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their numbers. There is a storage area for belongings. It is recommended to leave cars at the end of Iera Odos near the Dafni Monastery to avoid congestion. The race features electronic timing and tables for alphabetic number collection. The event includes various routes and provides instructions for access and organization, with emphasis on participant safety and comfort.

name: 1ο Ermionida Cross Country Running
organizer: Γυμναστικός Αθλητικός Σύλλογος Ερμιόνης «ΔΡΥΟΠΕΣ» και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ερμιόνης «ΠΟΡΦΥΡΑ»
description: The 1st Cross Country Race in Ermionida is organized by the Gymnastic Athletic Club of Ermionida "DRYOPES" and the Cultural Association of Ermioni "PORFYRA", in collaboration with the Municipality of Ermionida and the SEGAS Region of Peloponnese. The sporting event takes place in the lush Bisti Forest and on the roads around the seaside settlement of Ermioni, offering a unique experience of sport, nature, and culture. The program includes cross-country races for all ages and abilities, emphasizing family values, inclusion, and cooperation. The race is a shared experience for everyone, regardless of level, uniting the local community and runners in a friendly and athletic environment.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the lush Bisti Forest
Seaside settlement of Ermioni with natural beauty
Variety of distances for all ages and abilities
additional: Race schedule: 5km, 4km, 2.6km, 1.3km, 500m for adults and students from Grade 3 of Primary School to Grade 3 of High School, 10,000m race on public road for adults, 300m race for children with disabilities (AmeA). The race promotes family values, inclusion, cooperation, health, environment, and culture. It is open to runners of all ages and levels, offering a shared experience for everyone. Participants can enjoy races in natural scenery, with electronic timing and live results. The organization promotes sports, nature, and culture in the Ermioni area.

name: 13ο Pilabox Trail Race
description: The Pilabox Trail Race is a mountain race held on Mount Penteli, offering a unique experience in a natural environment. There are two routes, a short one of 6 kilometers and a longer one of approximately 13 kilometers, with a common starting point at the playground on Dionysou Avenue in Old Penteli. The race is organized by the multi-space PILABOX-PILABAR, which combines fitness and healthy eating, creating a comprehensive athletic and social experience. The event has a long tradition and is an important occasion for trail running enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain on Mount Penteli
Two routes: 6.0 km and 13.2 km
Common starting point at the playground on Dionysou Avenue, Old Penteli
additional: The Start Pack is collected on predetermined days before the race from PILABAR in Chalandri. The race is combined with social events such as Pasta Party. The organization emphasizes healthy eating and exercise, offering a complete experience. The race includes electronic timing, a medal, gifts, hydration stations, a recovery meal, photos, and a DJ, with routes of 6 km and 14 km.

name: 4ο Cretan Backyard Ultra
description: The 4th Cretan Backyard Ultra is a unique and mentally demanding endurance race held in Vorizi, Heraklion, Crete. It is a race without a finish line or time limit, where runners are required to run repeated laps of 6.706 kilometers every hour until only one remains. The race is distinguished by its spirit of participation, community, and smiles, attracting runners from all over Greece and abroad. The organization promises an authentic adventure and endurance experience in a unique Cretan landscape.
course_highlights: Repeated laps of 6.706 kilometers every hour
Race without a finish line and time limit
Unique Cretan landscape with natural beauty and challenge
additional: The race is characterized by a spirit of community and participation, with runners sharing experiences and passion for running without limits. The event is organized by Idean Routes and offers an authentic adventure and endurance experience. Trail, endurance, community, nature setting

name: 7ος Βυζαντινός Αγώνας
description: The Byzantine 50 Kilometer Running Race is an ultramarathon held in Megara, combining a fully asphalt route through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, and wooded areas, with a section of approximately 5 kilometers along the enchanting Alepohori - Dourako beach. The race honors the history of Byzantus, founder of Constantinople, and has a charitable character, collecting food for the Social Food Bank of Megara Municipality. The event is organized by the Municipality of Megara and collaborating bodies, aiming to promote the running movement and provide an introduction to ultramarathon races.
course_highlights: Fully asphalt route of 49,600 meters
Passage through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, and forests
Approximately 5 kilometers along the Alepohori - Dourako beach
additional: The registration desk opens at 07:00 and closes at 08:30 on race day. The race duration is 7 hours and 30 minutes. There are refueling stations every 5 km and medical support. Timing is done with an electronic RFID chip (DagTimingSystem). The race is non-competitive and does not count as an official qualifying event for other races. There is a charitable activity collecting food for the Social Food Bank of Megara Municipality. The race takes place on January 24, 2027, with RFID electronic timing, and includes a finish line in the city of Megara. It is non-competitive, and participation is open to runners who have completed at least one marathon in the last three years.

name: 10ο Λέβαδος Mountain Trail
description: The 10th Levado Mountain Trail is a demanding mountain running race held in Livadeia, Boeotia. It features two routes, 24.2 km and 10.7 km, with significant positive elevation gain, offering unique moments for runners amidst nature and the beauty of the area. The start and finish are located at the Erkina springs, with routes that include trails, forest roads, and pedestrian paths. The race is a qualifying event for participation in the Olympus Marathon and is organized by the Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia (A.K.O.L.).
course_highlights: 24.2 km route with a positive elevation gain of 1,530 meters
10.7 km route with a positive elevation gain of 650 meters
Start and finish at the Erkina springs (altitude 179 meters)
additional: The routes are marked with metal signs, signs with the letter L and yellow-blue color, as well as tape. After the last runner, a sweep escort follows with fluids, food, and medical supplies. The race has the same start and finish point at the Erkina springs area (KRYA). The event program includes routes with technical challenges and spectacular views, with announcements and participation details to be announced soon. The organization also includes traditional gifts for participants.

description: The 10th Veikou Trail is a mountain running race held around and within the Veikou Grove in Galatsi, offering a unique running experience within the city. The routes include trails, forest roads, and elevation changes, with views of the city and Hymettus. The race is mainly aimed at experienced mountain runners and crosses the borders of three municipalities, highlighting an area of special natural beauty and historical interest.
course_highlights: Routes through the old quarries of LATO with lunar landscape
Trails, forest roads, and stairs with elevation changes
Views of the city and Hymettus
additional: All routes start and finish at the Galatsi Municipal Stadium within Veikou Grove. There is a relay race route of 20 km (2 x 10 km). The race is held under the auspices of the Galatsi Municipality and co-organized by MYSPORTEVENT. It includes a technical T-shirt and a multi-purpose collar, with start and finish at the Galatsi Municipal Stadium, and takes place on natural trails and the mountain of Galatsi.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αιγιαλείας
description: The 14th Aigialeia Half Marathon is organized by the Athletic Club of Aigio "Athenodoros o Aigeus" with the support of the Deputy Mayor of Culture - Sports of the Municipality of Aigialeia. The half marathon route is almost entirely paved, flat with minimal elevation change, starting from the beach of Aigio and passing through local communities and seaside villages, finishing again at the Aigio beach. Simultaneously, 5km and 1.5km races are held, offering options for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Almost entirely paved and flat route
Starts and finishes at the beach of Aigio
Passes through local communities and seaside villages
additional: Parallel races of 5km and 1.5km. The half marathon route has minimal elevation change and begins at the Aigio beach, passing through communities such as Nikolaika, Valimitika, Temeni, and Digeliotika, continuing alongside the old railway line. 5km and 1.5km routes, parallel races and events, paved and flat routes, finish at the Aigio beach.

name: Frozen Lake
description: The Frozen Lake race is organized by the Dramas Health Runners Club and takes place in Kato Nevrokope, Drama. It is a special winter event that attracts runners who love challenges in a natural environment. The course offers unique experiences in icy landscapes, combining sports and nature. The event is open to runners of all levels and emphasizes safety and good spirits.
course_highlights: Course in icy natural environment
Landscape with snowy and frozen elements
Challenging winter route in a mountainous area
additional: Registration is done through the membership registration page of the Dramas Health Runners Club. The list of participants is updated up to 24 hours after registration completion. No specific start times or additional amenities are mentioned. The race includes routes in a natural setting, starting from the central square of Leukogea, highlighting the natural beauty and cultural value of the area.

name: 2ο Kanalaki Run
description: The 2nd Kanalaki Run race is organized by the Municipality of Parga with the aim of promoting mass sports and highlighting the area. The race starts from the Central Square of Kanalaki and includes four different routes for runners of all ages and levels. The event offers a pleasant running experience in the beautiful natural environment of Epirus.
course_highlights: Start from the Central Square of Kanalaki
Four routes: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km (running-brisk walking), 1000 m children's race
Routes suitable for runners of all ages and levels
additional: Registrations begin on Friday 31/10/2025. There is a 1000-meter children's race. An announcement for volunteers is expected. Registrations open from 31/10/2025. The event promotes local culture and the natural environment of the area.

name: 15ος Ημιμαραθώνιος «Ιωάννης Καποδίστριας»
distance_verbose: Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 3000 μέτρα, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.2 km
description: The 15th Ioannis Kapodistrias Half Marathon in Aegina is an important sporting event with high participation and excellent organization. The race includes routes of 21.100 meters and 2.000 meters, offering a celebration for runners of all ages and levels. The start and finish are located in front of the Aegina stadium, with an impressive atmosphere and support from the crowd. The organization takes care of participants' comfort, with bib number pickup and events such as the Pasta Party on Saturday evening.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.100 meters and 2.000-meter route
Start and finish in front of the Aegina stadium
Impressive atmosphere with support from 700 athletes and spectators
additional: The registration office opens on Saturday from 18:00 to 21:00 and on Sunday from 09:00 in front of the Aegina stadium for bib pickup. There is a Pasta Party on Saturday at 19:00 at the Petras eatery next to the registration. Participants are offered a 50% discount on ferry tickets via SARONIC FERRIES. The event includes routes of 10 km, 3 km, and children's routes, with individual or team participation, electronic timing, a technical t-shirt, medal, water, and a souvenir gift. The routes feature three different distances and are open to all ages, including children in middle and high school.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a beloved winter trail race series held in the mountains of Attica, offering unique competitive experiences for runners of all levels. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, with routes that highlight the natural beauty and mountainous landscape of the area. Each race offers two distances, a longer and a shorter one, with awards and draws for Salomon gifts, and the series is a fixture in the Attica running community. The organization aims to bring more runners closer to nature and mountain running.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with natural beauty in the mountains of Attica
Long distance with significant elevation gain (e.g., 10.3 km with +660m in Penteli)
Short distance routes for beginners and runners who prefer less challenge
additional: In each race, the top three men and women in each distance are awarded, with age categories only in the longer distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. There is a draw for 4 lucky winners who will receive Salomon shoes. There is also a team ranking in the longer distance with teams of 3 members. The races include men's and women's categories, team competitions, medals, awards, and health services.

name: Ρέτζακας Trail Run
organizer: Μορφωτικός Πολιτιστικός Αθλητικός Σύλλογος Πλοκαμιανών Κισάμου
description: The Rezakas Trail Run is a distinctive mountain running event held within the boundaries of the Municipality of Kissamos, in the Plokamaina Inahoriou area of Chania. The race offers two routes: the long Rezakas Challenge 24.7 km with significant elevation gain and the shorter Rezakas Entry 6.8 km, ideal for those who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the Rezakas waterfall. The event is notable for its course passing through villages and natural landscapes, providing a unique mountain running experience. Starts are in the morning, with the challenge beginning at 10:00 and the shorter route at 10:30.
course_highlights: Rezakas Challenge: 24.7 km with ±1290m elevation gain
Rezakas Entry: 6.8 km with ±420m elevation gain
Routes crossing 6 villages of Inahoriou and the Rezakas waterfall
additional: The Rezakas Challenge race has a time limit of 5 hours, while the Rezakas Entry has a limit of 2 hours. Starts are at two different times: 10:00 a.m. for the Challenge and 10:30 a.m. for the Entry. The routes are mountainous with significant elevation differences and offer refreshment stations during the race. The event includes running and hiking competitions, emphasizing nature and local culture. The organization attracts participants from all over Crete and Greece.

name: 5ο Sparta City Ultra
description: The running club "Spartiaters Runners" is organizing the 5th Sparta City Ultra in Sparta, Laconia, on Saturday, February 7, and Sunday, February 8, 2026. The race includes three routes of 6, 12, and 24 hours, with an intermediate milestone at 100 miles. The course is a circular loop of 822 meters, starting and ending near the statue of King Leonidas and the Sparta Municipal Stadium. The winners are those who cover the greatest distance within the race time limit.
course_highlights: Circular route of 822 meters along Konstantinos Palaiologos Avenue
Start and finish near the statue of King Leonidas and the Sparta Municipal Stadium
Race durations of 6, 12, and 24 hours with an intermediate milestone at 100 miles
additional: A central aid station operates with water, electrolytes, coffee/tea, soft drinks, fruits, nuts, and snacks. Hot food (pasta and soup) is provided depending on the race duration. Organized bus transportation from Athens (Karaiskaki Square, Metaxourgeio) with specific departure and return times for each race. Race packet pickup occurs on Saturday and Sunday before the race. Awards are given to the top 6 men and women in each race, as well as medals and T-shirts to all finishers. The event includes multiple race categories, support stations with food and drinks, transportation options from Athens, and registration through the Athletin platform.

name: 2ο Tsiggla Trail Run

description: The TSIGGLA Trail Run takes place in the Tsiggla forest near Didymoteicho, offering a unique running experience in a natural environment at the borders of Europe. The event includes a training route of 8 kilometers within the forest, suitable for runners of all levels. The organization is combined with the annual pie-cutting ceremony of Thrace runners, creating a friendly and social atmosphere. The race is an alternative sports gathering with a strong local character and tradition.
course_highlights: Training route of 8 km in Tsiggla forest
Natural environment near the Greece-Turkey border
Recreation area and forest trail
additional: The event includes the annual pie-cutting ceremony of Thrace runners and serves as an athletic gathering. The route is training-oriented and takes place in the recreation area of Tsiggla forest. The race occurs in early February and also features related events and activities in the Didymoteicho area.

name: 3ος Φιλανθρωπικός Αγώνας στη μνήμη του Γιώργου Πολάκη
location: Εθνικό Στάδιο Χανίων, Χανιά, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
description: The 3rd Charity Race in memory of Giorgos Polakis is organized by the Chania Health Runners Club and is an important athletic and social event in Chania. The race takes place at the National Stadium of Chania and offers free participation to students, club athletes, and people with disabilities (ΑΜΕΑ). The first 100 participants receive a free T-shirt, and awards are given to the top finishers in various categories. The event promotes athletic participation and social solidarity.
course_highlights: Held at the National Stadium of Chania
Free participation for students, club athletes, and people with disabilities (ΑΜΕΑ)
Awards for top finishers in men's, women's, children's, and ΑΜΕΑ categories
additional: Registrations are made 2 hours before the race at the Chania stadium. The first 100 participants receive a free T-shirt. There are awards for the oldest and youngest participants by age. The organization collaborates with the Region of Crete and the Regional Unit of Chania. The participation fee is 5 euros, and the proceeds are allocated to social causes such as KIFAMEA, KIFAP Megalohari, and ELEPAP.

name: 7ο Atlas Trail Running
description: Experience mountain running at the Atlas Trail Running race in the Malakasa area of Attica. The race offers four routes: 34km, 24km, 11km, and 6km, with a variety of technical sections, forest roads, and trails within a scenic and lush landscape. During the race, you will encounter two chapels, Prophet Elias and Saint Merkourios. A small amount of mountain race experience is required, and the use of appropriate shoes and a hydration pack is mandatory.
course_highlights: 60% forest roads and 40% trails
Scenic and lush landscape of Malakasa
Two chapels along the route (Prophet Elias, Saint Merkourios)
additional: All participants receive timing from 'AGON Race Timing' and a unique medal. Well-planned feeding stations are available for sufficient calories and electrolytes. A 500ml water flask is offered as a gift from sponsors RUN N TRAIL - BETTER PEOPLE. The most numerous team will be awarded. The race includes routes through forest and mountain trails, with an encouraging and friendly atmosphere for runners of all levels. The event will take place on February 14, 2027.

name: 49ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Υγείας Αθήνας 21 χλμ.
location: Ολυμπιακό Κωπηλατοδρόμιο Σχοινιά, Μαραθώνας, Αττική, Greece
description: The 49th Athens Health Run 21 km is organized by the Athens Health Runners Club and takes place at the Olympic Rowing Venue Schinias. Since 1978, the race promotes popular mass sports and running, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The route is paved, completely flat, and surrounds the water sports area, offering a pleasant and fast experience. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, with technical support from MyRace.
course_highlights: Paved and completely flat route
Four turns around the water sports area of the Olympic Rowing Venue Schinias
Hydration stations along the route and at the finish line
additional: Participants receive a bib number with chip timing and safety pins. Medical coverage is provided, and there is an option to print a commemorative diploma with name and performance. Participation packs are collected on race day from 07:30 to 09:00. The race has a completion time limit of 3 hours. The top three men and women overall and winners of age categories are awarded. Supporters offer energy gels, natural mineral water, and bananas at the finish line. The route is 21.1 km, with a participation limit of 600, online registration, a pack with chip and medal, hydration stations, live results, and medical coverage.

name: Malles Nature Run
description: The Mallon Cultural Association in collaboration with the Ierapetra Health Runners Association organizes the Malles Nature Run, a running race that includes routes of 10,000 meters, 5,000 meters, and a children's race of 750 meters. The race takes place in the village of Malles with start and finish lines at the square in front of the cultural center. The routes pass through the village alleys and natural landscapes, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all ages. There are award categories by age and gender, while all finishers receive a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route passing through the Katharo Plateau and the Retiko Dam
5 km route through the village center and alleys
Children's 750-meter race without electronic timing
additional: The start and finish of all routes are at the square in front of the village cultural center. Electronic timing is available for the 10 km and 5 km routes. There are refreshment stations at the 3rd, 6th, and 8th kilometers of the 10 km route. Participation in the children's race is free and requires parental consent. The top three overall male and female finishers and the top three in each age category are awarded. The race takes place on February 14, 2027, with online and on-site registration. The route includes a technical t-shirt, medal, timing, and medical support.

name: Γεντίκι Trail 9
description: Gedikí Trail is a mountain race held in the Gedikí area near Larissa. The 21-kilometer route follows marked trails with a positive elevation gain of +1370 meters, offering a challenging and exciting experience for mountain runners. There is also a shorter route of 5.1 kilometers with a positive elevation gain of +250 meters, ideal for those seeking a shorter challenge. The race serves as a qualifying event for the Olympus Marathon, attracting runners looking for high competition and natural beauty.
course_highlights: 21 km route on marked trail with +1370m elevation gain
Shorter route of 5.1 km with +250m elevation gain
The race is a qualifier for the Olympus Marathon
additional: Participation limit: 200 for the 21 km route and 150 for the 5.1 km route. Start time for 21 km at 10:00 and for 5.1 km at 10:30. Contact Apostolos Goulas at tel. 6932752733. The race is organized by the Larissa Marathon Runners Club. The event includes electronic registration, water and snacks, with a participation limit of 200 for the longer route and 150 for the shorter.

name: 2ος Αγώνας για την Πανελλήνια Ημέρα Φιλάθλου
description: The 2nd race for the Panhellenic Sports Day "In the Name of Alkis" is organized by the February 1st Structure, a non-profit organization based on volunteerism. The race aims to honor the memory of Alkis Kampanos and promote the message that sports unite and do not kill. Participants run wearing their favorite jerseys and colors, on a route passing through central points of Thessaloniki, providing an opportunity for the entire community to actively participate. The race includes routes of 5 km and 1 km for younger runners.
course_highlights: 5 km route from the intersection of Alexandrou Papapanastasiou and Nik. Plastira towards the Concert Hall and New Waterfront
Finish at the Statue of Alexander the Great
1 km route along the New Waterfront in front of the "Sand Garden" (AVENUE)
additional: All participants wear the number 19. The race is dedicated to the Panhellenic Sports Day and the memory of Alkis Kampanos. There is an option for volunteers to participate. The first person to register for the 5 km race is a member of the Structure residing in Munich and will travel to Thessaloniki to run. The routes start from locations within Thessaloniki, and the organization also includes social actions such as food collection and inclusion of people with disabilities. Participation is open to everyone, and the event promotes athletic unity and social awareness.

name: 5ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αγάπης
description: The 5th Love Half Marathon in Mytilene will take place on the weekend of February 14 and 15, 2026, offering a rich program of sports and cultural events. On Saturday, races start in the Tsamakia area with distances of 1000m, 2500m, Family Running 2500m, and 5000m for various age groups. On Sunday, athletes gather in the city center for the 10 km race and the half marathon of 21 km. This event has established itself as an important occasion for the city of Mytilene.
course_highlights: Races in the seaside area of Tsamakia in front of the EOT beach
Variety of distances from 1000m to 21 kilometers
Races in the city center with traffic interruption for smooth conduct
additional: The Saturday races start at 12:00 in the Tsamakia area with traffic interruption lasting approximately 4 hours. On Sunday, athlete registration begins at 07:00 and the start is at 09:00 in the city center. There are categories for all ages and family running. The event includes multiple routes, activities for all ages, and participation packages with special gifts and amenities.

name: 10ο MaskaRun
description: The sports celebration in Orchomenos, Boeotia on Sunday, February 15, 2026, combines the 10th anniversary MaskaRun with the 1st 5 km race "Asopichos" and events for the Panhellenic Sports Day. The event is a major festival of sports, memory, and humanity, with free participation for all. The Orchomenos Central Square will be the center of the events, which also include a handball demonstration and prize draws for children. The MaskaRun has established itself as a tradition with mass participation, and this year a certified competitive 5 km route "Asopichos" with official timing is added.
course_highlights: 10th anniversary MaskaRun with route in Orchomenos
New competitive 5 km route "Asopichos" with certification and timing
Events at the Central Square with sports and social activities
additional: Participation in the MaskaRun and the Asopichos race is free for everyone. The program includes handball demonstrations and activities, as well as prize draws for children. Commemorative medals are awarded at the end of the event. It features a 5 km "Asopichos" race, celebrations for the Panhellenic Sports Day, and various sports activities. Participation is free of charge.

name: 11ο Lycabettus Run
description: The 11th Lycabettus Run is a special running race held on the lush hill of Lycabettus in Athens. The routes include asphalt and dirt paths, offering a unique running experience in nature with a view of the city. The race includes individual and team categories, with starts in the morning and full support for runners. The organization provides medals, cups, digital diplomas, medical coverage, and refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Asphalt circular route around Lycabettus Hill
Dirt path reaching the top of the hill
Routes with multiple laps depending on the distance (5.5 km, 9 km, 11 km)
additional: The routes are circular with start and finish at St George Lycabettus Hotel. There are two refreshment stations with bottled water. Electronic timing with a single-use chip is provided. Medical coverage includes an ambulance and primary care from the Volunteer First Aid Corps. Participants receive a finisher medal, trophies for the top finishers in each category, and a digital participation diploma. A technical T-shirt is provided. Registrations require age verification and parental consent for minors. The race includes medals, trophies, digital certificates, and electronic timing.

name: 11ος Αγώνας Δρόμου “Η καρδιά του παιδιού”
description: The 11th Running Race "The Heart of the Child" takes place as part of the World Congenital Heart Disease Day and offers two routes of 7 and 10.5 kilometers within a lush and beautiful natural landscape in Fodele, Heraklion, Crete. The race aims to raise awareness and support children with heart conditions, while also providing a wonderful athletic experience for runners of all levels. The event is named and supported by the Association for the Protection, Information, and Assistance of Children with Heart Conditions "The Heart of the Child".
course_highlights: Two routes of 7 and 10.5 kilometers
Lush and beautiful natural landscape
Organized as part of the World Congenital Heart Disease Day
additional: The event includes races for children and adults, with participation through online registration, ending at the square and village. The route passes through the forest and the square of Fodele, promoting awareness for pediatric cardiology.

name: Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα
location: Δημοτικό Στάδιο Βύρωνα, Βύρωνας, Attica, Greece
description: The Victory Vyron Athletic Day is organized by the Gymnastic Club of Victory Vyron, based at the Vyron Municipal Stadium. The club, founded in 2005, offers specialized guidance from coaches with experience and high athletic achievements. The event aims to promote classical athletics and improve quality of life through exercise. It provides an opportunity for athletes and sports enthusiasts to experience the joy of track and field in a friendly and organized environment.
course_highlights: Held at Vyron Municipal Stadium
Specialized guidance from physical education teachers and former high-performance athletes
Promotion of classical athletics and exercise for all ages
additional: The secretariat operates in the afternoons from 17:00 to 20:00. The club offers programs for all ages, from toddlers to adults, with training at Vyron Municipal Stadium. Emphasis is placed on training runners for road and mountain races. The event includes training activities and the 6th Vyron Municipality Running Race, offering a comprehensive experience for athletes and coaches.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup 2026 race series is a beloved winter trail running series in the mountains of Attica, offering new competitive experiences for runners of all levels. It includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, each with two routes: a longer, technical, and demanding one, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The event aims to connect runners with nature and showcase the beauty of mountain running in Attica. MyRace is responsible for organizing, with Salomon as the title sponsor.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus, Parnitha
Two routes per race: Long (10-12 km) and Short (4-7 km)
Natural scenery and technical trails with significant elevation gain
additional: In each race, the top three men and women overall in both distances are awarded. Age categories are only available for the Long Distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. A draw will be held for 4 lucky winners to receive Salomon shoes. There is individual and team scoring in the Long Distance. The start time for the Long Distance is 10:00 and for the Short 10:15. Trail races in Hymettus, categories for different distances and age groups, team competitions, medals, prizes, and race amenities.

description: The 5th Friendship and Solidarity Memorial Race is a special athletic event held in the former forest of Varympompi. The race includes two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest and paved roads, fully marked. Participation is free with registration that includes a €10 deposit, which is refunded on the day of the race, while the amount collected from non-attending runners will be donated to an orphanage. The race does not have electronic timing or prizes, as all participants are considered winners and receive a cup as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Two routes of 14.5 km and 6.3 km on forest and paved roads
Full marking and hydration stations along the route
Held in the natural area of the former Varympompi forest (Tatoi Forest)
additional: There is no electronic timing or prizes. Each participant receives a cup with a possible personal photo. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit that is refunded on the day of the race. The amount from non-attending runners will be donated to an orphanage. Hydration stations are available along the route. Routes of 14.5 km and 6.3 km on forest and paved roads, without electronic timing, participation with a €10 deposit, a cup as a prize with a personal photo, social contribution to the orphanage.

name: 10ος Δρόμος Αξιών
location: Ιερός Ναός Ζωοδόχου Πηγής, Κεφαλάρι Αργολίδας, Αργολίδα, Greece
description: The 10th Axioms Run, organized by the 1st Scout Group of Argos, is a running race dedicated to universal values of life. The race is held in honor of Scout Thinking Day on February 22nd and commemorates the memory of the great Greek marathon runner Stelios Kyriakidis. The start and finish are at Kefalari Argos, at the Holy Church of Zoodochos Pigi, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km running race with start and finish at Kefalari Argos
Children's race of 650 meters at the same location
Honorable mention to Stelios Kyriakidis and universal values
additional: The race includes two simultaneous starts at 10:30 a.m. for the main 10 km race and the 650-meter children's race. The organization has a long tradition and is connected to Scout Thinking Day. The race is dedicated to universal values and takes place in a natural environment, with start and finish at the Holy Church of Zoodochos Pigi. Participation is free and includes the 650-meter children's race.

name: 18ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καθαράς Δευτέρας
description: The 18th Clean Monday Running Race is organized in Alepochori, Attica, and includes a 10,000-meter race on an uneven dirt trail starting and finishing at a Byzantine monastery. The race offers signage, water along the route, and medals, diplomas, and gifts for participants. There is also a mini race for children and a celebration with music, dancing, and a picnic after the finish. Participation is free, with a limit of 200 athletes. A shuttle bus is provided at a cost of 5 euros for transportation from Athens and back.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter race on an uneven dirt trail
Start and finish at a Byzantine monastery in Alepochori
Signage and water along the route
additional: Limit of 200 athletes. Numbers will be distributed until 10:00 on the day of the race. Shuttle bus from Athens at 8:30 and return from Alepochori at 15:30 with a cost of 5 euros per person. After the race, there will be a celebration with DJ music, dancing, and a picnic with fasting delicacies. There is a mini race for children. Participation is individual responsibility of each athlete. The race includes a route in a natural landscape, cultural events, a costume contest, shuttle transportation, and a parallel children's race. The organization emphasizes the health and safety of participants.

name: 1ο All Terrain Ultra Race Ioannina
description: The 1st All Terrain Ultra Race Ioannina is a demanding ultramarathon held in the Ioannina region. The course includes diverse terrains and natural landscapes, offering a unique experience for runners who love challenges and nature. The event brings together runners from all over Greece and abroad, promoting sports and mass amateur athletics in the Epirus region. Emphasizing quality and safety, the All Terrain Ultra Race Ioannina is a distinctive sporting event for ultramarathon enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Diverse terrains and natural landscapes of the Ioannina region
Ultramarathon with a challenging route
Promotion of mass amateur sports in Epirus
additional: The race will take place on March 6, 2027, with start and finish in Ioannina, and also includes a 1 km kids' fun run.

name: 2ο Spetses Mountain Run «Σωτήριος Ανάργυρος»

description: The 2nd Spetses Mountain Run "Sotirios Anargyros" is a mountain race held in Spetses, aimed at promoting sports, noble competition, and highlighting the trails of the island's pine-covered mountain. The routes offer unique sea views and combine natural beauty with athletic challenge. The event includes races of 26 km and 10 km, as well as a children's walk, with an emphasis on environmental protection and the promotion of local products.
course_highlights: Trails in the pine-covered mountain of Spetses
Sea views
Routes of 26 km and 10 km
additional: The registration desk opens at 10:00 a.m. and operates until 5:00 p.m. on the day before the race at the Titania cinema, where technical briefing and athlete meal take place. On race day, the registration desk opens from 08:30 to 09:45 a.m. After the races end at 3:00 p.m., awards and farewell celebration with local delicacies follow at the same venue. Technical briefing, participation in trails and beaches, charity fun run, events to promote local culture and environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Koumaria Trail Series
description: The 5th Koumaria Trail Series race is organized by the Achaias Marathon Runners Club "Pheidippides" and offers a challenging off-road course in mountainous and natural surroundings in Petroto, Achaia. The event includes routes of 40km, 22km, 12km, and 5km, with a large participation of runners and volunteers, providing a unique mountain running experience. The race is characterized by intense competition and at the same time by the support and service of runners at refueling stations. The organization honors the tradition and beauty of nature, while promoting sports and well-being.
course_highlights: Challenging off-road mountain terrain
Routes of 40km, 22km, 12km, and 5km
Refueling stations in the mountain village of Petroto
additional: The Achaias Marathon Runners Club "Pheidippides" operates refueling stations and serves approximately 600 mountain runners with the help of volunteers. The race has great organizational success and also honors athletes with personal records. Technical off-road terrain, participation and volunteer action, large organizational success, and support activities.

name: 2ο Ελάτεια Historic Trail
organizer: Ορειβατικός, Φυσιολατρικός Σύλλογος Ελάτειας και ο Σύλλογος Νεολαίας Ελάτειας
description: The 2nd Historic Trail of Elateia is a mountain running race offering three different routes of varying length and difficulty, within a beautiful natural and historical environment. The course starts from the central square of Elateia and crosses trails, forest roads, and archaeological sites, providing unique views of the Maliakos Gulf and the surrounding mountains. The race is suitable even for runners with limited experience in mountain running, with full marking and aid stations. The organization is renowned for its impeccable setup, volunteer support, and local community participation.
course_highlights: Start from the central square of Elateia at 180 meters altitude
Passage through archaeological sites and the church of Saint Athanasios
Views of the Maliakos Gulf and the mountains of Kallidromo, Parnassos, Giona, Oiti, and Vardousia
additional: The start is from the central square of Elateia. There are three routes: 21.2 km, 12.6 km, and 6.2 km. Electronic timing is provided by CHRONOLOG. There are three aid stations. A medal is awarded to all finishers. Payments are only accepted by card. Refunds are available up to 10 days before the race with a small fee. There is a cutoff time of 2.30 hours for the middle route. There are also 1 km routes for children, aimed at raising awareness and involving the whole family. The routes are specially marked and organized with respect for the environment and the local community.

name: 2ο Τρέχω Στον Μαραθώνα
description: The marathon race "MARATHON - Running in Marathon" is a flat race of 6.8 kilometers held in Nea Makri, by the sea, along the coastal promenade of Nea Makri - Marathon Beach. It is aimed at experienced runners and active individuals over 15 years old, offering an enjoyable route without difficulties. The start and finish are at the central port of Nea Makri, with a start time of 16:30. The event includes hydration and snack stations along the route and at the finish line, ensuring a complete experience for participants.
course_highlights: Flat route of 6.8 km by the sea
Coastal promenade of Nea Makri - Marathon Beach
Start and finish at the central port of Nea Makri
additional: The participation package includes hydration and snacks along the route and at the finish. There are stations with bottled water, soft drinks, juices, bananas, sweets, and savory items. Participation is allowed for individuals over 15 years old, with parental consent for minors under 18. Runners participate at their own risk and must have recent medical examinations. Routes are approximately 8.2 km, with entries for all ages, online registration, finish at the port of Nea Makri, with water and snack provisions during and after the race.

name: 14ος Χορτιάτης Trail Run
description: The 14th Chortiatis Trail Run is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners Club and takes place on Mount Chortiatis in Thessaloniki. The race aims to familiarize runners with the mountain environment of Chortiatis, to get acquainted with the challenges of mountain running, and to promote the protection of the natural environment. The event is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia - Chortiatis and promotes exercise, sports education, and social responsibility. It is a mountain race that combines natural beauty and athletic challenge, ideal for runners who love the mountain and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain running on Mount Chortiatis
Protected forest area with rich natural beauty
Routes highlighting the natural environment and local history
additional: Registration has been extended until Wednesday 25/2/2026. The race is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia - Chortiatis. The Thessaloniki Health Runners Club was founded in 1993 and promotes popular mass sports, exercise, and environmental protection. The annual membership fee is 15 euros and can be paid either at the club's office or via bank transfer. Routes of 24, 10, and 6 km, mountain running races and trails, start and finish in the Chortiatis area, Thessaloniki, with support from the Municipality of Pylaia - Chortiatis.

description: The All Together We Can running races are held for the third consecutive year in Parnitha, Attica, with the aim of reforestation and environmental protection. Participants can choose among three routes, allowing everyone regardless of age and physical condition to participate. The participation fee for adults is 10 euros, while for children up to 12 years old it is free. All runners receive individual timing and a commemorative t-shirt. The event unites the efforts of participants to create a sustainable environment.
course_highlights: Three different routes for all ages and fitness levels
Held in Parnitha, an area of natural beauty and ecosystems
Symbolic reforestation with tree planting in race areas
additional: All participants receive individual timing and a commemorative t-shirt. The event takes place in three separate locations in Attica. There is an option to donate via telephone number 19817 with a 2 euro contribution. The event is organized in three locations in Attica, emphasizing reforestation and environmental protection. It includes online registration, souvenirs, and individual timing.

description: The Panhellenic Veterans Athletics Games are organized under the auspices of the Federation of Greek Veterans Athletes (OEBAS) and take place at the Spiantza Grove in Ilia. They include cross-country races and 10 km race walking, aimed at veterans and independent athletes. The event is supported by the Region of Western Greece and the Municipality of Pyrgos, offering a high-level athletic experience in a beautiful natural environment. The races start in the morning with the first start at 08:30.
course_highlights: Cross-country races and 10 km race walking
Location: Spiantza Grove, Ilia
Organized under the auspices of OEBAS
additional: The organization has been entrusted to SEVAS N. Ilia and OEBAS with co-organizers the Region of Western Greece and the Municipality of Pyrgos. The races are held at two locations: Spiantza Grove and Katakolo Port, Ilia. Participants cover various age categories and include cross-country and race walking events, with detailed information on routes and registrations varying by category.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering each runner the opportunity to enjoy mountain running and the natural beauty of the area. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, with two routes in each race: a longer, technical, and demanding one, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The series has established itself as a tradition in the running community and provides incentives with awards, draws, and rankings for individual and team performances. The event is organized by MyRace and supported by Salomon, inviting runners of all ages to participate in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus, Parnitha
Two routes per race: long (10-12 km) with significant elevation gain and short (4-7 km)
Natural beauty and technical trails with elevation differences from +170m to +660m
additional: In each race, the top three men and women in each distance are awarded. There are age categories only in the long distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Each race includes a draw for 4 pairs of Salomon shoes. There is individual and team scoring in the long distance with awards. Teams consist of three members and can be male, female, or mixed. Trail running in Parnitha with multiple distances, categories for individual and team runners, medals and awards, as well as full amenities for participants.

name: 6η Γύρα Μάνης
organizer: Ο Ελληνικός Σύνδεσμος Αγώνων Μεγάλων Αποστάσεων 'ΟΙ ΑΘΑΝΑΤΟΙ'
description: The 6th Mani Round Race is a ultramarathon of 80.5 kilometers held in the region of Mesa Mani, starting and finishing in Areopoli. The route is a complete loop of Mesa Mani and is entirely on paved roads. The race has historical significance, as it takes place near March 17th, the day when the Revolution of 1821 began in Mani, and this year it is dedicated to the Battle of Diro and the Mani woman. It is open to runners who have completed a marathon or ultramarathon in the last two years and has a time limit of 12 hours.
course_highlights: Complete loop of Mesa Mani with start and finish in Areopoli
Entire route on paved road of 80.5 km
Crosses historic villages and areas such as Diro Caves, Gero Limani, and Mepzapu beach
additional: The race starts in front of the statue of Petrobey Mavromichalis in the central square of Areopoli. Runners sing the National Anthem before the start. The completion time limit is 12 hours. An essential prerequisite for participation is the completion of a marathon or ultramarathon in the last two years. The race includes an ultramarathon of 80.5 km on asphalt, with a total time of 12 hours, and is a cultural and sporting celebration in Mani.

name: 10ο Women’s Run
description: The 10th Women's Run is a non-competitive 5-kilometer race organized by the Chios Health Athletes Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Chios, aimed at honoring women. The route is flat and passes through the city center of Chios, starting and finishing at the Central Square (Chios Town Hall). The race offers a pleasant experience for all participants, with amenities such as a T-shirt, medal, and commemorative diploma. The start is at 11:30 a.m. and participation is open to women over 18 years old, with minors allowed with parental consent.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km route through the city center of Chios
Start and finish at the Central Square (Chios Town Hall)
Kilometer markers at each kilometer
additional: Participation includes a bib with the participant's name, a T-shirt with logos, a commemorative diploma, and a medal. There is medical coverage and support stations with bottled water at the start and finish. The race completion time limit is one hour (ends at 13:00). The packet pickup point is the Chios Town Hall, open on Friday 06/03/2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 07/03/2026 from 10:00 to 13:00. Cancellations are accepted only until 28/02/2026 with a refund after deductions. The race takes place at Chios Central Square and promotes sports and women's health, with participants from across the island and beyond.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αθήνας

price_tiers.distance: Special Olympics Hellas και ΑμεΑ Cosmote Telekom

description: The 14th Athens Half Marathon is one of the most popular road races in Greece, held in the historic center of Athens. The 21-kilometer route offers a unique experience within the city, with support stations and full organization. The race is open to runners aged 18 and above and is a celebration of sport and participation. Additionally, 5-kilometer races, Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities are organized. The event ensures the safety and comfort of participants, with support throughout the route and an exhibition area before the race.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer route through the historic center of Athens
Support stations with water, energy gels, isotonic drinks, and sponges
Start at 08:00 with finish by 11:30
additional: Material pickup for participants is from the Runner Service Center & ERGO Half Marathon Expo at the Peace and Friendship Stadium - Taekwondo installation. Full hydration and energy supply support are available along the route. Participants compete at their own risk, without the need for medical certificates. There is a cancellation policy with a refund until February 8, 2026. Also organized are 5km races, Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event includes the Family Run, the Special Olympics Hellas race, and activities such as the ERGO HALF MARATHON EXPO, with significant routes and activities for all.

name: Στα Βήματα του Ζορμπά
description: The 'In the Footsteps of Zorbas' race is organized in KOLINDRO PIERIAS and includes routes of 13 and 4 kilometers, as well as a children's race of 500 meters. The event highlights the historical and cultural heritage of the area, offering participants a unique experience within a beautiful natural environment with panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pieria Mountains. The race is open to athletes aged 12 and above, with special conditions for minors. The event is organized by the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros and SMF SPORTS, which handles the organization and support of the event.
course_highlights: Routes of 13 and 4 kilometers in Kolindro Pierias
Panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pieria Mountains
Children's race of 500 meters for younger athletes
additional: Participation rights for the 13KM race are for athletes aged 15 and above, while the 4KM race is for those aged 12 and above with a guardian. The organization also includes a 500-meter children's race. SMF SPORTS provides organization services, electronic timing, and sportswear sales. Technical routes, online registrations, medical support, commemorative medals and participation gifts, cultural events, and local traditions are also part of the event.

name: DRC x URC Run
description: The DRC X URC run is a friendly running event held in the center of Athens, offering an opportunity for light running and socializing with other runners. The route includes options for 5 and 8 kilometers, with different paces to suit each participant. The start is from the Karaiskaki Statue at Zappeion, creating a beautiful atmosphere for a morning run. Participation is free and limited to 200 spots, encouraging runners to register quickly.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 and 8 kilometers in the center of Athens
Starting point at the Karaiskaki Statue at Zappeion
Opportunity for a light run with different paces (5km @6:30 pace, 8km @6:00 pace)
additional: Participation is free and limited to 200 spots. Participants can choose the pace that suits them and run together with other runners in the center of Athens. The event also includes an open light run, activities in the center of Athens, and is part of a series of running events organized by DRC and URC.

name: 5ος Γύρος Περιβολίων
organizer: ΕΘΝΙΚΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΑΓΩΓΗ ΠΕΡΙΒΟΛΙΩΝ Ο ΘΗΣΕΥΣ
description: The Perivolia Round is a running race organized in the Perivolia area of Chania, offering routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km. The event is aimed at athletes, runners, and nature lovers, with the goal of promoting sportsmanship and highlighting the natural beauty of the area. The routes include running and brisk walking, while the 1 km race is specially designed for elementary school children. The start and finish are located in the Perivolia area, with electronic timing for the longer distances.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km in the Perivolia area
Running and brisk walking in a natural environment
Special 1 km route for elementary school children with group starts
additional: Registrations are only accepted online and are nominative. Pets are allowed under continuous supervision and on a leash. The 10 km race is a single trail with electronic timing. The 1 km race has starts in groups of 50 people. Routes of 1, 5, and 10 km, children's race, awards, participation benefits, natural scenery, urban and natural character of the routes.

name: 7ο Via Egnatia Run
description: The VIA EGNATIA RUN race is an athletic event organized by the Regional Unit of Evros and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace. It is an innovative initiative that connects the history and culture of the Ancient Via Egnatia with sports, offering a unique experience to runners. The race route crosses the ancient Via Egnatia, which in the past connected Constantinople with Rome, aiming to bring people together through sports and culture. The race includes certified routes for a half marathon and 5 kilometers, providing options for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Route length of 21.0975 meters (half marathon) certified by AIMS
5,000 meters route certified by AIMS
Route following the ancient Via Egnatia, a historic and cultural trail
additional: The race includes various categories, with participants from runners of all levels, and takes place in the beautiful city of Alexandroupoli, emphasizing community and the region's cultural heritage.

name: 17ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Καλαμπάκα – Τρίκαλα
description: The 17th Kalambaka-Trikala Half Marathon "Thanasis Stamopoulos" is one of the fastest half marathons in Greece and Europe, featuring a slightly downhill course starting from the historic Kalambaka and ending in the heart of Trikala. The event honors the memory of Thanasis Stamopoulos, a founding member of the Trikala Runners Club, and attracts thousands of runners from all over Greece and abroad. Alongside the classic half marathon, there are 5K, 5K PARA, and 1K children's races, making it a celebration for all ages and levels. The route offers beautiful scenery, historical and modern elements, while the atmosphere is filled with enthusiasm and support from spectators.
course_highlights: Slightly downhill course from Kalambaka to Trikala
Route crossing the Thessalian Plain with beautiful scenery
Passing through historic and modern points of Trikala
additional: The start is from the Central Square of Kalambaka and the finish at the Central Square of Trikala. There is 1 hydration point every 5 kilometers in the half marathon and every 2.5 kilometers in the 5K race. A technical commemorative T-Shirt is provided to all participants and a medal to those who complete the course. There are parallel races for PARA athletes and a 1K children's race. The organization emphasizes safety and smooth conduct according to the regulations of EOSLMA-Y. It includes parallel events and volunteer opportunities, with registrations through the official website.

name: Piraeus Port Run
description: The Piraeus Port Run is an iconic road race held in Piraeus, in memory of Piraeus runner Christos Vartzakis. The race offers routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children, emphasizing a safe and quality running experience, highlighting the city's waterfront. It is a tradition for Piraeus's sporting events and is organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Piraeus and the Piraeus Health Runners Club. The event places particular importance on supporting runners and providing medical care during the race.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children
Piraeus waterfront
Medical support at start, stations, and finish
additional: Medical support at start, stations, and finish. Bottled water and a banana pack are available at the finish line. Participation rights are granted per age category and for people with disabilities with a declaration during registration. Minors participate under guardian responsibility. Organized along the waterfront, with races of 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children. Online registration.

The race takes place at Serres Autodrome, a specially designed venue that combines safety and an exciting course. The event is supported by the Municipality of Serres, aiming to promote sports and the local community. It is an event that unites runners and spectators in a friendly and dynamic environment.
course_highlights: Course at Serres Autodrome, a specially designed racing venue
Safe and organized environment for runners of all levels
Organized by the Municipality of Serres with emphasis on the local community and sports
additional: The race includes various categories and ultra-distance races, with certified courses and international participation. It takes place at the city's autodrome in Serres on March 27, 2027.
