name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ηγουμενίτσας
description: The Igoumenitsa City Run is a road race organized by the Igoumenitsa Runners Club in collaboration with the sports company Epirus Athletic Events and the Municipality of Igoumenitsa. The race includes routes of 10,000 meters, 5,000 meters, and a children's race of 1,000 meters for elementary school students. The start and finish are at the Municipal Cultural Center Pantheon, offering a unique experience along a beautiful urban route. The race is dedicated to the memory of the young friend Maximos Lamprousis, honoring his memory and smile.
course_highlights: Routes of 10,000m and 5,000m in the city of Igoumenitsa
Children's race of 1,000m for elementary school students
Start and finish at the Municipal Cultural Center Pantheon
additional: The children's race starts at 10:35 AM. The race is dedicated to the memory of Maximos Lamprousis. The start and finish are at the Municipal Cultural Center Pantheon. Organized in a coastal area, open to all ages and levels, with celebrations and surprises in the city.

name: 4ος Καλλιγώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: The Kaligoni Half Marathon in Lefkada is an annual running event offering routes for everyone, from children’s races to the half marathon. The race combines athletic challenge with the beauty of Lefkada’s landscape, attracting runners of all ages and levels. The organization is friendly and provides a pleasant experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes of 21.1 km and 9 km with natural scenery and historical monuments
A 1000m race for Special Olympics and children
Discounts on accommodation and transportation for participants
additional: Organization emphasizing cultural and athletic experience, with participation in various categories and preparation for other races. Registration for 2027 appears to open soon.

name: 5ο Coast To Coast Race
location: Παραλία Παχιάς Άμμου, Ιεράπετρα, Λασίθι, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
description: The Coast to Coast Race in Ierapetra, Crete, is a half marathon of 21.100 meters starting from Pachia Ammos beach and ending at Minos Square in Ierapetra. The route crosses the narrowest point of Crete, passing through picturesque villages and the Chara Gorge, while the last kilometers offer a view of the city's main attractions. Simultaneously, 5,000-meter races and a 1,000-meter children's race are organized, providing a comprehensive athletic experience for all. The race has a cultural and touristic character and is organized by the Ierapetra Health Runners Club.
course_highlights: Route from Pachia Ammos beach to Minos Square in Ierapetra
Passing through Chara Gorge and villages Episkopi, Pano Chorio, Kato Chorio, Kentri
Finish with a view of the southern Cretan Sea (Libyan Sea) and sightseeing in Ierapetra
additional: Transportation for athletes participating in the half marathon is provided by organization buses from Minos Square until 8:00 a.m. The 5,000-meter race and the Health & Power Walking 5,000-meter race start and finish at Minos Square in Ierapetra. There is also a 1,000-meter children's race. The event includes running and walking races, routes through scenic areas, and preparatory activities. Participants can enjoy the beautiful nature and welcoming climate of Crete.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού
description: The 9th Spercheios Half Marathon "Athanasios Akridas" is organized in Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the support of the Municipality of Makrakomi and the Spercheiada Community. It is a running race that honors the tradition and natural beauty of the area, offering a unique experience for runners who love running and nature. The race is a celebration of sports and social responsibility, aiming to promote mass sports and develop volunteerism.
course_highlights: Route in Spercheiada, Phthiotis
Natural environment and local history
Support from local authorities and environmental awareness
additional: The race is supported by the Municipality of Makrakomi, the Spercheiada Community, and Goulinas Adventure. The Thessaloniki Health Runners Club (S.D.Y.TH.) organizes parallel and night training sessions in the Seich Sou area. The race promotes athletic education, social responsibility, and environmental protection, especially of the Seich Sou peri-urban forest. Technical route in the central square of Spercheiada, with running races, children's races, and participation from local clubs. Regulations and participation guidelines are available.

The race provides an opportunity for runners of all ages to participate in a route through a beautiful suburb with sports and cultural facilities. The event is supported by the Municipality of Philothei-Psychiko and promotes athletic activity and social solidarity within the local community. The city is counting down to Sunday, March 22, the day of the race.

Organized by the Municipality of Philothei-Psychiko
Opportunity for runners of all levels

name: Τρέχω για την άνοιξη ζωής
organizer: Πανελλήνια Ένωση Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων Ατόμων Παιδιών Νοητικά Υστερούντων (ΠΕΓΚΑΠ - ΝΥ)
description: The race 'Running for Spring of Life' is organized under the auspices of the Region of Attica and with the support of the P.E.G.K.A.P.-N.Y. Friends Association. It is an athletic event that includes routes of 10 km, 4 km, and 500 meters for people with disabilities, starting and ending on Drosias Avenue in Stamata. The routes are circular and pass through characteristic points of Dionysos Municipality, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all levels. The race is aimed at runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes, with categories by age and gender.
course_highlights: Circular 10 km route (2x5 km) with start and finish on Drosias Ave. in Stamata
4 km route for middle school boys/girls and adults
500 m route for people with disabilities with participation rights
additional: The races take place on Sunday, March 28, 2027, in Dionysos Municipality. There are age categories for men and women, with age limits and veteran categories. Participants include runners who train regularly as well as amateurs. The start and finish are on Drosias Avenue - Stamata and Solomou corner, with specific turns at the 2.5 km and 2 km routes. All entries support charitable causes, with an emphasis on strengthening social cohesion and raising awareness about people with disabilities.

name: Voio Race – Νεάπολη
description: The Voio Race running event in Neapoli is organized by the Municipality of Voio and includes routes of 10,000 meters, 5,000 meters, and a children's race of 1,000 meters. The start and finish are located on the pedestrian street of Neapoli, with the course crossing the old national road TsoTylio - Neapoli. The race is open to runners aged 12 and above, offering a beautiful experience on a public road with the support of local traffic police. The organization implements wave starts and provides electronic timing for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km route on a public road starting from the TsoTylio Health Center
5 km route starting from the intersection of the village Peristera
Children's race of 1 km starting from the kiosk at the entrance of Neapoli
additional: Participants receive a race number with an integrated timing chip and race materials from the registration center on race day. The 22 km race has a maximum finish time of 4 hours and uses wave start (wave start) with placement in blocks based on performance. After the time limit, runners who have not finished continue at their own responsibility on the sidewalk. The race includes routes on public roads and pedestrian streets, with volunteer participation and winners' awards. The event is scheduled for March 28, 2027.

name: 9ο “Το Δεκάρι του Πάρκου”
description: The 9th Charity Running Race "The Ten of the Park" is organized for the ninth consecutive year on the beautiful trails of Tritea Park. It is an off-road race with routes of 5 and 10 kilometers, supported by the Management Body of the Metropolitan Park and has a charitable character, supporting the MDA Hellas association. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels who love running in nature and social contribution.
course_highlights: Off-road race at the Environmental Awareness Park "Antonis Tritsis"
Routes of 5 and 10 kilometers within a natural environment
Access from five main entrances, with the recommended entrance A near the start
additional: Access to Tritea Park via five entrances, with the recommended entrance A near the start. Supported by the Management Body of the Park and with a charitable character supporting MDA Hellas. The race promotes social awareness, protection of Tritea Park, and support for MDA Hellas, while providing an opportunity for young and old to enjoy sports in a natural environment.

name: 1ος Μαραθώνιος Ηπείρου «Βασιλιάς Πύρρος»
description: The Epirus Marathon "King Pyrrhus" is a historic and fast marathon held in the city of Arta, with a certified route by World Athletics. The course is flat and runs along the Araxthos River, offering ideal weather conditions for runners seeking records. The race honors King Pyrrhus, an important ancient leader of Epirus, combining sports with the history and culture of the region. The event includes a marathon, 10 km, and 5 km races, and is open to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Araxthos River
Passage through the historic Arta Bridge
Start and finish at the statue of King Pyrrhus, Kilikis Square
additional: There are sufficient refreshment stations with bottled water along all routes. Timing is done with a single-use chip that is not returned. Electronic timing with checkpoints is available. Awards are given after the races. Group registrations for 10 or more people are available without restrictions on race choice. The event includes road races and regional routes, emphasizing the cultural and historical significance of the area. Registrations will open soon, and the event is expected to attract runners from all over Greece and abroad.

name: 2ο Amanitis Trail
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: The Amanitis Trail 2027 race offers a unique mountain running experience in central Chios, starting from the picturesque semi-mountain village of Avgonima with a view of the Aegean. The 40-kilometer route passes through historic and natural landscapes, such as the medieval village of Anavato and the isolated Agios Sideros, offering a variety of trails, dirt roads, and panoramic views. The finish line is again at Avgonima, completing an authentic adventure in the nature and history of the island. There are also options for shorter routes of 7 and 21 kilometers, suitable for beginners and more experienced runners respectively.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the traditional village of Avgonima with a view of the Aegean
Route through the medieval castle-village of Anavato
Passages through lush ravines, trails, and dirt roads with panoramic views
additional: Participants receive a race number and timing chip, feeding stations along the route, a commemorative finisher medal, and a technical race t-shirt with a choice of two designs until 20/2/26. There are age categories and participation requirements for the 40KM race regarding previous mountain race experience. Participants enjoy feedings along the route, commemorative medals, and technical t-shirts, with participation conditions for athletes and detailed regulations.

name: 2ο DUTH Campus Half Marathon
organizer: Δημοκρίτειο Πανεπιστήμιο Θράκης και Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ροδόπης
description: The DUTH Campus Half Marathon race is organized for the third consecutive year at the Democritus University of Thrace campus in Komotini. It includes two distances, 7,000 meters and 21,000 meters, which take place on a smooth, flat dirt track within the university campus. Participation is free and electronic timing is provided, along with a commemorative medal for all finishers. Additionally, the top three winners in each distance and age category are awarded cups. The race starts at 10:30 a.m. with the start and finish lines located at the TEFAA of DUTH.
course_highlights: Smooth, flat dirt track within DUTH Campus
Two distances: 7,000 m and 21,000 m
Start and finish at TEFAA DUTH
additional: Participation is free. Electronic timing and the issuance of general and individual results are provided. All finishers receive a commemorative collectible medal. The top three winners in each distance and age category are awarded cups. A medical examination is required for all athletes and for parents or guardians of minor athletes. Organized with the support of TEFAA DUTH, with commemorative medals, cups, and family events. The route is flat and suitable for all runners.

name: 2ο Vertical Challenge
description: The 2nd Vertical Challenge is an international mountain running race of 'vertical kilometer' organized in Gerakas Xanthi by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Xanthi in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi. Athletes start from the village of Gerakas and ascend on a 3.5 km uphill route with a vertical difference of +1000m, reaching an altitude of 1415m where they finish. Simultaneously, the Gerakas Trail and Gerakas Path races are held, featuring circular routes of varying difficulty and distance. The event welcomes runners aged 12 and above, with special conditions for younger participants. Registrations are made online through the club's website and are individual.
course_highlights: Vertical Challenge: 3.5 km with +1000m elevation gain on trails up to 1415m altitude
Gerakas Trail: circular route of 8.5 km with +1000m elevation gain
Gerakas Path: easy circular route of 5 km with +240m elevation gain
additional: Maximum number of participants in the 2nd Vertical Challenge: 80 people. Submission of ITRA rating is required if available. Only individual registrations. Participation is open to those aged 12 and above, with special conditions for ages 16-18. Organized in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi, with limited entries and registrations via the website.

name: 3ος Παράκτιος Ημιμαραθώνιος Θερμαϊκού Αντώνης Ματζάρης
description: The Thermaikos Coastal Half Marathon "Antonis Matzaris" is a distinctive running event in Eastern Thessaloniki, offering unique routes along the seaside promenade of the Municipality of Thermaikos. With a fixed date and high participation of runners, the race combines sports and social action, attracting families and runners of all levels. The organization aims to establish itself as an important sporting event with a quality character and beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: Seaside route with unique beauty
Routes suitable for the whole family
Impressive performances and participant numbers
additional: Limited number of new registrations are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the Registration Center on Friday 27.3.2026 and Saturday 28.3.2026. The race includes parallel events and volunteering. The organization follows standards of major international races and has a fixed date. It is supported by local clubs and organizations, with an emphasis on ecological awareness and social participation, and includes start and finish points at the Wellness Santa Hotel.

name: 5ος Μυρμιδόνων Αθλος
description: The 5th Myrmidons Race is a demanding mountain running event organized by the Municipality of Farsala in collaboration with the Greek Federation of Folk Mass Sports - Ultra Distance, the Marathon Runners Club of Larissa, and Running Team Farsala. The race covers a distance of 21 kilometers with a positive and negative elevation change of approximately 1,000 meters, offering an exciting experience in a natural mountain environment. Additionally, the 2nd Myrmidons Mini Trail is held, a shorter route for runners seeking a more concise course. The event aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the Farsala area.
course_highlights: Distance of 21 kilometers with +1,000 meters of positive and negative elevation change
Mountain running in a natural environment around Farsala
Parallel organization of a smaller mini trail race
additional: The race includes high-difficulty routes, emphasizing the promotion of the area's natural and cultural wealth, with participants from various age groups.

name: 5ο Pravi Trail Run
description: The Athletic Cultural Club of Pangaio Municipality "EleftheroupoliRunners" organizes the 5th Mountain Running Race Pravi Trail Run in Eleftheroupoli. The race includes three routes: 21.5 km, 12 km, and 5 km, starting and finishing in Eleftheroupoli. The 21.5 km route is of moderate difficulty and includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt, while the 12 km route is also of moderate difficulty. The 5 km route is easy and suitable for beginners, offering an initial experience of mountain running.
course_highlights: 21.5 km route with 16 km trails, 2.5 km forest roads, and 2.5 km asphalt
12 km route with 8 km trails, 1.5 km forest roads, and 2.5 km asphalt
5 km easy circular route for beginners in mountain running
additional: Maximum participation: 300 for 21.5 km, 200 for 12 km, and 200 for 5 km. Finish time limit: 5 hours. Age limit: from 15 years with parental consent for 15-18 years. Start and finish at the Eleftheroupoli Open Market area. Registration includes a commemorative gift. Terrain includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt; registration deadline 23/03/2026; maximum participants: 300 (21.5 km), 200 (12 km), 200 (5 km); age 15+; time limit 5 hours

name: 5ο Run For Autism Half Marathon
description: The 5th consecutive Run for Autism race in Ayia Napa offers a unique experience with the addition of the Half Marathon distance. It is a charitable event supporting the Smile Project Day Center for young people with autism, promoting awareness and inclusion. The routes are flat and fast, suitable for personal bests, and also include 10km, 5km races, as well as children's races. The event attracts runners from all over Cyprus and abroad, offering a festive atmosphere with music, support, and many activities.
course_highlights: Half Marathon with a flat, fast two-loop course along the coastline
Passing through Ayia Napa port with views of luxury yachts and crystal-clear waters
Finish at Nissi Beach, with the option for a refreshing swim after the race
additional: There are official pacers for all distances to help runners achieve their goals. Water stations with isotonic drinks, fruits, refreshments, and medical support are available along the routes. Runners are encouraged to be at the starting line at least half an hour before the start. The roads are closed to traffic, ensuring safety and comfort for participants. The event includes a half marathon, 10K, 5K, children's races, and a 500-meter race, aiming to raise awareness and support for individuals with autism. Registration closes on March 1, 2026.

name: 8ος Δρόμος 21 Μαθητών
description: The Cultural Association of Makrohori Imathia "PSYFIDOTO" in collaboration with the Sports Department of the Municipality of Veria and the Folklore Association of Dopion Makrohori & Surroundings organize the popular memorial race "8th Race of 21 Students". The race includes routes for adults and children, with a main running event of 10,700 meters, a health walking route of 2,500 meters, and races for elementary and middle school students. The route is asphalted, with no significant elevation differences, and takes place in Makrohori Imathia. The event has a charitable character and honors the memory of the 21 students.
course_highlights: 10,700m route on asphalt without significant elevation differences
Health walking route of 2,500m for adults
Races of 1,000m and 1,500m for elementary and middle school students
additional: Online registration has closed for all categories. Late registrations are only possible if there are available numbers on Saturday or Sunday morning at the office of the Cultural Association of Makrohori. Awards will be presented at 13:15. Routes are on asphalt, participation at own risk, declarations via website, age category and route separation.

name: 8ος Κροκόδειλος Trail
description: The 8th Crocodile Trail is a demanding mountain race held in Paleochora, Chania, Crete. The 20.5-kilometer route with an elevation gain of +1200 meters starts from the coastal road of Sougia and passes through technical trails, rocky terrains, and historic sites such as Ancient Lissos. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and respect for the environment, offering a unique running experience in southwestern Crete. The event includes athlete transportation, a pasta party, and a meal after the finish line.
course_highlights: Technical rocky trail with 4 sharp 'teeth' in the elevation profile
Passage through historic sites such as the Temple of Asclepius and the ancient theater of Lissos
Views of the Ancient Lissos bay and the Southern Cretan Sea
additional: Athlete transportation from Paleochora to Sougia approximately 1 hour before the start. Pasta party and race packet distribution on Saturday before the race. Last athlete crossing time limit at the Gialiskari station is 10 km. After the finish, an award ceremony and meal follow. The route is 20.5 kilometers with 1,200 meters of positive elevation, emphasizing technical difficulty and the beauty of the natural environment. The event also includes the Kolisaura Run, 6.5 kilometers long.

name: 10ος Αραφήνειος Δρόμος
location: Δημοτικό Κολυμβητήριο Ραφήνας, Ραφήνα, Ανατολική Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 10th Rafina Road Race is a major sports celebration in the Municipality of Rafina - Pikermi, which has evolved into a tradition with strong social and athletic participation. The event unites people and organizations, showcasing the city as a vibrant center of sports and culture. The central square of Rafina transforms into a space for action and entertainment with sports activities, music, and events for all ages.
course_highlights: Organization in the central square of Rafina
Sports activities and fitness activities from PROTYPO FITNESS CLUB
Cheerleading demonstration and music by the Rafina - Pikermi Municipality Philharmonic
additional: Number and athlete kit pickup is from 09:00 to 19:00. Throughout the day, there are activities, treats, and the presence of event sponsors. The event includes music and sports demonstrations. It features races on certified routes, with participants aged 6 and above, supported by police and volunteers. Participation is free or with a small fee, and the event is accompanied by cultural and social activities.

description: The Nafplio Marathon is a unique running event that combines sports, history, and natural beauty in the beautiful city of Nafplio. Runners of all levels have the opportunity to enjoy routes passing through historic and natural landscapes, while participating in a friendly and well-organized environment. The event offers rich amenities and provides participants with free access to archaeological sites in Argolis. The Marathon is a celebration for the city and runners, with a strong cultural character and social dimension.
course_highlights: Routes that combine sports, history, and natural beauty
Free entry to Argolis archaeological sites for participants
Viewing monuments and archaeological sites of Nafplio, Palamidi, Tiryns, Mycenae, and Epidaurus
additional: Participants receive a participation number (BIB), electronic timing, a technical t-shirt, informational printed material, a participation diploma, race photos, a finisher's medal, and a bag. The registration fee is paid only by card or IRIS. Unpaid registrations are automatically canceled. Volunteers are an important part of the event. Free access to Argolis archaeological sites for runners on race day and the following day. Organized with parallel cultural, educational, and social activities, routes for marathon, half marathon, 5km, and 1km for students, as well as cultural programs and trips.

name: 10ος Εύκλειος Αγώνας Βουνού & 6ο Υμηττός Marathon
description: The 10th Euclide Mountain Race and the 6th Ymittos Marathon are organized by the Southern Suburbs Runners Club of Attica "EUKLIS" and offer a unique mountain running experience in Ymittos. The routes include various lengths and elevation gains, with certified courses and hydration points. The event is supported by volunteer groups and local authorities, providing electronic timing, medals, and refreshments to participants. The start is from Argyroupoli and the atmosphere is friendly and safe for all runners.
course_highlights: 18 km route with electronic timing and live position tracking
47 km Ymittos Marathon with a positive elevation gain of +2150 m and 2 ITRA points
Hydration points at critical points of the route
additional: Electronic timing is done with a chip and there is real-time position tracking of runners. The registration desk hands out participation packages from 07:00 strictly for athletes outside Attica. Payment is made exclusively online via card within five days of registration. Volunteers receive a race shirt, backpack, snacks, water, juice, and a medal. Mountain races and marathons, routes in Ymittos, participation in road and mountain races, technical shirt and equipment, electronic timing.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Βόλου
price_range: Half Marathon 15€, City Race 10€, Family Run 5€, Kids Run 500m δωρεάν
description: The 10th Volos Half Marathon is a festive athletic event held under the auspices of the SEGAS Thessaly and the Hellenic Association of Running Clubs (EΟΣΛΜΑ-Υ). The race includes the half marathon, the city race 5 km, the Family Run 2 km, and the Kids Run 500 m, attracting thousands of participants each year. The event is co-organized by the Volos Running Club, the Municipality of Volos, the Region of Thessaly, the Magnesia Chamber of Commerce, and the University of Thessaly. Registrations are exclusively online with card payment, and the participation package includes a commemorative t-shirt of the anniversary race. The start and parallel races offer a unique running experience in the city of Volos.
course_highlights: Half marathon 21.1 km within the city of Volos
Parallel races: City Race 5 km, Family Run 2 km, and Kids Run 500 m
Festive participation package with commemorative t-shirt
additional: Registrations are only online with card payment. Participation in the Kids Run 500 m is free with on-site registration. No refund for cancellation after March 20, 2026. Runners who do not pick up their participation package on the day and time of the race start will not be able to collect it later. Routes include half marathon, 5 km race, family and kids' races. Online registration with card, registration deadlines from 27/10/2025 to 14/2/2026, discounts, and participation packages.

name: 14ος Βαλλιάνειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 14th Vallianios Public Road Race in Argostoli is one of the most important and beloved athletic events in Kefalonia, with a continuous presence for 14 years. The main 10-kilometer race crosses a beautiful and easy route along the beach, combining the sea and natural landscape. Simultaneously, children's races and a special route for people with disabilities are organized, enhancing the inclusive character of the event. The organization is complemented by music, dance, and athletic activities, offering a comprehensive sports festival for the entire community.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the promenade with the Phoenix trees
Turnaround near the 'Oscar' restaurant and return to the Central Square
Special route for people with disabilities and children's races with distances from 50 to 100+ meters
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal and winners in each category are awarded with special prizes. The event is organized in co-operation with the Municipality of Argostoli and under the auspices of the Vallianios Endowment. Last-minute registrations are available only for a limited number of runners and are processed on a first-come, first-served basis. Various routes and age categories, volunteer participation, and events for the public are included. It features 10 km routes and children's races.

name: 29ος Δρόμος Κουδουμά
description: The 29th Koudouma Race is a demanding off-road and hiking race held in the Sternes area, Heraklion, Crete. The 22.5-kilometer route includes mountainous and difficult terrain with 9 kilometers of uphill and 13.5 kilometers of downhill on a dirt road, starting from Sternes and finishing at the Holy Monastery of Koudouma. The race offers free transportation for athletes from Heraklion and a meal for participants after the event. The organization is welcoming and emphasizes safety and a good experience for runners.
course_highlights: Mountainous and challenging 22.5 km route
9 km uphill and 13.5 km downhill on a dirt road
Finish at the Holy Monastery of Koudouma with a meal after the awards ceremony
additional: Free bus transportation for athletes from Eleftheriou Venizelou Square, Heraklion at 07:30 a.m. on race day. Race completion time limit is 3 hours. Prizes for the top 3 in each category and commemorative gifts for all participants. Age and gender categories with a minimum of 4 participants per category. Available categories for various ages, transportation from Heraklion, a meal is offered after the race, participation at own risk, and a three-hour time limit.

name: PepsiCo Gives Back – Kifissia
location: Πλατεία Ηρώων Πολυτεχνείου, Κάτω Κηφισιά, Greece
description: The PepsiCo Gives Back - Kifissia event is a charity running race held in Kato Kifisia with start and finish lines at Heroes of Polytechnic Square. It includes timed 5km and 10km races, as well as children’s 500m and 1000m races for students and people with disabilities (AmeA) without timing. The event is open to runners of all ages and proceeds are allocated for charitable purposes. The technical coordination is provided by RUNAWAY, offering a pleasant and socially beneficial athletic experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the circular road around Heroes of Polytechnic Square
Timed 5km and 10km running races
Children’s 500m and 1000m races for students and people with disabilities without timing
additional: The 5km and 10km races are timed. The children’s 500m and 1000m races are without timing. Accompanying persons with disabilities and parents can participate without a bib, starting from the end of the route. The event has a charitable character with proceeds going to social causes. Registrations include various categories and age groups, with participation fees and online registration forms. The event takes place in Kato Kifisia, starting at Heroes of Polytechnic Square.

description: The Run Greece Heraklion race offers a unique road running experience in the heart of Crete, with routes of 10km, 5km, a children's race, and a Family Run. The start is from Eleftherias Square, crossing main streets of the city, providing beautiful scenery and support throughout. The organization ensures the safety and comfort of runners with medical coverage and electronic timing. Participation is open to everyone, with special prices for students and university students in group registrations. After finishing, runners receive a medal and a participation certificate.
course_highlights: Start from Eleftherias Square, Dikaiosynis Avenue
Route through the city of Heraklion with safety and support
Electronic timing with a chip embedded in the bib number
additional: Participation includes a bib with an embedded electronic timing chip, a finisher's medal, a participation certificate with times, and an official race T-shirt. Medical coverage is comprehensive with medical services and rescue volunteers. Registrations are automatically canceled if the participation fee is not paid. Bibs are distributed three days before the race. The race promotes healthy living and social participation, with various categories and events for the whole family.

name: 3ο Kefalonia Backyard Ultra
price_range: Τελικές Τιμές για Αθλητές (μετά την έκπτωση 50%)
description: The 3rd Kefalonia Backyard Ultra race is an ultra-distance race of the backyard ultra type held in Argostoli, Kefalonia. Runners are required to run on a circular route of 6,706 meters, completing one lap every hour until only one winner remains. The event aims to bring participants closer to nature and challenge them to surpass their limits, offering a unique endurance and sports experience on the beautiful island of Kefalonia.
course_highlights: Circular route of 6,706 meters
Running one lap every hour until one runner remains
Natural environment of Kefalonia with mountain and sea
additional: The event offers significant amenities to athletes, such as free transportation with Ionion Pelagos Lines and a 50% discount with Levante Ferries. The race is conducted in continuous one-hour rounds, with the goal for participants to run as much as possible. The organization is supported by local sponsors and has been continuously upgraded, providing a high-standard endurance and hospitality experience. The race includes ongoing rounds on a circular route, with strategic feeding and support from the organizing team. Participation requires registration, and the route is suitable for endurance and strategic runners.

name: 78ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιέρας Πόλης Μεσολογγίου
location: Ιερά Μονή του Αγίου Συμεών, Μεσολόγγι, Greece
description: The 78th Sacred City of Messolonghi Memorial Run is a historic race held as part of the celebratory events of the anniversary of the historic Exit. The race honors the Messolonghi residents who sacrificed themselves for the ideals of freedom and is the oldest running race in the country. The route starts from the Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon, where the Free Besieged sought refuge, and ends in the city's Heroes' Garden, covering a total of 9,800 meters. It is a route with special historical and symbolic significance, offering participants a unique athletic and cultural experience.
course_highlights: Start from the Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon, a historic refuge point for the Free Besieged
Finish in the Heroes' Garden of Messolonghi
Total distance of 9,800 meters with historical and symbolic importance
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. The route begins at the Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon and ends in the city's Heroes' Garden. The race honors the historic sacrifice of the Messolonghi residents and the Philhellenes during the Exit of Messolonghi. The organization includes three participation categories: over 2,500 entries, ages up to 17 years, participation via QR code, and it is conducted along a walking route around Messolonghi.

name: Evia Ultra Trail
description: The Evia Ultra Trail race is a demanding mountain course held in the area of Steni, Euboea. It offers a unique experience for runners who love the mountain and adventure, with routes crossing natural trails and picturesque landscapes. The race is an important event for the local community and attracts runners from all over Greece and abroad. The organization is professional and welcoming, with an emphasis on safety and participant support.
course_highlights: Mountain course with natural trails
Impressive landscapes of Steni, Euboea
Support stations along the route
additional: The race includes routes of 30 km with recorded support stations. There is inclusion in the ITRA - UTMB Index for 2026. The organization provides technical briefing and race regulations available to participants. The race features feeding stations, medical support, and different routes for each runner level, with an emphasis on safety and enjoying nature.

name: Helicon Mountain Race
description: The Helicon Mountain Race is a demanding mountain race held at the Sources of Krya in Livadeia. It offers routes of different distances, from 5.6 km to 38 km, within a enchanting natural environment with rugged terrain and rich vegetation. The race is certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and provides a unique opportunity for nature and action enthusiasts to experience an unforgettable mountain running adventure. Additionally, free yoga sessions are organized for relaxation and unwinding.
course_highlights: Variety of routes from 5.6 to 38 km in mountain environment
Certification by the International Skyrunning Federation
Natural landscape with lush vegetation and rugged terrain
additional: A free yoga session is organized on Saturday 4/4 at 15:00 at the Open Theater of Krya with mandatory registration. There is an option for voluntary participation in the organization via a special form. Multiple routes, environmental awareness, local hospitality, and cultural experiences, with emphasis on mountain nature and adventure.

description: The Run Greece race in Syros offers a unique road running experience with routes of 10 km, 5 km, a children's race, and a Family Run. The start is at Miaoulis Square, with routes combining urban and seaside scenery, ideal for runners of all levels. The event provides electronic timing, medical coverage, and medals for finishers, creating a friendly and safe environment for all participants. Participation is open to adults and children, with special prices for students and pupils in group registrations.
course_highlights: Start in front of the Town Hall on Eleftheriou Venizelou street
Routes of 10 km and 5 km within the city and seaside area
Organized support with stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing
additional: Participation in the 10 km race includes a bib number with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher's medal, a participation certificate with times, and an official T-shirt. Medical coverage is organized with medical services and volunteer rescuers along the route. Registrations are automatically canceled if the participation fee is not paid. Bib and material collection takes place before the race with instructions sent via email. The race includes four laps of the 10 km route, starting at Miaoulis Square and finishing in front of the Town Hall. Registration closes a few days before the race.

name: Hydra’s Trail Event
location: Hydra, Hydra Regional Unit, Attica, Greece
description: The Hydra’s Trail Event is an annual mountain running race held on the island of Hydra. It offers a variety of routes for runners of all levels, from a marathon to shorter and more fun routes. The event combines the challenge of nature with the beauty of the landscape, attracting a large number of participants and volunteers. The event has a long tradition and reputation for excellent organization and a friendly environment.
course_highlights: Routes with intense mountain character and natural beauty
A variety of races from marathon to routes for beginners and children
Routes crossing the picturesque island of Hydra
additional: Participants are offered race t-shirts and medals. There is an option for volunteering to support athletes. The program includes multiple start times for different routes, with the first start at 07:00. The event includes medals, t-shirts, volunteer opportunities, and participation in various categories, emphasizing natural beauty and community.

name: 10ος Μαραθώνιος Κρήτης
description: The 10th Crete Marathon is an internationally recognized sporting event held in the beautiful city of Chania. Dedicated to the memory of the Blessed Metropolitan Eirinaios Galanakis, the race includes routes for the marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, each with a special dedication and historical significance. The course starts and finishes at the National Sports Center of Chania, passing through important points of the city, offering a unique running experience in an urban and natural environment. The event is supported by the Chania Health Runners Club and local authorities, emphasizing quality and tradition.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the National Sports Center of Chania
Route through historic and seaside points of Chania
Variety of distances: Marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km
additional: The races start at different times depending on the distance: Marathon at 07:00, 10 km at 07:30, 5 km at 08:30, and 2.5 km at 11:30. Participants receive an official backpack and a face towel as participation gifts. Registration is available online or in cash at the SDC of Chania. There is a cancellation policy with a refund until January 31, 2026. The routes are dedicated to important personalities of Crete and Greece. Official items include t-shirts, towels, and backpacks. The event has a cultural and memorial character, with participation from clubs and organizations of Crete.

name: 3ος Γιτάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 3rd Gitanos Race is an important athletic and cultural event that combines sports with the promotion of the historical heritage of Thesprotia. It includes races of 21 km, 5 km, and a children's race of 1,000 meters for children aged 6 and above. The route is asphalt and ends at the archaeological site of Gitanos, with the finish line at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitanos. The organization aims to establish a tradition that links sports with the history and culture of the area.
course_highlights: 21 km route from Igoumenitsa bike path to the Archaeological Site of Gitanos
Passage along the coastal front, Raggio-Kestrini plain, and the Kalama River
Finish at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitanos
additional: Participation is free. Buses will be available from Pantheon Igoumenitsa to the Archaeological Site of Gitanos (08:00 - 08:30 a.m.) with return after the award ceremony. For safety reasons, vehicle traffic will be interrupted at the Ancient Theatre of Gitanos and its surroundings before the start of the 5 km and children's races. Routes are on asphalt, include cultural monuments, refreshments, medical coverage, and have age participation terms.

name: 3ο Γρεβενά City Run
description: The 3rd Grevena City Run is a special road race organized in the city of Grevena. Participants will run through the city's main streets, climbing stairs and passing through picturesque alleys, enjoying the view of the Grevenitis River. The race offers routes of 10 km, 5 km, as well as 1000 meters for children and a 1000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. The start and finish are located at Emilia Square in Grevena, providing a beautiful opportunity to get to know the city and experience Grevena hospitality.
course_highlights: Routes through the city's main streets
Passing through alleys and stairs
View of the Grevenitis River
additional: Routes for children 1000 meters and a 1000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. Start and finish at Emilia Square in Grevena. The race theme is 'Sports for All' and emphasizes strengthening social cohesion and health through sports.

name: 5ο Race For Autism Gr
description: The 5th Race For Autism Gr takes place in Kavouri Vouliagmenis with the aim of raising awareness and promoting equal participation of neurodiverse individuals in sports. The event is supported by the Non-Profit Civil Company Race for Autism Gr, which organizes amateur athletic races across Greece. Through this race, social inclusion and acceptance of people with autism and their families are promoted. The activity is held in collaboration with the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and aims to raise awareness about autism.
course_highlights: Location: Kavouri Vouliagmenis
Amateur race of 5 kilometers
Promotion of equal participation of neurodiverse individuals
additional: The event is supported by the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and local authorities. There is a parallel swimming activity called "Swim for Autism" held at the Kallithea Swimming Pool. The event promotes acceptance, participation, and inclusion of neurodiverse individuals in sports. It includes road races and other awareness activities, with support from the Municipality of Vouliagmeni and local organizations. The event is open to all ages and abilities, promoting social integration and acceptance.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Πεδίου Αρεως «Στις Γειτονιές της Αθήνας»
location: Pediou Areos Park, Athens, Attica, Greece
description: The 9th Pedion Areos Race "In the Neighborhoods of Athens" is organized by the Athletic Cultural Club "Athena Runners" with the aim of highlighting Pedion Areos Park and raising awareness about environmental issues. The race includes 5 and 10 kilometer routes that start and finish within the park, crossing the surrounding neighborhoods of Athens, as well as a children's race of 1.3 kilometers within the park. The event emphasizes culture, fair play, and ecological consciousness, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Athena Statue inside Pedion Areos
Routes of 5 and 10 kilometers crossing the neighborhoods around the park
Children's race of 1.3 kilometers inside the park
additional: The children's race is a loop inside the park. The 10-kilometer race has a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes, after which runners are required to run on the sidewalk at their own risk. The race is under the auspices of several organizations, including the GGA and the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultramarathons (EOSLMA-Y). The event emphasizes green races with environmental awareness. Routes in the park and neighborhoods, environmental program, electronic timing, participation limit of 650 overall for 5 and 10 km.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Γερανείων
description: The 10th Gerania Mountain Race is a demanding mountain race held in the beautiful natural environment of Gerania, near Loutraki Peloponnese. The race celebrates a decade of challenges and participation, offering runners a unique experience on trails and mountain routes. The event is supported by the Municipality of Loutraki and is an important athletic event in the region. The event brings together organizers and athletes in a friendly and dynamic environment.
course_highlights: Mountain route in the Gerania Mountains
Natural landscape with trails and varied terrain
Challenging course celebrating 10 years of history
additional: The event is organized by the Municipality of Loutraki. No information was found regarding registration fees, start times, or special participation categories. The organization celebrates its 10th anniversary and emphasizes the challenge of every kilometer in the mountain. The race includes mountain running with an emphasis on nature and challenge, and offers opportunities for preparation and training at different difficulty levels.

The race takes place in Rethymno, starting from Kalonykti, and includes routes on dirt roads and trails. The event features races of various distances, a children's race, a bike ride, and a nature walk, offering a comprehensive athletic experience for all participants.

10 km route with 2 km on dirt roads
Start from Kalonykti and route through Agios Andreas, Gonia, Frantzeskianes, and Metochia

The 15km route offers elevation changes with a total altitude difference of 500 meters, providing a challenging and beautiful experience for runners. The race aims to raise awareness for children with autism and support the Autism Unit "HOPE". Registration includes official timing, medical support, a medal, a commemorative diploma, and snacks at the finish line. There is also a clothing storage area and toilets at the start-finish area.

15km route with 500 meters elevation difference
Feeding points and official timing at 5+km and 15km

There is a clothing storage area and toilets at the start-finish area. Online registrations have closed definitively, with the name printed on the bib number for those registered by March 22, 2026. description: The Messini Marathon is a well-established running event organized by the Municipality of Messini with the support of the SEGAS Peloponnese Region. The race promotes noble competition and camaraderie, inspired by ancient Greek tradition. Messini, with its historical significance, hosts this important athletic event attracting runners of various ages and levels. The organization includes marathon, 10 km, and 3 km routes, offering a variety of options for participants.

10 km race suitable for intermediate runners
3 km race for beginners and children

The event is supported by the Municipality of Messini and the SEGAS Peloponnese Region. It includes races for all ages, with participation and registration options, as well as volunteer opportunities. The race takes place on April 11, 2027.

name: 29ος Αγώνας Δρόμου / Πεζοπορίας Κουδουμά
description: The 29th Koudouma Mountain Running / Hiking Race is a challenging mountain race of 22.5 kilometers starting from Sternes and ending at the Holy Monastery of Koudouma. The route includes 9 kilometers of uphill and 13.5 kilometers of downhill on a dirt road, offering a unique experience in a natural and mountainous environment. The race is intended for runners in good physical condition and has a finish time limit of 3 hours. After finishing, participants enjoy a meal and awards in a friendly and warm atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route of 22.5 kilometers with 9 km uphill and 13.5 km downhill
Start from Sternes and finish at the Holy Monastery of Koudouma
Route on dirt road with natural beauty and challenging terrain
additional: Free transportation of athletes by bus from Eleftheriou Venizelou Square (Heraklion) at 07:30 a.m. on race day. There are many participation categories by age and gender, with prizes for the top finishers in each category and commemorative gifts for all participants. After the awards ceremony, a meal follows in the courtyard of the Holy Monastery of Koudouma. The race includes routes in mountainous areas, with transportation from Heraklion, and offers discounts to passengers of Anek Lines ships. Participation categories include various age and gender groups, with a 3-hour time limit.

name: Sougliani Trail
description: The Sougliani Trail race is a mountain running event held in Stavros, Thessaloniki. The route is a circular figure-eight shape, 50 kilometers long, with a positive elevation gain of 3,000 meters, offering a demanding and diverse experience within mixed forests and natural landscapes. The race includes trails, forest roads, and sections of asphalt, with 7 support stations and 6 control points. The start is located in the center of the village Stavros, next to the park and the Town Hall.
course_highlights: Circular route in the shape of an eight, 50 km long
Variety of vegetation with mixed hardleaf and deciduous forests
Positive elevation gain of 3,000 meters with 7 support stations
additional: The start is in the center of the village Stavros Thessaloniki, next to the park and the Town Hall. There are 7 support stations and 6 control points along the route. The course consists of 77% trail, 15% forest road, and 8% asphalt. The positive and negative elevation change is 3,000 meters. The route crosses a variety of forest habitats with rare fauna species such as wolves and jackals. The organization includes various race categories, registration is required, and the event hosts other activities and trail races.

description: The Dolichos Delphi - Olympia Running Race is a demanding ultramarathon of 255 kilometers lasting 48 hours, starting from Delphi and ending in Ancient Olympia. The route combines 60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails with 40% paved roads, crossing central Greece and the Peloponnese via the Rio-Antirrio bridge. The mountainous course reaches an altitude of up to 1100 meters with significant positive and negative elevation changes. The race is organized by the athletic club OLYMPIANS and invites runners who wish to test their endurance in a pioneering Greek race.
course_highlights: 255 km route with a duration of 48 hours
60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails, 40% paved roads
Mountainous route with an altitude up to 1100 meters and a total positive elevation gain of 5420 meters
additional: Transportation from Athens to Delphi and from Olympia to Athens is included, as well as accommodation and meals in Ancient Olympia after the race, feeding stations and medical support during the race, transportation in case of abandonment, a medal and commemorative diploma for finishers, guided tour of the archaeological site and museum of Ancient Olympia the next day. The race includes multiple routes (255 km, 144 km, 111 km), featuring natural beauty and a challenging course, and takes place over three days in April. Support points and electronic tracking are available.

name: Ε’ Δρόμος Γερακιού
description: The E' Gerakios Road is a special ultra-distance running race of 47.5 kilometers connecting the historic Byzantine castles of Mystras and Gerakio in Laconia. The race takes place on a paved route with significant elevation gain of up to 650 meters, offering a unique experience that combines sport, culture, and natural beauty. It is organized by the Greek Association of Long-Distance Runners "The Immortals" in collaboration with local authorities and has a strong local and athletic character. The start is from the Castle of Mystras and the finish line is at the central square of Gerakio, with a completion time limit of 7 hours.

Paved route with elevation difference from 420 to 650 meters
8 refreshment stations with volunteers along the route

The race has a completion time limit of 7 hours, ending at 22:00. There are exclusion points for safety and smooth conduct of the race. The race includes 8 refreshment stations, technical briefing, and a program with a pasta party. The route is paved and the finish time is 7 hours.

The children's race and walking route provide participation opportunities for younger ages and non-competitive runners. The event includes medals, a light meal, and juice for participants, while timing is supervised by the organizing committee. With medical coverage and Pontic festivities after the race, it is a celebration for the local community and runners.

My Adventure, with many years of experience in organizing sports events in Epirus, supports this event, combining the natural environment and the mountainous terrain of the region. The race is aimed at runners who wish to enjoy nature and the athletic challenge in a beautiful mountain landscape.

Natural environment of the village of Koutselio
Organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Ioannina

The organization combines sports and local natural beauty, creating a celebration for mountain running enthusiasts.

Mountain running in a natural environment

description: The 4th Mountain Race of Handrino is organized by the Athletic and Cultural Association of Handrino 'HANDRINIKOS' and will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, in Handrino, Messinia. It features mountain races with routes of 11 km and 6 km, as well as a children's running race of 1 km. The course starts from the 'Platania' park within the settlement and ends at the top of the conical Mount Prophet Elias, offering panoramic views of all of Messinia and the surrounding landscapes. The race combines natural beauty, athletic challenge, and local tradition, inviting runners and visitors to enjoy a unique mountain running experience.
course_highlights: Route of 11 km and 6 km on mountain trail starting from 'Platania' park in Handrino settlement
Arrival at the top of Mount Prophet Elias (620 meters altitude) with panoramic views of Messinia, Mani, Taygetus, and nearby islands
Children's running race of 1 km starting at 10:15 a.m.
additional: The races start at 10:00 a.m. for the 11 km and 6 km mountain routes, while the children's race of 1 km begins at 10:15 a.m. The course includes a trail with unique views and is suitable for runners seeking mountain challenge. The settlement of Handrino has approximately 600 residents and is located in the Municipality of Pylos-Nestor, Messinia. Technical mountain running routes with sections of high difficulty and impressive scenery, suitable for experienced runners and nature lovers.

description: The 5th Istipetis Sacrifice Run is a mountain race of 14 kilometers with 600 meters of positive elevation gain, held at the Istipetis Fortress near Nea Petritsi, Serres. The race is organized by the Friends of Istipetis Fortress Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Sintiki, as part of the 85th anniversary of the fortress battle. The purpose of the event is to preserve historical memory through sports and to highlight the natural wealth of the area. The route includes passages over the surface of the fortifications of the Metaxas Line, where defenders faced the German war machinery in 1941.
course_highlights: Mountain race 14.6 km with positive elevation gain
Route through Istipetis Fortress and the Metaxas Line
Passage through historic sites of the fortress battle
additional: The race takes place at the Greek-Bulgarian border, in the northern part of Serres Prefecture. The organization honors the historical memory of the fortress battle and promotes the natural wealth of the area. No information was found regarding participation fees, start times, or registration procedures. Routes approximately 14 km and 600 m, historical and cultural significance, includes a race with historical and cultural character, routes with GPS and smartwatch, start at 10:00 AM.

name: Lake Plastiras Trail
description: The Lake Plastiras Trail is a festive mountain running race held in the beautiful area of Lake Plastiras in Karditsa, Greece. The race routes cross the historic mountain massif of the Agrafa mountains, offering unique natural landscapes, a variety of terrains, and significant elevation changes. The start is from the Botanical Garden of the Municipality of Lake Plastiras, next to the lake, and participants have the opportunity to enjoy routes that combine trails, dirt roads, and asphalt. The race promotes sports, entertainment, and the highlighting of nature and the local history of the area.
course_highlights: Variety of terrains: trails, dirt roads, asphalt
High elevations with views of Lake Plastiras and the Agrafa mountains
Start and finish at the Botanical Garden of Neohori, on the lake shore
additional: The races include five routes: 42 km (+2400m elevation gain) starting at 08:00, 23 km (+1150m elevation gain) starting at 10:00, 10 km (+100m elevation gain) starting at 11:00, 5 km (+100m elevation gain) on Saturday 18/4 at 18:00, and a children's race of 600m at 11:10. There are hydration and feeding stations. The 23 km route includes technical descent and the highest point at 1808m. The 5 km route is circular and suitable for beginners. The organization promotes health, entertainment, and the highlighting of nature and local history. The event features routes with technical difficulties, participants from Greece and abroad, and safety and health programs. There are also activities and accommodation options in the area.

description: The Run Greece Sparta 2026 race offers a unique road running experience in the historic city of Sparta. Participants can take part in 10km, 5km, children's race, and Family Run, covering different levels of runners and ages. The route starts from the Statue of Leonidas and provides support with stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing. Finisher medal and official T-shirt are included, combining sports and culture in a welcoming event.
course_highlights: Start from the Statue of Leonidas in Sparta
10km route through the historic city
Support stations and medical coverage during the race
additional: Participation in the 10km race includes a registration number with an integrated electronic timing chip, online results announcement, support stations, medical services, finisher medal, participation certificate, and official T-shirt. Medical coverage is organized with volunteer rescuers along the route. Registration is only possible with a card, and registrations without a fee are automatically canceled. The children's race and Family Run are free. Registration and material pickup are at the Sparta Indoor Municipal Gymnasium, with many race categories and parallel activities.

name: 10ο No Finish Line Athens
description: The No Finish Line Athens is Greece's largest charity running event, combining sports, recreation, and social contribution. Participants run or walk freely for 100 hours, recording kilometers that are converted into money to support children's programs through the organization "Mazi gia to Paidi". The event takes place at Pedion tou Areos and is a leading social and athletic event with high participation and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Held at Pedion tou Areos
Duration of 100 hours with free participation in time and distance
Charitable nature with conversion of kilometers into financial support
additional: The race lasts 100 hours, and participants can run or walk whenever they want, without time or distance restrictions. The event is supported by the international organization No Finish Line International and the organization "Mazi gia to Paidi". It has a large social reach with over 50,000 participants since 2017 and significant funding for children's programs. The event includes various competitions, aiming to record over 100,000 kilometers, and takes place at Pedion tou Areos, emphasizing collective effort and social contribution.

name: 24ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καλαμάτας
description: The 24th Kalamata Running Race is an official 10-kilometer race organized by the Messinia Health Runners Club and is dedicated to the Special Kindergarten and Special School. The course is certified by World Athletics and SEGAS, flat, paved, and fast, along the Kalamata beach, with start and finish lines at the Central Square. There are also parallel events, such as a 10 km power walk, a 1.5 km children's race, and a 500 m Special Olympics race. The race offers official times and support for runners along the route.
course_highlights: Certified course by World Athletics and SEGAS
Flat, paved, and fast course along the beach
Start and finish at Kalamata Central Square
additional: Support stations are available at 5 km and 7.5 km along the route. Pace runners are available. Participation is open to individuals aged 15 and above for the 10 km race, 12 and above for the 10 km power walk, and children and parents for the 1.5 km children's race. The 500 m Special Olympics race is for people with disabilities (AΜΕΑ) with escorts. Registrations are conducted online. The event includes participation in various categories, online registration, and a free children's race. The start and finish are at Kalamata Central Square, with approximately 2,000 participants of all ages.

name: Η Μάχη στο Λεβίδι 14-04-1821 «Αναγνώστης Δημήτριος Στριφτόμπολας»
organizer: Δήμος Τρίπολης, Γυμναστικός Σύλλογος Αρκαδίας, Σύνδεσμος Σωματικής Αγωγής
description: The Municipality of Tripoli in collaboration with the SEGAS Peloponnese Region, the Athletic Club of Arcadia, and the Physical Education Association 'Orochemos' organize the road race and power walking event titled 'The Battle at Levidi 14-04-1821 (Dimitrios Striftompolas)'. The races are dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turkish conquerors that took place in Levidi 205 years ago. The event includes routes of 10km, 5km, and 1000m and is held at the central square of Levidi. The organization honors the historic victory and offers a celebration of sport and memory for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Routes of 10km, 5km, and 1000m at the central square of Levidi
Dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turks in 1821
Historical and sporting event with a strong local and cultural character
additional: Race schedule: 16:00 opening of the secretariat and distribution of race packs, 18:00 start of 10km, 18:10 start of 5km, 19:20 start of 1000m, 19:45 end of finishes, 19:50 awards, 20:15 end of the event with celebration and recognition of the historic battle. Routes in a historic area, participation across various age categories, start and finish in Levidi, with souvenirs and cultural activities.

name: 3ος Παλλήνιος Δρόμος
price_range: 8€ για 5χλμ., 10€ για 10χλμ., δωρεάν για το παιδικό 1χλμ.
