description: The 3rd Panhellenic Race is a sports and cultural event held in Pallini, Attica, offering 5 km and 10 km road races as well as a 1,000-meter children's race. The race takes place on a certified World Athletics route, mainly within beautiful Mediterranean nature with vineyards and olive groves, on paved paths with slight elevation changes. The start is from Eleftherias Square in Pallini, with a start time of 8:30 a.m. The event is supported by local clubs and has a charitable character. Participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration during the race.
course_highlights: Certified route by World Athletics
Routes through Mediterranean nature with vineyards and olive groves
Paved routes with slight elevation changes
additional: Registrations are only available online using a debit/credit card. No registrations are accepted on the day of the race. Group registration options and special rates for large families are available. All participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration. The routes are paved with slight elevation changes, participation is allowed from age 6 with parental consent, registration deadline is April 15, 2026, and no registrations are accepted on race day.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Ορεινού Τρεξίματος «Αλέξανδρος Παναγούλης»
description: The 5th Mountain Running Race "Alexandros Panagoulis" in Syvro, Lefkada is a celebration of sports and nature offering a unique experience on trails filled with springs and lush landscapes. The race honors the memory of Alexandros Panagoulis and attracts athletes of all ages who enjoy the mountain route and friendly environment. The event is characterized by energy, smiles, and impressive performances, creating an unforgettable athletic experience.
course_highlights: Trails among springs and lush landscapes
Mountain route in Syvro, Lefkada
Honoring Alexandros Panagoulis
additional: Organized with emphasis on safety, hospitality, and highlighting the natural beauty of the area, with online registration and detailed results.

name: 8ο Kissavos Marathon Race Ευάγγελος Κουμπάρος
description: The Kissavos Marathon Race «Evangelos Koumparos» is an annual mountain running event held in the area of Agia, Larissa. The route starts from the square of Agia and crosses enchanting forest trails, picturesque mountain villages, and natural springs, reaching the top of Mount Kissavos at 1,978 meters with stunning views of the Aegean Sea. The race offers a unique experience in a protected scenic forest, part of the NATURA 2000 network. The organization also includes shorter routes and a children's race, with full support and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Route through fairy-tale forests of firs, oaks, oaks, and chestnuts
Natural springs and picturesque mountain villages with squares and chapels
Kissavos summit at 1,978 meters with a view of the Aegean Sea
additional: Rating from ITRA and UTMB. Amenities: kilometer markers, medical support, medal for all participants, net time measurement, refreshments at multiple points, food, sweets, and fruit for athletes. The race will take place on May 2, 2027, in Agia Larissa, with online registration through the official website. It includes various routes in mountainous terrain, emphasizing nature and the beauty of the area.

name: 10ο Run For All
description: The 10th Papagou - Cholargos City Run «RUN4ALL» is an annual event honoring World Autism Awareness Day and supporting participation of individuals with intellectual disabilities and relatives with heart conditions. The race includes routes of 1 km for children, and 5 and 10 km for adults and students, with electronic timing and commemorative gifts for all participants. The proceeds support the «Champs» basketball teams of the Cholargos Basketball Club, which are aimed at children on the autism spectrum. The event takes place in the Municipality of Papagou - Cholargos and offers a 50% discount to residents with a special coupon.
course_highlights: Children's route of 1 km with participation of children on the autism spectrum
Races of 5 and 10 km with electronic timing and classification
Organized in the Municipality of Papagou - Cholargos with support from local sports clubs
additional: 50% discount for residents of Papagou-Cholargos with coupon DC2550. Elementary and middle school children participate free in the 1 km children's route. All participants receive a technical T-Shirt, medal, water, snack, and surprises. Group registration requires two steps: payment and filling in participant details before the race. Distances of 5 km and 10 km, children's route of 1 km, support with water and snacks, medals and souvenirs, presence of a doctor and ambulance.

name: 11ος Μαραθώνιος Ρόδου
description: The 11th TUI Rhodes Marathon is an international marathon held on a flat, seaside route next to the walls of the Medieval City of Rhodes, offering a unique view of the Aegean Sea. The 42.195 km course consists of two half-marathon turns and is designed to highlight the island's cultural and natural landscape. Alongside the marathon, half-marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km children's race are organized, providing options for runners of all levels. The event has international recognition and is supported by local authorities and volunteers, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Flat seaside route next to the walls of the Medieval City
View of the endless blue of the Aegean Sea
Course with cultural and natural scenery, UNESCO monument
additional: All participants receive electronic timing with chip, commemorative medal, electronic diploma, water, sports drinks, gels, bananas, medical services, and sports massage at the finish line. There is an official t-shirt and sponsor gifts. The marathon must be completed within 6 hours, the half-marathon within 3 hours, and the 10 km race within 100 minutes. The event is supported by local authorities and organizations, emphasizing the island's cultural and natural beauty, and includes various activities and volunteer participation.

name: 17ος Διεθνής Ποσειδώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
price_range: 35€ - 50€ (ανάλογα με την ημερομηνία εγγραφής και το πακέτο)
description: The 17th International Poseidon Half Marathon in Palaio Faliro offers beautiful and fast routes along the sea, ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes parallel races such as relay, quarter marathon, 5 km race, power walking, and a children's race, creating a sports and social contribution celebration. Participants enjoy high-quality technical t-shirts and have the opportunity to download performance certificates and race photos. The organization takes care of runners' comfort and information with a digital secretary assistant and a full race program.
course_highlights: Beautiful and fast routes along the sea
Routes for half marathon, relay, quarter marathon, and 5 km
Packet pickup at the Municipal Indoor Gymnasium of Palaio Faliro
additional: Packet pickup takes place at the Municipal Indoor Gymnasium of Palaio Faliro "Sofia Befon". Participants receive a high-quality technical t-shirt and a cotton t-shirt for children and adults. There is a digital secretary assistant "Floisvos" for immediate support. After the race, runners can download performance certificates and photos from the official results website. Routes pass through significant points such as the Battleship "Averof" and the Flisvos Marina, with start and finish at the Palaio Faliro Municipal Sports Center. There are parallel races and events, as well as online registration and photo activities.

name: 17o Μονοπάτι Παρνασσού
description: The 17th Parnassos Trail is a major mountain running festival held in Amfikleia Fthiotida. The event includes seven races for all ages and fitness levels, with routes starting and ending at the 25th March Square. The two-day event features children's races, the Amfikleia City Trail through the streets of the traditional settlement, as well as mountain races of 6, 12, and 25 kilometers with significant elevation gain. The event combines athletic activity with local tradition and natural beauty, offering a comprehensive experience for participants.
course_highlights: Technical mountain route of 25 km with 1610m elevation gain
4 km route through the cobblestone streets of the traditional settlement of Amfikleia
Variety of races for all ages and fitness levels
additional: All races start and finish at the 25th March Square in Amfikleia. The registration desk operates at the atrium of the Cultural Center in the square. Saturday afternoon includes children's races and the Amfikleia City Trail, while Saturday evening features a Pasta Party for participants. Awards are given on Saturday evening for the children's races and the City Trail, and on Sunday afternoon for the mountain races. The event also includes children's races, electronic registration, and support activities such as the pasta party. The event takes place on April 25-26, 2026, aiming to promote sports and nature.

name: 20ός Διεθνής Μαραθώνιος «Μέγας Αλέξανδρος»
description: The International Marathon "Alexander the Great" covers the route from Pella, the ancient capital of Macedonia and birthplace of Alexander the Great, to Thessaloniki, the modern Greek metropolis. It is a race that combines sports with history and culture, offering a unique experience through a course filled with Greece and ancient Greek culture. The marathon is an important international sporting event with parallel activities and races for all ages and categories.
course_highlights: Route from ancient Pella to Thessaloniki
Beautiful landscapes and historical sites along the course
Combination of sports and culture
additional: There are 1,000m running races for elementary school students, 5km and 10km races, as well as a national marathon championship for persons with disabilities. Parallel events, informational seminars, and cultural activities are available. Group registration for teams of 10 or more is supported. Technical instructions and participation certificates are provided. The event includes 5km, 10km, and marathon races, along with parallel activities and exhibitions.

name: Ηετιώνιος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The Hetionios Road Race of Drapetsona, under the auspices of the Municipality of Keratsini-Drapetsona and the Region of Attica, invites runners of all ages to participate in a celebration of sports and culture. The route starts from the old town hall of Drapetsona and is designed with respect to the area's historical and cultural heritage. With a friendly atmosphere and excellent organization, the race offers an opportunity for participation, health, and collective identity. There are routes for adults, children, and people with disabilities, providing a unique experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the old town hall of Drapetsona
5 km route heading east
Children's race and 500-meter race for people with disabilities
additional: The finish time for the 5 km route is 1 hour, after which runners proceed at their own responsibility. Participants under 18 years old need a parental or guardian's responsible statement. Registrations on the day of the race are not allowed. Ceremonies and results in local organization, participation in various categories, respect for the area's history and culture.

name: Go Kea
description: The GO KEA is an exciting two-day sports event that combines mountain running (trail running) and open water swimming on the beautiful island of Kea. The organization aims to offer an authentic sports experience and contact with nature, establishing Kea as a unique sports destination. The two-day event gathers athletes and friends from all over Greece and abroad, offering a variety of activities in a enchanting Cycladic landscape.
course_highlights: Mountain running on natural trails of Kea
Open water swimming in the clear waters of the island
Contact with nature and the unique Cycladic landscape
additional: The event is organized in collaboration with GOEvents. Information is provided about ferry routes from Lavrio to Kea and local transportation. There is an option to register for a contact list for updates regarding the Municipality of Kea and the events. The organization includes trail running and open water swimming routes, with emphasis on safety, preparation, and enjoyment of nature. Participants can pre-register and enjoy a comprehensive outdoor activity experience.

name: 2o Rodopi Backyard Ultra
description: The Rodopi Backyard Ultra race is a demanding ultra marathon of the backyard ultra type held in the Komotini area. It is a endurance race where runners are required to run repeated laps of 6.7 kilometers every hour until only one winner remains. The route is mountainous and offers unique natural beauty of Rhodope, combining technical trails and elevation changes. The race is organized by the Rodopi Runners club, which ensures excellent organization and support for participants.
course_highlights: Mountainous route with technical trails
Repeated laps of 6.7 kilometers every hour
Unique natural beauty of the Rhodope region
additional: The race takes place in hourly cycles, where runners must complete the 6.7 km lap within the hour to continue. There is refreshment along the route and support from the organizer. The race has regulations governing safety and participation, available on the official website. The terrain is outdoor and competitive, emphasizing endurance and participant support. The organization includes logistical and medical coverage.

name: 4ο Heyday Road IV
description: The Heyday Road is an international ultramarathon held in Greece, featuring two routes: Sparta - Ancient Olympia (165.96 km) and Sparta - Megalopoli (72.80 km). The race is characterized by paved roads and minimal dirt paths, with checkpoints equipped with supplies and medical support. The route passes through the village of Georgitsi, the highest point at 900 meters above sea level, offering a unique ultramarathon experience with cultural and historical significance. The race is conducted under strict medical and police supervision, with time limits at major checkpoints.
course_highlights: 165.96 km route from Sparta to Ancient Olympia and 72.80 km to Megalopoli
Highest point at the village of Georgitsi at 900 meters altitude
99.6% paved road with fully equipped checkpoints approximately every 5 km
additional: The race lasts up to 27 hours (15 hours for the route to Megalopoli). Major checkpoints Pelana, Megalopoli, and Andritsaina have time limits and disqualification rules for athletes who do not comply. At checkpoints, water, soft drinks, fruits, snacks, coffee, tea, meals, and medical support with doctors, nurses, and ambulances are provided. The race includes routes of 165.9 km and 72.8 km, emphasizing the historical and local beauty of the area.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Υγείας Αντιπάρου
description: The 8th Antiparos Health Run is a celebration of sports and health that invites runners of all ages to participate in routes of 5km, 10km, and 24.4km, as well as hiking and children's routes. The routes are safe, by the sea, and within the picturesque village of Antiparos, offering a unique view and experience. The event ensures safety and cleanliness of the island, supported by volunteers and local authorities. The race is an opportunity for sporting gathering and enjoyment of Antiparos' natural environment.
course_highlights: 24.4km asphalt route with 280m elevation change by the sea
10km circular coastal route with 3 refreshment stations
5km and 5.5km hiking routes and 1km Fun Race for children
additional: The road is monitored by police and volunteers with fluorescent vests. There are water and supply stations along the routes. Measures are in place to maintain the cleanliness of the island with special bins for empty water bottles. Information is provided about transportation from Paros to Antiparos. There are routes for all ages and runner levels, as well as a children's Fun Race. The event includes running races and hikes, emphasizing safety and enjoyment of the island. Participation is confirmed upon payment completion, and the finish line is at the port of Antiparos.

name: 14ο Corfu Mountain Trail
description: The 14th Corfu Mountain Trail is a series of four unique mountain running races held on the island of Corfu. The routes include the CMT Ultra 103 km with a climb to Mount Pantokrator, the Rain Trail 44 km, the Olive Tree Trail 24 km, and the Quick Trail 12 km, offering stunning views of the sea and traditional villages. The finish line is in the heart of Corfu town, at Liston, providing a special experience for each runner. The event collaborates with the Municipality of Central Corfu and the Diapontia Islands, offering an unforgettable athletic adventure.
course_highlights: Climb to the highest point of the island, Mount Pantokrator
Routes passing through traditional villages and beaches with views of the Adriatic
Finish at the historic center of Corfu town, at Liston
additional: The Ultra Trail 103 km starts from the village of Ypsos at 06:00 with transportation from Corfu town center. The other routes start on the same day with transfers from Liston. All races finish at Spianada Square in Corfu town. RaceTracker is used for the 103 km and 44 km routes. A children’s race without charge takes place on Sunday, May 9. Multiple routes, scenic mountain and beach trails, registration via the official website from June 2025 to April 2026, detailed schedule and transportation information.

name: Amorgos Trail Challenge
description: The Amorgos Trail Challenge is an entertainment mountain running race organized by the Naturalist - Hiking Association of Amorgos "Palia Strata". Its purpose is to highlight the beauty of Amorgos and bring together athletes and residents through sports, cultural, and gastronomic events. The two-day event includes races of different distances, such as the Spike, 7.5 km, and 20.5 km, as well as a children's race. The organization invites everyone to experience authentic moments of hospitality and sportsmanship on the beautiful island of Amorgos.
course_highlights: Trails with traditional paths (up to 85% on the 7.5 km and 80% on the 20.5 km)
Start of the 20.5 km race from the historic Monastery of Panagia Chozoviotissa
Positive elevation of 350 m for the 7.5 km and 850 m for the 20.5 km
additional: The races take place over two days with the Spike on Friday and the 7.5 km and 20.5 km races on Saturday. There are refueling stations with salty snacks, sweets, fruits, isotonic drinks, and water. Essential equipment includes a water bottle. Electronic timing is done with a chip, and there are cut-off times (2.5 hours for 7.5 km and 5 hours for 20.5 km). There is also a children's race, Loza Kids Race, and group registration discounts for 10 or more participants. The event includes children's races, as well as cultural and nature activities, aimed at promoting sports and local culture on the island.

name: ROC 50 Miles
description: The Rodopi Challenge 50 Miles (ROC) is an introductory mountain ultra trail race of 89 kilometers with a positive elevation gain of 4,800 meters, organized every spring in the Rodopi mountain range by the non-profit organization Rodopi Ultra Trail AMKE. The route is loop-shaped, starting and ending at the Erymanthos Forest Village, crossing villages, ancient forests, and mountain trails. The race is aimed at experienced athletes wishing to get acquainted with the spirit of ultra trail races, offering a demanding and unique mountain running experience. The start is early in the morning, and participants have a time limit of 19.5 hours to complete the race.
course_highlights: 89 km route with 72% trails, 25% dirt roads, and 3% asphalt
Total positive elevation gain of 4800 meters
Passage through ancient forests, villages, and mountain trails with intense natural beauty
additional: Maximum number of participants is 300 athletes. The race closes at 00:30 on the same day, providing a time limit of 19.5 hours. A mandatory participation criterion is the completion or abandonment of at least a 40 km mountain running race after 1/1/2024. The route is part of the ROUT Classic 100 miles and is loop-shaped. The race includes routes on natural trails and offers accommodation options in campsites and hotels, mainly accessible by road and rail. There are also family events and other shorter-distance routes.

name: 1ο Φάλανθος Trail
description: The Phalanthos Trail is the first mountain running race in Mainalo, organized by the Arcadian Mountaineers Ecologists Club. The race highlights the rich natural and cultural environment of the mountainous Arcadia, promoting the protection of biodiversity and landscape. The route utilizes the extensive network of trails in Mainalo, offering a unique experience for runners and hikers. The Phalanthos Trail 29km is an official criterion for the Olympus Marathon, confirming the quality and prestige of the race.
course_highlights: 29 km route through the dense trail network of Mainalo
Rich natural and cultural environment of mountainous Arcadia
Official criterion for the Olympus Marathon
additional: The race promotes the protection of the natural environment and biodiversity. There are 11 km hiking routes parallel to the running races. Available technical T-shirt, CHIP timing, hydration, feeding stations, medical coverage, registrations with card and chip, limited number of participants (150 for 29km, 200 for 11km, 100 for 11km hikers).

name: 3ος Εργατικός Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 3rd Workers' People's Race, organized by the Workers' Centers of Athens and Piraeus, is a race with a historical and political character, dedicated to the memory of the 200 communists executed in Kaisariani on May 1, 1944. The route starts from the Haidari Camp and ends at the Kaisariani Shooting Range, honoring their sacrifice and keeping the historical memory alive. The race has been embraced by trade unions and is open to all who wish to walk in the footsteps of history. The start is early in the morning, and all participants receive commemorative medals, with the top three men and women in the overall ranking being awarded.
course_highlights: Route from Haidari Camp to Kaisariani Shooting Range
Historical and political character dedicated to the 200 executed communists
Commemorative event with awards and medals
additional: The start is from the Haidari Camp "Karaiskaki A" - Block 15, with the finish at the Kaisariani Shooting Range. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 11 a.m. Participation calls are made by PAME. All finishers receive commemorative medals. The event includes ceremonies and a race with registration until April 30, with the finish at the Kaisariani Shooting Range, awards, and medals.

name: 5o Pamvotis View Trail
description: The 5th Pamvotis View Trail is a mountain running race organized in Drosohori Ioannina, offering two routes with the backdrop of the enchanting Lake Pamvotis and the impressive mountains of the area. The start and finish are at the village square, with routes passing through picturesque points such as Mavili, Drisko, Gerakari, and Iliokali. The race is open to runners of all levels, providing a unique experience of nature and adventure close to the city of Ioannina. The organization ensures medical coverage and refreshment stations for the safety and comfort of participants.
course_highlights: Two routes: 21 km with +1,150m elevation and 9 km with +420m elevation
Refill stations at 6, 13, and 17 km of the 21 km route
Sources with drinking water at 7, 15, and 19 km of the 21 km route
additional: Medical coverage is provided by volunteers of the Hellenic Red Cross Ioannina and a private doctor, with a portable defibrillator available. Participants must be over 18 years old; minors require a responsible statement and parental accompaniment. Routes with refill stations, medical coverage from the Red Cross and a private doctor, and finish time limits of 2 and 5 hours respectively.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Λιμένων Μεγάρων – Νέας Περάμου
location: Λιμάνι Νέας Περάμου, Νέα Πέραμος, Μεγαρέα, Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 9th Port Run Megara - Nea Peramos is a sporting event organized by the Local Councils of the Municipal Communities of Megara and Nea Peramos in collaboration with the Deputy Mayor of Sports & Youth of the Municipality of Megara and the athletic club "Athenaeoi Runners". It includes routes of 9 and 18 kilometers, as well as a 1000-meter children's race. The race aims to promote sports and highlight the natural beauty and historical significance of the area. The start is at the port of Nea Peramos and the port of Pachi Megara, with a common finish at the port of Pachi Megara.
course_highlights: Routes of 9,050m and 18,100m
Start at the port of Nea Peramos (9 km) and at the port of Pachi Megara (18 km)
Common finish at the port of Pachi Megara
additional: The timing is done electronically with RFID chip. There are refreshment stations with drinks, water, and medical support. The finish time limit for the 18 km is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Participation is open to adults and minors with a responsible declaration. The 1000m children's race is for children born between 2014 and 2020. The event is organized in collaboration with local municipal authorities, emphasizing the promotion of sports and social cohesion at the port of Nea Peramos.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Πυθαγόρας ο Σάμιος
description: The 9th Pythagoras of Samos Half Marathon is an important athletic event held in Samos, starting from the Heraion Column. The race honors the memory of Pythagoras, the great philosopher and mathematician of antiquity, and attracts runners from all over Greece. The route offers a unique running experience in a historic and scenic environment, combining sports and culture. The event is organized by the Primary Education Directorate of Samos, ensuring smooth conduct and participant safety.
course_highlights: Start at the Heraion Column, a historic site of Samos
Route with views of the Aegean Sea
Combination of cultural and athletic environment
additional: Routes through natural and cultural sites, starting from the Heraion Column, finishing at the Pythagoras central square, with water and isotonic support, and cultural activities.

name: 14ος Βατικιώτικος Αγώνας
organizer: ΓΕΛ Νεάπολης, 1ο ΕΠΑΛ Βοιών, Γυμνάσιο Νεάπολης, Δημοτικό Σχολείο Νεάπολης, Περιφέρεια Πελοποννήσου, Δήμος Μονεμβασίας
description: The 14th Vatikiotikos Race in Neapoli Lakonias is a unique running experience that combines sports with the local community and the natural beauty of the area. The event includes 10-kilometer and 1-mile (1,600 meters) races for children and families, offering a celebration of participation and effort. The certified route ensures safety and validity, while parallel activities such as athlete talks and the Pasta Party promote camaraderie and sportsmanship. The organization is supported by the educational community, the Peloponnese Region, and the Municipality of Monemvasia, creating a two-day athletic event full of energy and smiles.
course_highlights: Certified 10-kilometer route with intermediate timing
Children's 1-mile race (1,600 meters) - Family Run
Feeding stations and medical coverage along the route
additional: The start of all routes is in front of the Merchant Navy Academy of Laconia. Packet pickup is at the registration desk at the race start on Saturday 02/05/2026 (10:00-12:00) and Sunday 03/05/2026 (07:00-09:15 for 10 km, 07:00-10:00 for 1 mile). Participants must clearly display their race number. The last registration date is Sunday, May 3, 2026, 30 minutes before each race begins. Medical coverage and volunteer support are available along the route. The 10 km race is open to adults and children over 12 years old, while the 1-mile race is for children over 6 years old or younger with accompaniment. The event, scheduled for May 2-3, 2026, includes talks, awards, a pasta party, and volunteer activities.

name: 15η Ανοπαία Ατραπός
organizer: Δήμος Λαμιέων και Σύλλογος Δρομέων Φθιώτιδας
description: The 15th Anopaia Trail is an iconic mountain running race held in Thermopylae, an area of historical and natural beauty. The race is at the heart of mountain running in the region, offering a unique experience for runners who love challenge and nature. The event is organized by the Municipality of Lamia, which supports the promotion of sports and the natural environment of the area. The event attracts runners from all over Greece and is a celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Route through the historic Thermopylae
Mountain and natural landscape with intense natural beauty
Challenging terrain for mountain runners
additional: Technical T-Shirt available, finish line at a historic site, registration until April 24, 2026, with written permission from a parent or guardian, and the possibility of online participation.

name: 15ος Ιπποκράτειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 15th Hippocrates Race is a popular running event organized in the city of Larissa, featuring routes of 10 km, Fun Run 3 km, and a children's race of 1000 meters. The 10 km route is paved, without significant uphill gradients, passing along the bed of the Pinios River and city monuments, offering a beautiful experience for runners. The race has a family character, with the possibility of minors participating under parental responsibility. Technical t-shirt, electronic timing, collectible medal, and water are provided to participants.
course_highlights: Paved route without significant uphill gradients
Route along the bed of the Pinios River
Passing through monuments of the city of Larissa
additional: Facilities: technical t-shirt, electronic timing, collectible medal, water. Parental declaration required for minors. Start and finish at Ancient Theatre of Larissa. Children's race with free participation and commemorative medals for all finishers. Registrations until April 27, 2026, payment at the club's offices, participation in various categories and distances, emphasizing the cultural and athletic tradition of the region.

name: Εορδαία Run
description: The Eordaia Run race is an important sporting event hosted in the Municipality of Eordaia. Its purpose is to highlight the values of sportsmanship, cultivate the spirit of fair competition, and strengthen the mass running movement. It includes a 10-kilometer road race and a 1,000-meter children's race, offering a beautiful athletic experience for all participants. The event emphasizes safety and smooth conduct, with support for transportation of runners and a registration office for bib collection.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer road race
1,000-meter children's race
Transportation of runners by buses from the community of Kryovrysi
additional: The registration office operates from 15:30 for bib collection. Buses transport runners from 16:15 to 16:45. Due to a date change, those who have already paid cannot participate and must contact via email for a refund. The races include a 10-kilometer run and a 1,000-meter children's race, along with related events. Date: April 17, 2026. Location: Ptolemaida, Greece.

name: Λαφονήσιος Δρόμος
location: Μονή Παναγίας Χρυσοσκαλίτισσας, Χανιά, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
organizer: Μορφωτικός, Πολιτιστικός και Αθλητικός Σύλλογος Βάθης “ΜΟΥΣΑΓΟΡΕΣ”
description: The Lafonissios Race is a historic running event held in the area of the Monastery of Panagia Chryssoskali in Chania, Crete. Dedicated to the memory of those massacred in 1824 on the island of Lafonisi, it includes a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km, a popular race of 7.8 km, and a children's race of 1.1 km. The routes start from historic sites and end at the courtyard of the Holy Monastery, offering a unique experience combining sports, history, and culture. The organization is carried out in collaboration with local clubs and agencies, inviting runners of all ages to participate in this celebration of memory and sports.
course_highlights: Half marathon 21.1 km starting from the Xotikospilio and ending at the Holy Monastery of Panagia Chryssoskali
Popular race 7.8 km with route Livadia - Chryssoskali
Children's race 1.1 km on a circular route in the settlement of Chryssoskali
additional: Volunteers receive special clothing, refreshments from aid stations, and free transportation by the event's bus. All races finish at the courtyard of the Holy Monastery of Panagia Chryssoskali. The event includes three routes: half marathon 21.1 km, popular race 7.8 km, children's race 1.1 km. Participation is only possible online, with free transportation for participants and a limited number of spots. The race takes place on public roads and has a historical and cultural character.

name: Run Greece Καβάλα
description: The Run Greece Kavala race is an athletic event that includes 10 km, 5 km routes, and power walking, as well as races for families and children. The event promotes sports and healthy living in the city of Kavala, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all ages and levels. The organization is supported by SEGAS and is part of the national Run Greece program. The start and finish are held at central points in the city, with safe and scenic routes.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and 5 km in an urban environment
Power walking and races for children and families
Organized event with SEGAS support
additional: Includes road races for adults, power walking, Family Run, and races for children. The event promotes the I Run Clean program and safety in sports. There is a mobile app related to the race. Participants can register online, with participation materials collected from the service center in Kavala. The route includes two laps around the city, and the organization encourages sports and social participation.

name: Voio Race Series – Μπούρινος
description: VoioRace is a series of four running races held at different locations within the Municipality of Voio, aimed at promoting health, wellness, and social cohesion. The event is organized voluntarily with the help of volunteers and is open to individuals over 15 years old. The routes are mountainous and offer an opportunity for walking, running, and enjoying nature. Participation is considered a victory and finishing is a triumph, promoting sports as an important part of life.
course_highlights: Four running races at different locations within the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountainous routes
Promotion of health, wellness, and social responsibility
additional: Participants must be over 15 years old. Minors require parental consent to participate. The organization is supported by volunteers and promotes social cohesion and environmental responsibility. Four running races at different locations within the Municipality of Voio, with various routes and activities that strengthen the local community and active living.

name: Messinia Challenge 2026
description: The Messinia Challenge 2026 is a multifaceted sporting event held in Pylos, Messinia, offering three running routes: the Greek Half Marathon, a 10-kilometer route, and a shorter 5.4-kilometer route. The courses combine asphalt, dirt roads, and seaside trails, providing a unique experience in a natural environment with views of the Gialova lagoon and Natura 2000 landscapes. The event attracts athletes of all levels and ages, while also offering a rich program of activities and cultural events. The organization is hosted in luxury resorts in the area, enhancing the participants' experience.
course_highlights: Greek Half Marathon 21.1 km with mixed terrain (40% asphalt, 56% dirt road, 4% sand)
10 km route with 50% asphalt and 47% dirt road
Short route 5.4 km with 80% dirt road and 20% asphalt, next to the Gialova lagoon
additional: The program includes numerous sports and cultural activities, such as seminars, climbing lessons, water sports, and cooking challenges. Accommodation packages are available at luxury resorts Costa Navarino and The Romanos, with special amenities for participants. Participants can also enjoy activities such as kite surfing, windsurfing, wing foiling, and many more. The Messinia Challenge 2026 is Greece's first fully sustainable running event, with over 5,500 participants from 34 countries and a focus on environmental responsibility, inclusion, and community.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Πλατανοθεραπεία»
description: The 2nd 'Platanotherapia' Running Race in Dávleia is a special race held amidst the natural beauty of the village. The event includes three routes and is aimed at runners who wish to enjoy the scenery and the athletic experience in a friendly environment. The race is organized by the Municipality of Levadia, the Dávleia Community, and the Pandauleiakos team, with a start time of 17:30. It is a beautiful athletic event that supports the local community and promotes love for sports.
course_highlights: Three different routes through the natural beauty of Dávleia
Held in the mountainous environment of Parnassus
Start at 17:30 for an enjoyable afternoon athletic experience
additional: The race is organized by the Municipality of Levadia, the Dávleia Community, and the Pandauleiakos team. The start is from Dávleia, an area of Parnassus. No information was found regarding registration fees or registration process. Participation requires pre-registration. The start takes place on Saturday 15/05/2027 from 17:30 to 17:50. The route covers approximately 5 kilometers and includes natural landscapes and athletic activities.

name: 4ο Triantafilia Mountain Trail Races
description: The 4th Triantafilia Mountain Trail Races are organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Panta Vrechi in the region of Southern Evrytania. These are mountain races with routes crossing trails and dirt roads with beautiful natural scenery and significant elevation changes. The start is from the Tournou square, and the 10 km route includes trails such as the Waterfalls Trail and the Pilgrims Trail. The race is aimed at runners who love mountain running and contact with nature.
course_highlights: Trails with natural beauty such as the Waterfalls Trail
Elevation gain of 650 meters on the 10 km route
Routes on dirt roads and trails of Southern Evrytania
additional: The races are organized under the auspices of local authorities and sports organizations, with participation in various route lengths and impressive routes through mountain trails and villages.

name: 6ο Thrace Night Run
description: The 6th Night Race of Thrace in Alexandroupoli is an annual sporting event offering routes of 10,000m, 5,000m, and 1,500m for runners of all ages. The race starts and finishes on the city's seaside boulevard, on a circular route of 2,500m, with brisk walking and running. The event combines sports with culture, hosting the registration center in an art gallery of post-Byzantine visual arts. There is electronic timing, extensive medical coverage, and awards for winners in various age categories. The race attracts over 1,200 participants and is supported by the Municipality of Alexandroupoli and other organizations.
course_highlights: Circular route of 2,500m on the seaside boulevard of Alexandroupoli
Brisk walking and running over distances of 1,500m, 5,000m, and 10,000m
Start and finish on the seaside boulevard, with electronic timing
additional: Participation packages can be collected on Friday and Saturday before the race at the old Town Hall of Alexandroupoli. There are refreshment stations with water and bananas during the race and at the finish line. All participants receive a sports bag. There is an option to purchase dry-fit t-shirts, windbreakers, and thermal wear. The race has a total participation limit of 1,200. Medical coverage includes medical examinations and collaboration with EKAB, the Hellenic Red Cross, and the Greek Rescue Team. The race takes place on May 15, 2027, with participants from all over Greece and the Balkans. The event promotes unity, sports, and culture, offering a unique night running experience.

name: Tyros Run
description: The Tyros Run is a friendly road race held in the beautiful Tyros of Kynouria, offering two main routes of 8 and 16 kilometers along the sea. With a convivial atmosphere and noble competition, participants run and explore the area while enjoying cultural events and nights filled with local culture and Tzakonia. The event provides professional timing and rich photographic coverage before, during, and after the event. It is an event that combines sports and culture with a friendly and social character.
course_highlights: Two main routes of 8 and 16 km along the sea
Convivial and friendly atmosphere
Local culture and Tzakonia in parallel events
additional: Professional timing and rich photographic coverage are provided before, during, and after the race. There are parallel routes for children and adults. Road races and cultural events, children's races, hiking, local festival, parallel activities, and cultural and environmental initiatives are organized.

name: 1ο Kotroni Trail
description: The 1st Kotroni Trail Run is a new mountain running race held in Kapandriti, Attica. It includes routes of 20km, 12km, and 5km, with natural trails, forest roads, and varied terrain, offering an authentic trail running experience. The event also features a 1km children's race, making it accessible to everyone. The start and finish are at the Kapandriti indoor gym, with the course marked and supported by volunteers. The organization hosts hundreds of runners and mountain running enthusiasts, creating a festive atmosphere with music and traditional dances.
course_highlights: Routes of 20km, 12km, and 5km with natural trails and forest roads
Cleaned and marked course with refreshment points
Rich vegetation and terrain variations (dirt, rocks, streams)
additional: The start and finish are at the Kapandriti indoor gym. There is a 1km children's race with participation of over 40 children. The organization includes a pre pasta party and a music stage with The Retro Sofa. There is a participation limit of 400 people overall, with 100 for the 20km and 300 for the 12km and 5km. Group registrations are for teams of more than 10 people. The routes include trail running and paths, emphasizing natural protection and cultural heritage. The event also features cultural and environmental activities, as well as a 1km children's race.

name: 3ο Koziakas Trail
description: The 3rd Koziakas Trail is a mountain race held in the beautiful Elati Trikalon, with routes of 25.75 km, 8 km, and 1 km for young athletes. The course starts and ends in Elati, crossing fir forests and alpine landscapes of Koziakas, dedicated to the rescue of the Egyptian vulture, an endangered bird species in Greece. The area is a popular mountain tourist destination with many natural and cultural attractions. From this year, the event is included in the ITRA lists, giving the race international recognition.
course_highlights: Routes through beautiful fir forests
Alpine landscapes of Mount Koziakas
Start and finish in Elati Trikalon
additional: Trail races 25.75 km, 8 km, and 1 km for children; part of ITRA; natural scenery, bird protection, and ecological awareness.

name: 5ο Koutouki Trail Run
organizer: Δήμος Παιανίας, Σύνδεσμος Προστασίας & Ανάπτυξης Υμηττού (ΣΠΑΥ)
description: The 5th Koutouki Trail Run race in Paiania offers enchanting dirt trails in Mount Hymettus, with options of 10 km and 1 km. The event welcomes hundreds of runners who enjoy nature and the beauty of the mountain. The race is ideal for runners of all levels seeking a unique mountain running experience in a friendly and well-organized environment.
course_highlights: Dirt trails in Mount Hymettus
Enchanting natural scenery
Options of 10 km and 1 km
additional: The race includes two distances, 10 km and 1 km, with dirt trails in Mount Hymettus. No information was found regarding prices, start times, or registration process. Technical features of the route: approximately 10,000 meters, trail and forest road. Difficulty: moderate, with small elevation changes. Aid stations with water and first aid. The route will be monitored by volunteers and there will be a children's race of 1,000 meters. Participation also includes exercises and kilometers on trails and mountain paths.

name: 6ο City Trail Αγρίνιο
description: The 6th City Trail Agrinio is a 16.4-kilometer running race organized by the Agrinio Health Runners Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Agrinio. The race takes place as part of the celebrations for the city's patron saint, Saint Christoforos, with start and finish lines at the central Democracy Square of the city. Additionally, on the same day, races of 6 km and 1 km are held for younger runners. The route includes trails and dirt roads within the Saint Christoforos Forest and the Pappasstratos Municipal Park, with signage for participants' safety.
course_highlights: 16.4 km route with trails and dirt roads
Passes through Saint Christoforos Forest and Pappasstratos Municipal Park
Start and finish at the central Democracy Square of Agrinio
additional: On the same day, races of 6 km and 1 km are held for children. All starts are from the central Democracy Square. The route is marked for the safety of runners. The races include 16.4 km, 6 km, and 1 km for children, with the start from the square. The event aims to promote sports and health, with participants from local and visiting runners.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Ιωαννίνων
description: The 9th Ioannina Half Marathon is a distinctive running event held around Lake Pamvotis and the historic center of Ioannina. It offers routes for everyone, from the half marathon of 21 km to 10 km, 5 km, a children's race of 1 km, and a 1 km race for People with Disabilities (PWD). The organization is dynamic and comprehensive, with high participation and performances, establishing the event as significant in the Greek running scene. The races take place on May 15 and 16, 2027, with start and finish points along the city’s lakeside.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Pamvotis
Passages through the historic center of Ioannina
Lakeside scenery with beautiful views
additional: The children's 1 km race is held on 15/05/2027 at 17:00 for children aged 3-12 with free registration and limited spots. There are also 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km races for PWD with specific start times. The event includes feeding stations and is supported by volunteers. Late registration is available for a limited period before the race. Organized with the support of the Municipality of Ioannina and the Epirus Region, with activities and events in the city attracting runners and visitors from all over Greece.

name: 9ος Λαϊκός Δρόμος «Παναγιώτης Αφαλής»
description: The 9th People's Race "Panagiotis Afalis" in Neapoli Thessaloniki is an annual sporting event that promotes sports and social participation. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages to enjoy a route within the city, strengthening community spirit and healthy living. The organization bears the name of Panagiotis Afalis, honoring his memory and contribution to the local community. The Municipality of Neapoli-Sykies actively supports the event, providing a well-organized and welcoming athletic experience.
course_highlights: Route within the city of Neapoli Thessaloniki
Friendly to all runners, regardless of level
Organized support from the Municipality of Neapoli-Sykies
additional: The event includes running and walking in Neapoli Thessaloniki, with participation from organizations and clubs, and requires a signed participation form. It is conducted with safety and medical support, and involves traffic interruptions and bus diversions.

name: 10ο Panorama Charity Fun Run «Μελίνα Λαζαρίδου»
description: The 10th Panorama Charity Fun Run "Melina Lazariadou" is a charitable running event organized by the Municipality of Pylaia-Chortiatis in collaboration with SEGAS and the athletic club "Leontes Panorama". The event includes three routes of 10km, 5km, and 2km through the streets of Panorama, with the finish line at the Olympic Athletic Center. The race has a social character, as the proceeds are allocated to charitable associations and organizations. Participation is open to everyone, with a large turnout of runners of all ages, creating a celebration of sports and solidarity.
course_highlights: Three routes: 10km, 5km, and 2km
Routes through the streets of Panorama
Finish at the Olympic Athletic Center
additional: The event is supported by SEGAS and the athletic club "Leontes Panorama". The proceeds are allocated to charitable associations such as the Parents' Association of Children with Neoplastic Diseases of Northern Greece “Lampsi”, the Friends of Papageorgiou Hospital “Antirida”, and the “Children's Village of SOS Filyrou”. Registration can be done online or in person at the Olympic Athletic Center of Panorama daily from 17:00 and on weekends from 11:00. Routes with special traffic arrangements, participation for all ages, proceeds for charitable purposes, collaboration with SEGAS and local clubs.

name: 13ο Paggaio Trail Run
description: The 13th Paggaio Trail Run is organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Kavala and offers two mountain running races: a challenging 27-kilometer race for experienced runners and a 10-kilometer race for less experienced participants. The routes start and finish in the village of Dómatia, at the foot of Mount Paggaio, and cross trails, forest roads, and a few meters of asphalt. Mount Paggaio offers unique natural landscapes and an unforgettable experience for mountain running enthusiasts. The event welcomes both experienced and new runners to discover the area's beauty through the race.
course_highlights: Trails on paths and forest roads with a few meters of asphalt
Start and finish in the village of Dómatia, altitude 150 meters
Natural landscapes and ridges of Mount Paggaio
additional: The event also includes routes for children, while the natural beauty and cultural heritage of the area are significant elements of the event.

name: 14ος Αγώνας Ορεινού Τρεξίματος «Σαμαριά»
description: The 14th Samaria Mountain Race is a demanding 21.6-kilometer race that crosses the impressive Samaria Gorge, one of the most well-known and visited natural landscapes in Europe. The route starts from the Omalos Plateau and moves through trails and rural roads, offering unique panoramic views and contact with the area's rare flora and fauna. Simultaneously, the 4th Omalos Run 7-kilometer race is organized, ideal for those seeking a shorter route. The race is organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Chania and provides an excellent opportunity for runners to enjoy the nature and history of Crete.
course_highlights: Route of 21.6 km through the Samaria Gorge with rare flora and fauna
Multiple refreshment points along the route
Panoramic view from Kalivaki and diverse terrains (trails, rural roads, asphalt section)
additional: The route includes 8 refreshment stations with a variety of foods. The race starts and finishes at Xyloskalo (altitude 1,250 meters). There is also a shorter 7 km route (Omalos Run). The route crosses the gorge with narrow sections such as the "Sideropora" which is 3 meters wide and up to 700 meters high. Tips for accommodation, transportation, and equipment are provided. The organization includes services and checks, and participation requires online registration. The Samaria area and Omalos offer a unique mountain experience.

name: 39ος Κορακοβούνιος Δρόμος
price_range: 5€ για 4χλμ, 7€ για 4χλμ, άλλα ποσά κατόπιν επικοινωνίας
description: The 39th Korakobounios Race is one of the oldest and most historic running events in Crete, organized in Korakobouni, Heraklion. It features a route that combines natural beauty and athletic challenge, attracting runners of all levels. The event has a long tradition and offers a unique running experience in the heart of Cretan countryside. Participants enjoy authentic hospitality and support from local communities.
course_highlights: Route through authentic Cretan countryside
Passages through traditional villages and natural landscapes
Stone-paved alleys and forest trails
additional: The organization emphasizes environmental protection. No information was found regarding start times, participation fees, or special packages. The website recommends following social media for updates and photos. Registration is open until May 3rd, with free bus transportation, bib and t-shirt pickup on May 9th, technical support from SEGAS, and medical coverage from CRETA Interclinic.

name: «Τρέξε για τη ζωή» για τη γιορτή της Μητέρας
description: Run for Life is a sporting event organized by Lesvos Runners in Mytilene, on the occasion of Mother's Day. It is a day full of energy, smiles, and love, where runners and walkers are invited to participate in a large gathering at the Tsamakia Park. The event is open to everyone, regardless of level, and promotes well-being and social participation through sports.
course_highlights: Route through Tsamakia Park in Mytilene
Friendly and family environment for runners and walkers
Event dedicated to Mother's Day
additional: The event takes place at Tsamakia Park, with a start at 11:00 a.m. No specific distances or categories are mentioned; participation of all levels is encouraged. The organization has a friendly and social character, honoring Mother's Day. It includes running or walking, aiming to promote health and the local community, and is held on the pedestrian street "Tsamakia" on May 16, 2027.

name: Kassios Dias
description: Kassios Dias is a challenging technical mountain running race held on the trails of Northeastern Corfu, offering two routes of 25 and 12 kilometers. The routes pass through traditional semi-mountainous settlements and the unique ecosystem of Erimitis, a protected NATURA area, combining mountain scenery with seaside beauty. The 25 km route includes passages through caves and peaks with panoramic views, while the children's race of 1,200 meters allows kids to experience the joy of running. The race is organized by the Running and Hiking Club "Kassios Dias" with the aim of promoting sports and volunteerism.
course_highlights: 25 km route with +1,300 m elevation, passing through Peristerograf Cave
Passing through the protected NATURA ecosystem of Erimitis
Panoramic view from Mount Matagonas (640 m elevation)
additional: Number pickup and new registrations are carried out in person on Thursday and Saturday in Corfu and Kassiopi, as well as on race day before the start. The start and finish are at the Kassiopi Port. There is a pre-race meal (Pasta Party) on Saturday. Registration is not required for the 1,200 m children's race. Access by car to Kassiopi Port on race day is limited due to traffic regulations. There is private paid parking and free parking spots on a nearby peripheral road. On-site registration is available, and the organization includes accommodation and transportation options to ensure comfortable participation. The area is a popular summer destination with easy access via airport, road networks, and ferries.

name: Kifissia Runners In The Night
description: Kifissia Runners in the Night is an exciting 5-kilometer night race held in the center of Kifisia with start and finish at the Zirinio Municipal Stadium. The event, taking place for the fourth year, offers a unique running experience on the illuminated streets of the city, welcoming summer with a large sports celebration. The race is organized by the Municipality of Kifisia in collaboration with the Attica Region and is aimed at runners seeking a night route full of energy and vibrancy.
course_highlights: Night race of 5 km in the center of Kifisia
Start and finish at Zirinio Municipal Stadium
Route through main city streets with lighting
additional: The race includes chip timing and a participant number sent via email. There is an option to participate as a volunteer supporting the organization. The race offers registration and volunteering options, and is a major sports celebration in the heart of Kifisia, with participants of all ages and levels.

name: Megalopolis Theater Run
description: The Megalopolis Theater Run is a running race held in Megalopolis, Arcadia, dedicated to the ancient theater of the city, the largest theater of the ancient Greek world. The race includes routes of 10 km with a newly renovated course, 5 km, and 1 km for all, offering a unique running experience in a historic environment. The organization invites runners and volunteers to participate and embrace this celebration of sports and culture. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in collaboration with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce.
course_highlights: 10 km route with a newly renovated course
Routes of 5 km and 1 km for all
Dedicated to the ancient theater of Megalopolis, the largest ancient theater
additional: There is a volunteer program for residents and interested parties. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in collaboration with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce. The event includes multiple routes, registrations for runners and volunteers, and takes place in a historic site dedicated to the ancient Greek theater.

name: Sohos Mountain Games
organizer: Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος «Σώκος Ερμής» και Τοπική Κοινότητα Σοχού
description: The Sohos Mountain Games is the largest mountain running race held in Sohos Thessaloniki, offering an unforgettable trail running experience amidst natural beauty and a variety of routes. Participants can choose between 30km, 10km, 5km routes, and a 1-mile route for children, starting and finishing at the central square of Sohos. The race combines sports, local tradition, and social event, with a party, DJ, and traditional kokoretsi after the finish. It is a celebration for all runners, from elite athletes to families and children.
course_highlights: 30km route with 1300m positive elevation, moderate difficulty
10km route with 520m positive elevation, moderate difficulty
5km Fun Run around Sohos, suitable for everyone
additional: All starts are from the central square of Sohos. Race amenities include a technical T-shirt, Buff, Pre-Race Pasta Party, participation number, electronic timing, finisher medal, full catering, medical services, after-race traditional meal, and electronic participation certificate. There is also a big celebration with DJ and traditional kokoretsi after the race. Discount packages are available for unemployed, students, pupils, people with disabilities, and members of the Armed Forces & Security Services. Includes multiple trail routes, post-race activities, party, free transportation for early registrations, and warm hospitality.

name: 26ος Ευχίδειος Άθλος
description: The Euchideia Ultra is a historic ultramarathon race that crosses the area between Delphi and Plataea, honoring the feat of the messenger Euchidas. Runners pass through historic battlefields and natural landscapes, with routes that include uphill sections on Mount Helicon and panoramic views of the Corinthian Gulf. The race offers a unique experience combining sports, history, and culture, with start and finish points at significant historic sites. The event includes three ultramarathon routes, covering different levels of difficulty and distance.
course_highlights: 107.5 km route Plataea - Delphi through historic battlefields
Uphill sections on the mythical Mount Helicon with panoramic views of the Corinthian Gulf
A short 5 km section on dirt road along the Mornos Canal
additional: The start of the Euchideia ultra-distance race of 215 km is at 07:00. There is a pasta party and technical briefing the day before. The route is mainly paved except for a small 5 km dirt road section. There are control and refueling stations along the route. After finishing, a ceremony of lighting the Delphi Fire, awards, and a reception at the European Cultural Center of Delphi take place. The event features multiple routes with historical and cultural significance, emphasizing the natural beauty of the area. Registrations usually open at the end of October or early November.

name: 5ο Run Πύργου
location: Κεντρική Πλατεία Πύργου, Πύργος, Ηλεία, Greece

description: The 5th running race "5th RUN PYRGOU" in Pyrgos Ilia offers a sports celebration for all ages with routes of 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, and 500 meters. The start and finish are at the Central Square of Pyrgos, with categories for adults and children, as well as special categories for people with disabilities. The race is co-organized by Pirgos AthleticEvents and the Municipality of Pyrgos, aiming to promote sports and community participation. The event offers medals and cups to the winners of each category, creating a friendly and encouraging atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, and 500 meters at the Central Square of Pyrgos
Categories for all ages, from toddlers to adults and people with disabilities
Start and finish at the central square, in an urban environment
additional: Medals are awarded to the top three winners of each category and cups to the first-place finishers overall. Minors aged 15-18 can participate with parental consent. The start of all routes is from the Central Square of Pyrgos at different times from 18:30 to 20:30. The race is organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Pyrgos and includes various routes and categories for all age groups and athletic levels. Participation promotes health and well-being, while electronic registration and results facilitate tracking runners' performance.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κάστρου Διδυμοτείχου «Κώστας Γκατσιούδης»
description: The 8th Castle of Didymoteicho Run «Kostas Gatsioudis» is an annual running event held in Didymoteicho. It includes routes of 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, a race for people with disabilities, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The race started in 2016 initiated by military personnel with the support of the Municipality of Didymoteicho and the Division. It is an important athletic and cultural event for the area, honoring the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay
Includes a race for people with disabilities
Held at the historic Didymoteicho Castle
additional: The event honors the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis and General Charalambos Lalouzis, and includes festive activities. The route passes through the historic castle of the city, and participation is open to everyone, with registrations via Google Form.

organizer: Δήμος Πόρου, Γυμναστική Ένωση Πόρου Τροιζηνίας

description: The Poseidonia races on Poros are a popular running sports event attracting over 900 runners from all over Greece and abroad. Organized by the Municipality of Poros and the Gymnastics Union of Poros Troizinas, it offers routes of different distances within the picturesque island of Poros. The event includes routes from 300 meters up to 10 kilometers, with electronic timing and free participation in all activities. After the races, a free Pasta Party is offered to participants, creating a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes from 300 m to 10,000 m on a scenic island
Electronic timing for 5 km and 10 km athletes
Free Pasta Party after the races
additional: Participation includes a race t-shirt, water bottle, banana, electronic timing, and a commemorative medal. There is a 50% discount on ferry tickets for athletes traveling from Piraeus and Aegina. The registration office operates on Friday afternoon and Saturday morning for bib, bag, and t-shirt pickup. Transportation to Poros is available by road and ferry. The event features road and mountain running races, children's races, family activities, electronic registration, and events for all.

name: Goulinas Trail
description: The Goulinas Trail mountain running race is organized in the Spercheiada area of Phthiotis with the aim of highlighting the region through sports and love for nature. It includes three routes of different lengths and elevation differences, offering an unforgettable experience to all participants. The start and finish are at the central square of Spercheiada, while the race emphasizes environmental protection and sustainability. The event promotes fair play, cooperation, and a healthy lifestyle through sports.
course_highlights: Three routes: 6km, 12km, and 30km with different elevation gains (220m, 700m, 2000m)
Start and finish at the Central Square of Spercheiada
Environmentally sensitive setting with emphasis on protection and minimal footprint
additional: The start and finish of all routes are at the Central Square of Spercheiada. The 30km main race has a finish time limit of 7 hours and an intermediate checkpoint at 12.5km in 2 hours and 45 minutes. The race is environmentally friendly with measures to reduce impact on the natural environment. It includes different routes focused on nature and adventure, and provides information on accommodation and participation.

name: 1ο «Το Καλωσόρισμα των Πελαργών»
description: The 1st Stork Welcome Run in Aiginio Pierias is a spring athletic celebration organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros. The event includes races of 11 kilometers, 5 kilometers, and a children's race of 1000 meters, offering an opportunity for participation to athletes and visitors. The hospitable city of Storks hosts runners on a route that combines natural beauty and sporting spirit, promoting mass sports and regional awareness.
course_highlights: 11 km race route Kolindros - Katakhas - Aiginio
5 km race circular route in Aiginio
Children's race 1000 meters circular route in Aiginio
additional: The organization takes place within the framework of the 1st Stork Festival and includes sports events aimed at promoting mass sports and regional awareness. The event is supported by local clubs and agencies. Races at various levels and ages, scheduled for May 23, 2027, along with parallel activities and ecological awareness initiatives.

name: 4ος Axios Running Festival
description: The Axios Running Festival is a multi-day sports and cultural celebration held in the Axios Valley, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages and levels. The event includes races of 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1 mile, with certified routes and parallel social, cultural, and environmental activities. The race combines sports, tourism, and history, showcasing the area and supporting the local community. The organization is under the auspices of the Central Macedonia Region and follows the regulations of World Athletics.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting from the Koufalia Town Hall and finishing at the Balkan Wars Military Museum
Routes crossing the Axios Valley, the Axios Dam, and the old Thessaloniki-Evzoni National Road
Certified routes according to the regulations of World Athletics
additional: The race takes place every first Sunday of April (in this case May 23, 2027) and is a two-day multifaceted experience with parallel environmental, cultural, and social events. Participants can print participation certificates for all distances. The organization provides high-level safety and support services for runners of all ages and levels. It includes running races, health activities, and walking, with an emphasis on environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Belles Historic Trail
description: The Belles Historic Trail race is a special mountain running event that combines natural beauty with the historical memory of the Nea Petritsi area in Serres. The routes cross trails with rich natural vegetation, historic fortresses, and enchanting panoramic views, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. The event includes races of different distances, from 1 km for children to 22.66 km for experienced athletes, with a welcoming atmosphere and local flavors at the finish line. The Belles Historic Trail is a celebration of sport, culture, and nature, uniting the community and visitors.
course_highlights: Trails through lush natural vegetation and waterfalls
Historic fortresses and trails of the Battle of the Forts (1941)
Panoramic view of Lake Kerkini and Mount Belles
additional: Electronic timing with immediate and accurate results. Nutrition stations along the routes. Souvenir gifts for all athletes (windbreaker jacket, buff, socks). Medical coverage throughout the event. Traditional local delicacies at the finish line. Children's races on Sunday at 11:30. Secretariat and packet pickup on race day from 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 17:30. The event includes trail and on-road races, with participation from children and athletes of different levels, and offers medals and local cuisine to participants.

name: 5ο Godzilla Xanthi Trail
location: Xanthi, East Macedonia and Thrace, Greece
