description: The 5th Godzilla Xanthi Trail is a demanding mountain race held in Xanthi, offering three different routes: 30km, 14km, and 7km. The 30km route features technical trails and significant elevation gain, while the shorter routes are suitable for runners with different experience levels, with the 7km being an ideal introduction to mountain running. The race is organized by the Athletic Club of Runners Xanthi “Xanthi Runners” in collaboration with the Municipality of Xanthi and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, providing a unique sporting experience in the area's nature.
course_highlights: 30km route with 28km trails and 1850m positive elevation gain
14km route with 12km trails and 600m positive elevation gain
7km circular, easy route, ideal for introduction to mountain running
additional: The start and finish are located at Thilia. Awards are given at 11:30 for the 7km race and at 14:30 for the 30km and 14km races. There is a volunteer following the last runners for support. Bib collection takes place at the central square of Xanthi on Saturday before the race and early on race day at the start area. Group registration is available for clubs and groups of runners. Three routes with different difficulty levels, start and finish in Iliia, with full catering and awards. The 30km route is particularly demanding and technical, suitable for experienced runners.

name: 6ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Φαλανναίων
description: The 6th Falannaios Running Race is an athletic event organized in Falani, Larissa, offering an opportunity to participate in a road race aimed at promoting mass sports and healthy living. The race is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners Club, an organization with a long tradition in supporting runners, mountaineers, and cyclists. The event emphasizes social responsibility, solidarity, and love for nature, strengthening the athletic spirit and the community of sports enthusiasts. The race is a celebration for runners and sports lovers in the area.
course_highlights: Routes of 21.1 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children and people with disabilities
Collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local agencies
Focus on social cohesion and volunteering
additional: Organization with routes of 21.1 km, 5 km, and children's/disabled 1 km, in collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local agencies

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ειρήνης «Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης»
description: The 8th Peace Run "Grigoris Lambrakis" is a 23-kilometer race organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee in honor of the activist and peace martyr Grigoris Lambrakis. The race takes place in Tripoli and crosses routes connecting the city with areas such as Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista. Participation is free, and the race is part of the annual racing events of the Arcadia Peace Committee. It is an event with a historical and social character that honors the memory and work of Grigoris Lambrakis.
course_highlights: 23-kilometer route from Tripoli to Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, Kerasista, and back to Tripoli
Areas of historical and natural interest in Arcadia
Race centered around the birthplace of Grigoris Lambrakis
additional: Participation in the race is free. The race is organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee and is part of the annual racing events of the Committee. The date for 2026 was Sunday, May 17 at 18:00, in Tripoli. Routes in various parts of Tripoli, participation from the Arcadia Peace Committee, historical and social context, and references to previous events.

name: 13ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμους «Γεώργιος Αποστολάκης»
description: The 13th Popular Running Race "Georgios Apostolakis" is organized in Nea Chalkidona in honor of the late Mayor Giorgos Apostolakis, who left an indelible mark on the local community. The race has high participation and is a celebration of sports and local tradition. The event honors the contribution and love for sports, while promoting social cohesion and health through athletics.
course_highlights: Routes of 1,000 m and 10,000 m in an urban environment
Organized by the PARK "GEORGE APOSTOLAKIS"
Includes running races and gymnastics for all ages
additional: Routes of 1,000 m and 10,000 m, age categories, running races and gymnastics, date 23/05/2027

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας
description: The 22nd Sacrifice Run in Naoussa is a race that honors the historic heroic city and its unique tradition. The route offers participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural environment of Mount Vermio and the area's rich cultural heritage. Naoussa, with its beautiful trails and welcoming environment, is an ideal destination for runners of all ages and levels. The race combines athletic challenge with historical memory and local hospitality.
course_highlights: Route at the foothills of Mount Vermio
Passing through historic and cultural sites of Naoussa
Natural environment with fresh air and beautiful trails
additional: Naoussa offers welcoming accommodations and local cuisine with Xinomavro wine and traditional flavors. The area is accessible by road from Thessaloniki, 90 km away, and is suitable for family trips and outdoor adventures. Organized with an emphasis on historical memory, registrations are available online and in person, with medals and souvenirs for all runners.

name: Dental Run
organizer: Athens Dental Students' Association, Greek Pharmaceutical Students' Federation, Δήμος Ζωγράφου
description: The Dental Run 2026 is a friendly race organized at Goudi Park on May 17. It invites runners of all levels to participate either in a 5-kilometer course, a leisurely walk, or a children's race. The event aims to promote health and smiles, while also offering opportunities for non-athletes to volunteer. The start is scheduled for 09:00 in the morning, and the event is open to everyone, supported by well-known dental product companies.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route at Goudi Park
Option for a leisurely walk or children's race
Friendly to all, open to runners and volunteers
additional: There is an option to participate as a volunteer for those who do not wish to run. Supported by companies such as Sensodyne, Corega, Parodontax, Elmex-Colgate, Curaprox, and Dole. The race is organized to raise awareness for health, with participation options including 5 km, walking, and children's running, and includes opportunities for volunteer involvement.

name: 5 ος Αγώνας Ολοι Μαζί Ολοι Ισοι
description: The 5th race event "All together - All equal" is organized by the Region of Central Greece with the support of the "Geydra" structure and the backing of the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners Club “Trachina”. The race takes place at Lamia Castle and aims to raise awareness for People with Disabilities. It includes three routes of 800m, 2.5km, and 5km, which are non-competitive and do not have timing. Participation is free for People with Disabilities and their companions.
course_highlights: Routes of 800m, 2.5km, and 5km at Lamia Castle
Start and finish at the same point at the Castle
Routes suitable for PWD and companions, non-competitive
additional: The 2.5km and 5km routes allow participation of People with Disabilities and companions over 12 years old. The 800m route is for PWD regardless of age and elementary school children (6-12 years). There is no timing and the race has a symbolic character. The program includes opening of the registration desk at 10:00, 800m start at 11:00, and 2.5km and 5km starts at 11:30, with the event ending at 12:30. Organized with a social purpose, involving children and adults, awareness and cultural activities, supported by the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners Club.

name: 13ος Πράσινος Ημιμαραθώνιος Λευκάδας
description: The 13th Green Half Marathon of Lefkada is a night race organized by the Athletic Club of Lefkada "Filandros" in collaboration with the Municipality of Lefkada and the Ionian Islands Region. The race includes routes of 21.1 km, 8 km, and a children's race of 1 km for children aged 6-12. The start and finish are at the Lefkada Cultural Center, with the route passing around the lagoon, offering a unique running experience with a sunset view. The race is under the auspices of the EAS SEGAS Epirus and the Hellenic Association of Long Distance Runners - Youth.
course_highlights: Night race with start at 19:45
Route around the Lefkada lagoon
Start and finish at the Lefkada Cultural Center
additional: Event schedule includes bib and chip pickup, pasta party, awards. Children's races with separate start times. The 8 km start is at 17:45 and the children's 1 km at 16:30. Routes of 21.097 km and 8 km, races for children aged 6-12, parallel activities, routes in protected NATURA environment.

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Αγγελής Γοβιός»
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Ψαχνών, Ψαχνά, Ευβοίας, Greece
description: The Thysias Road "Angelēs Goviōs" is a historic running race held for the 22nd time in Psachna, Euboea, organized by the Psachna Runners and Walkers Club under the auspices of the Municipality of Dirfys-Messapia. The race includes routes of 15 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children and people with disabilities, honoring the memory of the great Euboean revolutionary leader Angelēs Goviōs and the late Mayor Giorgos Psathas. The start is given at the central square of Psachna, and participation is free with adequate refreshments. The 15 km route is 50% off-road with a total elevation gain of +131 meters, while the 5 km and 1 km routes are entirely asphalt with minimal elevation changes.
course_highlights: Route of 15 km with 50% off-road terrain and +131m elevation gain.
Routes of 5 km and 1 km on asphalt with minimal elevation changes.
Start from the central square of Psachna.
additional: Registrations are made on the day of the race at the starting point and are free. Registrations begin at 15:00. There is sufficient refreshments for runners. The event takes place on May 29, 2027, with a start time at 17:00, and includes routes for all ages and levels, promoting sports and historical memory.

name: Run For Stroke
location: Μητροπολιτικό Πάρκο «Αντώνης Τρίτσης», Αγίοι Ανάργυροι, Αττική, Greece
description: The Run For Stroke race is organized by the Stroke Hope Non-Profit Company in collaboration with NeuroLife IKE, aiming to raise awareness for the prevention and support of people affected by stroke. The event takes place at the Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park and includes 5 km races for runners and 1 km for children and people with disabilities. The race started in 2024 and has the vision to connect physical activity with health and social awareness. The technical direction is managed by WeRun with support from RUNAWAY.
course_highlights: Routes within Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park
5 km dirt track consisting of two 2.5 km laps
1 km route for children and people with disabilities
additional: Participation rights: 5 km for individuals over 12 years old with a medical certificate of fitness. 1 km for children aged 6-12, people with disabilities, and patients. The race includes runners and walkers. Technical direction by WeRun, supported by RUNAWAY. The event will take place on Saturday, May 23, 2026, starting at 18:30, at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park. The terrain includes park trails and promotes health and social awareness.

name: Ursa Trail
description: The Ursa Trail race in Metsovo is a demanding mountain race offering routes for all runners, from the ultra marathon of 100 km with 5,700 meters of elevation gain, to shorter distances such as 40 km, 21 km, 11 km, and the vertical race Katara Vertical 4.6 km. The course crosses beautiful trails and mountains of the area, providing unique natural scenery and technical challenges. The race is certified by the ITRA and is an important event for mountain running enthusiasts in Greece. The organization ensures the safety and support of athletes with supply points and technical assistance along the route.
course_highlights: Ultra marathon 100km with 5,700m elevation gain
Routes of 40km, 21km, 11km, and the 4.6km vertical race
Beautiful mountain trails in Metsovo with technical challenges
additional: The races start at different times depending on the distance. There are supply points and technical support along the routes. The race is certified by ITRA and awards UTMB points for the 100km ultra marathon. Information on accommodations and transportation in the area is also provided. Ursa Trail includes children's races and special challenges, such as URSA CHALLENGE 65.6 km with 4,810 meters of elevation difference. The organization combines racing and hiking, with overnight stays in Metsovo and participation of volunteers and local authorities.

name: 1ο Backyard Ultra Δράμας
description: The 1st Drama Backyard Ultra starts and finishes at Kart Track 69 Speedway in Drama. Runners begin at 08:00 in the morning of May and follow the Backyard Ultra format, where they must complete a 6.7 km lap within each hour, continuing until only one runner remains. The course crosses the lush area of the Kallifytos stream with a elevation gain of 67 meters per lap, which accumulates over time. There is also a team endurance competition, which determines the best team based on total laps completed.
course_highlights: 6.7 km lap with 67 meters elevation gain
Course through the green area of the Kallifytos stream
Direction change every hour to avoid monotony
additional: Start and finish location at Kart Track 69 Speedway. Refreshment station facilities evolve with the progress of the race: snacks and drinks initially, pasta, cold beer from the 7th lap, pizza from the 10th, and homemade soup from the 15th. Reflective markers for night running. Team endurance cup with results recorded at bigsbackyardultra.com. The course includes crossing the green Kallifytos stream with a 67-meter elevation gain per lap. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, where the winner is the last to complete a lap alone. Participation costs 40 euros.

name: 6ο Vasiliki Lefkada
description: The 6th Vasiliki Lefkada Road & Mountain Races 2026 will take place on May 30-31 in Vasiliki, Lefkada. It is a two-day event featuring road and mountain running races organized by the Lefkada Tourism Company and the Tourism and Culture Association of the wider area. The routes include children's scooter races, an explosive 3,500-meter duathlon with swimming and running, and the classic 13,000-meter road race starting from Porto Katsiki beach. The main race begins at 18:00, offering a unique athletic experience in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: 13,000-meter road race starting from Porto Katsiki beach
3,500-meter duathlon with 500 meters swimming and 3,000 meters running on trails and asphalt
Children's scooter races of 1,000 and 1,500 meters at Vasiliki beach
additional: The children's scooter races start on Saturday, May 30 in the afternoon from Vasiliki beach. The 3,500-meter duathlon includes approximately 500 meters of swimming from Agiofili beach to the neighboring Valtas beach and 3,000 meters of running on trails and asphalt with two feeding stations. The main 13,000-meter road race begins from Porto Katsiki beach at 18:00. The event features various categories and distances, and participation requires registration with a fee.

name: 29ος Γύρος Πόλεως
description: The 29th City Tour in Kyparissia is organized by the Municipality of Trifylia and will take place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, starting and ending at the town's central square. The event includes races for all ages, from toddlers to adults, with distances ranging from 100 meters to 10 kilometers. Participation is free of charge, and all finishers will receive a commemorative medal, with awards for the top finishers in each category. It is a sports celebration that unites the local community and runners of all ages in a beautiful route through the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the central square of Kyparissia
Routes for all ages from 100 meters to 10 km
Power walking and running races in an urban environment
additional: The program includes 100 m races for toddlers, 1000 m for elementary school children, 4000 m for middle school, high school students, and adults, power walking for all ages, and 10 km for runners aged 18 and above. All finishers receive a commemorative medal, and awards are given to the top in each category. Participants can register via an online form. The race features routes for children, teenagers, and adults, emphasizing social participation and the promotion of sports in the area.
